title: FTD-GNO: Memory-Efficient Graph Neural Operators through Functional Tensor Decomposition of the Kernel
summary: Graph Neural Operators (GNOs) provide flexible surrogate models for learning solution operators of partial differential equations (PDEs). However, standard GNOs typically parameterize the integral kernel with a monolithic neural network and evaluate kernel interactions over graph edges, leading to substantial computational and memory overhead at high resolutions or with large neighborhoods. To address these limitations, we propose Functional Tensor Decomposition Graph Neural Operator (FTD-GNO), a memory-efficient GNO framework that decouples the high-dimensional continuous integral kernel into low-dimensional mode-wise functions. By instantiating the kernel with classical tensor decomposition formats, including CP, Tensor-Train, and Tucker decompositions, FTD-GNO enables algebraic reconstruction of the integral operator without explicitly materializing full edge-wise kernel tensors. This factorized formulation reduces the memory footprint of kernel evaluation and aggregation while retaining the continuous operator-learning structure of GNOs. Theoretical complexity analysis shows that FTD-GNO substantially lowers parameter and activation-memory costs associated with high-dimensional kernel construction. Experiments show lower peak memory than the corresponding unfactorized graph-integral baselines, with shorter recorded training times. Fourier-graph experiments further demonstrate that FTD can improve the efficiency of a graph-integral layer within a hybrid operator and has good scalability.

AI.tldr: 提出功能张量分解图神经算子（FTD-GNO），通过将高维积分核分解为低维模态函数（CP、Tensor-Train、Tucker分解），避免显式构建全边核张量，大幅降低内存占用和计算开销，同时保持连续算子学习结构，实验验证其内存效率、训练速度及可扩展性优势。
AI.motivation: 标准图神经算子（GNO）采用整体神经网络参数化积分核并在图边上评估核交互，导致高分辨率或大邻域下计算和内存开销巨大，限制了其在大规模偏微分方程求解中的应用。
AI.method: FTD-GNO 将连续积分核解耦为低维模态函数，采用经典张量分解格式（CP、Tensor-Train、Tucker）实例化核，通过代数重构积分算子而非显式物化边级核张量，实现核评估与聚合的因子化表达，保留 GNO 的连续算子学习结构。
AI.result: 理论复杂度分析表明 FTD-GNO 显著降低高维核构建的参数量与激活内存成本；实验显示峰值内存低于非因子化图积分基线，训练时间缩短；傅里叶-图实验进一步证明其能提升混合算子中图积分层的效率且具良好可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: FTD-GNO 通过张量分解实现内存高效的图神经算子框架，在保持连续算子学习能力的同时解决了大规模 PDE 代理建模的计算瓶颈，为高分辨率科学机器学习提供了实用的可扩展方案。

title: Verb-ICL: Rethinking In-Context Learning for Structured Prediction
summary: Structured prediction tasks pose unique challenges for in-context learning (ICL): their compositional outputs require modeling fine-grained, token-level patterns that sentence-level approaches fail to capture, and their task-specific annotation conventions are human-defined artifacts that cannot be acquired through pretraining alone. We propose Verb-ICL, a selective annotation framework for ICL-based structured prediction that addresses both challenges. Verb-ICL first selects representative examples using a token-level coverage strategy that captures local semantic patterns critical for structured prediction, then generates actionable error feedback that codifies task-specific annotation guidelines and incorporates this feedback into ICL demonstrations. We evaluate Verb-ICL on six structured prediction datasets spanning information extraction and semantic parsing. Experiments with recent LLMs show that Verb-ICL consistently outperforms strong selective annotation baselines under low-resource settings and continues to provide gains as the annotation budget increases. Extended analyses demonstrate that the generated feedback is predominantly useful across a four-category quality taxonomy, generalizes as task-level guidance beyond instance-specific corrections, and improves performance regardless of the underlying selection strategy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Verb-ICL，一种面向结构化预测任务的选择性标注框架，通过 token 级覆盖策略选取代表性示例，并生成可执行的错误反馈将任务特定标注规范注入上下文学习，在六个数据集上显著优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 结构化预测任务的组合式输出要求建模细粒度 token 级模式，而句子级方法无法捕捉；且任务特定的标注约定是人为定义的产物，无法仅通过预训练习得。现有 ICL 方法在低资源场景下难以同时解决这两大挑战。
AI.method: Verb-ICL 包含两大核心组件：1) 基于 token 级覆盖的示例选择策略，捕捉结构化预测所需的局部语义模式；2) 自动生成可执行的错误反馈，将任务特定的标注指南编码为上下文演示的一部分，指导模型遵循标注规范。
AI.result: 在信息抽取和语义解析共六个数据集上的实验表明，Verb-ICL 在低资源设置下持续超越强选择性标注基线，且随着标注预算增加增益保持。扩展分析显示生成反馈在四类质量分类中以有用为主，能泛化为任务级指导而非仅限实例修正，且无论底层选择策略如何均能提升性能。
AI.conclusion: Verb-ICL 通过 token 级示例选择与规范化错误反馈相结合，有效解决了结构化预测在 ICL 中面临的细粒度建模与标注规范获取难题，为低资源结构化预测提供了通用且可扩展的解决方案。

title: EnvDreamer: Large-Scale Multimodal-to-Environment Generation for Embodied AI
summary: Large datasets and high capacity models have accelerated progress in vision and language. This work introduces a platform aimed at bringing comparable gains to embodied learning, world models, and robotics. We present EnvDreamer, a framework that uses large language and vision language models to generate Unreal Engine 5 environments for embodied AI and robot training. EnvDreamer enables sampling of large, diverse, interactive, customizable, and validator passed virtual environments for training and evaluation across navigation, interaction, and manipulation. We illustrate the platform with a large set of generated scenes and simple baselines. Policies trained on EnvDreamer generated environments, without explicit mapping or human task supervision, achieve competitive results on multiple embodied benchmarks spanning navigation, rearrangement, and manipulation. EnvDreamer also supports image-conditioned reconstruction for real-to-sim studies. Finally, we release EnvDreamer-20k, a dataset of 20,000 validator passed environments with task programs, scene graphs, trajectories, and metadata to support reproducible benchmarking.

AI.tldr: EnvDreamer 是一个利用大语言模型和视觉语言模型生成 Unreal Engine 5 交互式环境的框架，用于具身 AI 和机器人训练，提供大规模、多样化、可定制且通过验证的虚拟环境，并在导航、重排、操作等基准上取得有竞争力的结果，同时发布了包含 2 万个环境的 EnvDreamer-20k 数据集。
AI.motivation: 现有大规模数据集和高容量模型推动了视觉和语言领域的进步，但具身学习、世界模型和机器人学缺乏类似的可扩展、多样化且可交互的虚拟环境平台，阻碍了该领域的发展。
AI.method: EnvDreamer 利用大语言模型和视觉语言模型生成 Unreal Engine 5 环境，支持导航、交互、操作等任务的大规模、多样化、可定制且通过验证的环境采样；提供简单的基线策略，无需显式建图或人工任务监督；支持图像条件重建以实现真实到仿真的研究；并发布 EnvDreamer-20k 数据集，包含任务程序、场景图、轨迹和元数据。
AI.result: 在 EnvDreamer 生成的环境上训练的策略，在导航、重排、操作等多个具身基准上取得了有竞争力的结果；EnvDreamer-20k 数据集为可复现的基准测试提供了支持。
AI.conclusion: EnvDreamer 为具身 AI 和机器人学提供了一个可扩展的虚拟环境生成平台，填补了大规模交互式环境的空白，推动了该领域向视觉语言领域类似的进步迈进。

title: PaLoRA: Paced Low-Rank Adaptation for Continual Learning
summary: LoRA-based continual learning methods mitigate catastrophic forgetting through various mechanisms, yet nearly all complement these with small learning rates as a heuristic to restrict gradient scaling magnitude. Such fixed heuristics lack theoretical guidance on how the strength of this restriction should evolve as tasks accumulate. We reveal that even under directional constraints such as nullspace projection, finite-precision updates inevitably leak into the subspace of accumulated prior knowledge along multiple directions. While small learning rates attenuate such leakage, they cannot prevent the accumulated forgetting from intensifying as the effective rank of historical knowledge grows. We show that the optimal magnitude restriction should adaptively increase with this effective rank to balance stability and plasticity, i.e., preservation of previous knowledge and acquisition of new task information. Under an anisotropic leakage model, we derive a pacing law $s^*=\sqrt{R/c}$ that characterizes the optimal scaling of gradient steps, i.e., the magnitude restriction itself, where $R$ is the effective rank of past updates. Based on this insight, we propose PaLoRA, which compresses historical knowledge via adaptive SVD truncation, projects gradients onto the nullspace of prior tasks, and applies rank-aware adaptive pacing. Experiments demonstrate consistent improvements over prior methods, with particularly strong performance in long-horizon settings, achieving substantial gains of 4% accuracy on challenging 50-task ImageNet-A and ImageNet-R benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文指出基于LoRA的持续学习方法依赖固定小学习率作为启发式手段来限制梯度缩放，缺乏理论指导。作者揭示了即使在方向约束（如零空间投影）下，有限精度更新仍会沿多个方向泄漏到先验知识子空间，且小学习率无法阻止遗忘随有效秩增长而加剧。基于各向异性泄漏模型，推导出最优步长缩放规律 s* = sqrt(R/c)，提出PaLoRA方法：自适应SVD截断压缩历史知识、梯度投影到先验任务零空间、基于秩的自适应步长调度。在50任务ImageNet-A/R基准上比现有方法提升4%准确率，长时程设置优势显著。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LoRA的持续学习方法虽通过各种机制缓解灾难性遗忘，但几乎都辅以固定的小学习率作为启发式手段来限制梯度缩放幅度。这种固定启发式缺乏理论指导，无法说明限制强度应如何随任务累积而演变。作者发现：即使在零空间投影等方向约束下，有限精度更新仍不可避免地沿多个方向泄漏到累积先验知识的子空间。虽然小学习率能衰减泄漏，但无法阻止遗忘随历史知识有效秩增长而加剧。因此需要理论指导的自适应机制来平衡稳定性（保留旧知识）与可塑性（获取新知识）。
AI.method: 提出PaLoRA方法，包含三大核心组件：(1) 自适应SVD截断压缩历史知识，提取有效秩R；(2) 将梯度投影到先验任务的零空间，施加方向约束；(3) 基于各向异性泄漏模型推导的步长调度律 s* = sqrt(R/c)，实现基于秩的自适应步长调度，其中R为历史更新的有效秩，c为常数。该调度律表征了最优梯度步长缩放，使幅度限制随有效秩自适应增加。
AI.result: 实验显示PaLoRA在多个基准上持续优于现有方法，长时程设置下优势尤为明显。在具有挑战性的50任务ImageNet-A和ImageNet-R基准上，相比先前方法实现了4%的准确率显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 最优的梯度幅度限制应随历史知识的有效秩自适应增加，以平衡稳定性与可塑性。本文建立的各向异性泄漏模型及推导的步长调度律 s* = sqrt(R/c) 为持续学习中自适应梯度缩放提供了理论指导。PaLoRA通过压缩历史知识、零空间投影和秩感知自适应调度的结合，有效解决了长时程持续学习中的遗忘累积问题。

title: More Value per Key: Asymmetric Sparse Attention for Faster LLM Decoding
summary: utoregressive generation in Large Language Models (LLMs) is constrained by the memory and computational demands of attention mechanisms. Sparse attention methods mitigate this cost by selecting only high-probability entries of the attention matrix. We observe that in many such methods, this renders the probability-value multiplication negligible, shifting the bottleneck to the query-key step. Key heads can therefore be reduced to accelerate inference, while retaining more value heads preserves capacity with limited additional decoding cost. We introduce Sparse Asymmetric Group-Query Attention (SAGA), which decouples key and value head counts to exploit this principle, and pair it with approximate top-N (Atop-N) attention, a simple sparse attention method designed to study the interaction between sparsity and head-count asymmetry. We formalize the benefits of this asymmetry theoretically and validate them empirically through latency measurements and quality evaluations on models up to 1.5B parameters. Together, SAGA and Atop-N achieve end-to-end decoding speedups exceeding $2\times$ over our full-attention GQA baseline at long contexts. Models trained from scratch with SAGA nearly match the quality of comparable GQA variants on the evaluated benchmarks. To facilitate adoption, we introduce an efficient fine-tuning method that converts pretrained models to the SAGA architecture, enabling practitioners to benefit from our approach without costly retraining.

AI.tldr: 论文提出稀疏不对称分组查询注意力（SAGA）和近似top-N（Atop-N）注意力，通过解耦键头和值头数量，在长上下文解码中实现超过2倍的端到端加速，且模型质量接近同等规模的GQA基线。同时提供高效微调方法将预训练模型转换为SAGA架构，避免昂贵的从头训练。
AI.motivation: 自回归生成中注意力机制的内存和计算开销是瓶颈。稀疏注意力方法虽减少注意力矩阵计算，但使概率-值乘法变得可忽略，将瓶颈转移到查询-键步骤。因此减少键头可加速推理，同时保留更多值头能维持模型容量且额外解码成本有限。
AI.method: 引入SAGA架构，解耦键头和值头数量（键头少于值头），并配合Atop-N稀疏注意力方法（一种简单的近似top-N稀疏注意力）以研究稀疏性与头数不对称的交互。从理论上形式化不对称性的优势，并通过延迟测量和质量评估在高达1.5B参数的模型上实证验证。
AI.result: SAGA结合Atop-N在长上下文下相对于全注意力GQA基线实现超过2倍的端到端解码加速。从头训练的SAGA模型在评测基准上质量接近同规模GQA变体。提供的高效微调方法能将预训练模型转换为SAGA架构，使从业者无需昂贵重新训练即可受益。
AI.conclusion: 通过不对称分组查询注意力和稀疏注意力的协同设计，可显著降低长序列推理延迟同时保持模型性能，且提供实用的模型转换方案，降低采用门槛。

title: MOIRA: Mass-Oriented Indexing with Ragged Attention for Long-Context Decoding
summary: Long-context decoding is limited by memory bandwidth, because every output token reads the KV cache of every layer. Sparse decoding reduces this cost by reading only part of the KV cache. We observe that the number of pages a query needs varies widely across KV heads, layers and steps. Fixed budgets are simple, but they are sized for demanding cases and tuned per workload; adaptive budgets follow this variation more flexibly, but existing designs pay for it with extra selection cost or training. At the kernel level, FlashAttention-3 (FA3) and FlashInfer are designed for rows of similar length: with page lists whose length differs per KV head, they either pad the lists (forfeiting much of the sparse saving), leave thread blocks unbalanced, or rely on a host-side plan that runs outside the CUDA graph. We propose MOIRA, a training-free sparse decode path in vLLM whose budget adapts per KV head and per layer. For every request, layer, KV head and step, a coverage rule keeps the smallest set of pages whose estimated attention mass reaches a fraction $γ$. A new kernel, self-planning attention, lets each thread block derive its own share of the work from the list lengths, so the whole decode step stays inside the CUDA graph. On an H200, at RULER's 128k context, MOIRA with $γ=0.99$ matches dense accuracy while reading about 30% of the pages and reduces the time per output token (TPOT) by 2.2-2.5$\times$ relative to dense FA3; with $γ=0.98$ it reduces TPOT by 2.7$\times$ and stays within the noise of dense. Under high serving load it raises throughput by up to 51%. These results suggest that a budget adapted per head and layer, paired with a kernel that keeps such budgets inside the CUDA graph, makes sparse decoding both flexible and fast.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 MOIRA，一种无需训练的稀疏解码路径，在 vLLM 中实现按 KV 头和层自适应预算，配合自规划注意力内核将整个解码步骤保持在 CUDA 图内，于 H200 上以约 30% 页面读取量达到稠密精度，TPOT 加速 2.2–2.7×，高负载下吞吐提升 51%。
AI.motivation: 长上下文解码受限于内存带宽，每个输出 token 需读取所有层的 KV 缓存。稀疏解码虽能减少读取，但固定预算针对最坏情况且需逐任务调优，自适应预算虽灵活却引入额外选择开销或训练成本；现有内核（FlashAttention-3、FlashInfer）假设行长相近，面对每头页面列表长度不一时，要么填充列表抵消稀疏收益，要么线程块负载不均，要么依赖宿主端规划而跳出 CUDA 图。
AI.method: MOIRA 采用覆盖规则：对每个请求、层、KV 头和步骤，保留估计注意力质量累计达到分数 γ 的最小页面集合，实现逐头逐层的自适应预算。设计自规划注意力内核，让每个线程块根据列表长度自行推导工作量，使整个解码步骤留在 CUDA 图中，避免宿主端干预。
AI.result: 在 H200、RULER 128k 上下文下，γ=0.99 时读取约 30% 页面即匹配稠密精度，TPOT 降低 2.2–2.5×；γ=0.98 时 TPOT 降低 2.7× 且精度在稠密噪声范围内。高服务负载下吞吐最高提升 51%。
AI.conclusion: 逐头逐层自适应预算与可在 CUDA 图内运行的自规划内核相结合，使稀疏解码兼具灵活性与高性能，无需训练即可大幅降低显存带宽压力并加速推理。

title: Stochastic Adaptive Fourier Decomposition for Operator Learning
summary: Fourier Neural Operators (FNOs) offer an efficient paradigm for solving partial differential equations (PDEs). However, FNOs rely on a fixed Fourier basis and hard frequency truncation, which inherently limit their ability to model non-periodic, localized, and fine-scale solution structures. We propose the Stochastic Adaptive Fourier Decomposition Neural Operator (SAFDNO), a spectral neural operator that replaces predefined Fourier modes with an adaptive Takenaka-Malmquist (TM) orthonormal system derived from the theory of Stochastic Adaptive Fourier Decomposition (SAFD). Instead of performing an expensive greedy pole search in classical SAFD, SAFDNO amortizes stochastic pole selection through a neural pole predictor and constructs the adaptive TM system directly from latent features. The resulting operator performs learned filtering on coefficients of analytic branches in the Hardy space with respect to the input-adaptive TM system, preserving the global receptive field of spectral operators while providing a more flexible representation than using fixed spectral bases. Across nine PDE benchmark problems, SAFDNO achieves the best performance on all six regular-grid problems among strong neural operator baselines, with especially notable gains on Darcy, Burgers, and Navier-Stokes, where fixed Fourier modes are often less effective at modeling localized oscillations, sharp transitions, and multiscale structures. SAFDNO also exhibits stronger zero-shot super-resolution performance and shows less performance degradation when deployed on finer discretizations. These results suggest that the input-adaptive TM system provides a promising alternative to fixed spectral representations for neural operator learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出随机自适应傅里叶分解神经算子（SAFDNO），用自适应 Takenaka-Malmquist (TM) 正交系替代固定傅里叶基，通过神经极点预测器摊销随机极点选择，实现输入自适应的频谱表示，在九个 PDE 基准问题中全面超越强基线，尤其在非周期、局域化、多尺度问题上表现优异，且具备更强的零样本超分辨率与细化网格鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有傅里叶神经算子（FNO）依赖固定傅里叶基与硬频率截断，难以有效建模非周期、局域化以及精细尺度的解结构（如局域振荡、陡峭跃变、多尺度特征），限制了其在复杂 PDE 求解中的泛化与精度。
AI.method: 基于随机自适应傅里叶分解（SAFD）理论，构建输入自适应的 TM 正交系：利用神经极点预测器替代经典 SAFD 中昂贵的贪婪极点搜索，从潜在特征直接生成自适应极点，进而建立 TM 系；在 Hardy 空间中对解析分支系数进行学习式滤波，保留频谱算子的全局感受野，同时提供比固定频谱基更灵活的表示能力。
AI.result: 在九个 PDE 基准测试中，SAFDNO 在所有六个规则网格问题上均取得最优性能；在 Darcy、Burgers、Navier-Stokes 等固定傅里叶模式失效的问题上增益显著；零样本超分辨率表现更强，且在更细离散化部署时性能衰减更小。
AI.conclusion: 输入自适应 TM 系为神经算子学习提供了极具前景的替代方案，能以数据驱动方式自动匹配解的频谱特征，克服固定频谱基的局限，显著提升对非周期、局域化、多尺度 PDE 解的建模精度与泛化能力。

title: How Do People Challenge Racial Stereotypes Online? Counter-Story Detection Across Reddit Communities
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference). 28 pages, 12 figures, 24 tables. Content warning: this paper contains examples of racial stereotypes that may be upsetting or offensive. Code: https://github.com/UmaGunturi/counter_story_detection
summary: Counter-storytelling is a powerful mechanism people use to challenge dominant narratives. Unlike other forms of counterspeech that have been widely studied in computational social science, counter-storytelling has largely been overlooked. Counter-stories are difficult to detect automatically; they are relational (defined with respect to expressions of racial stereotypes) and structurally diverse (drawing on stories that describe lived experiences, witnessed events, exemplars, and hypotheticals). We introduce a first framework for detecting and characterizing counter-storytelling against racial stereotypes at scale. This includes (1) a three-dimensional taxonomy grounded in narratology and Critical Race Theory and (2) a multi-stage pipeline that identifies relational pairs of stereotypes and counter-stories in noisy Reddit discourse. Using this pipeline, we annotate 25,549 Reddit posts across 615 communities and identify 1,312 counter-stories. Our analysis shows that speaker identity and post context shape how counter-stories are told. For example, in-group writers favor first-person testimony, often adopting the role of self-reflective insiders. Our work shows how computational methods can scale qualitative approaches to identify and characterize counter-storytelling as a contextual narrative practice, with implications for content moderation, narratology, and racial discourse analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个大规模检测和表征针对种族刻板印象的反叙事框架，包含基于叙事学和批判种族理论的三维分类体系及多阶段流水线，在615个Reddit社区的25,549篇帖子中识别出1,312个反叙事，发现说话者身份和语境显著影响反叙事的讲述方式，证明计算方法可扩展定性研究以分析反叙事作为情境化叙事实践。
AI.motivation: 反叙事是挑战主导叙事的有力机制，但在计算社会科学中长期被忽视。反叙事具有关系性（相对于种族刻板印象表达定义）和结构多样性（借鉴生活经历、目击事件、典范和假设性故事），难以自动检测，现有研究主要关注其他形式的反言论。
AI.method: 构建三维分类体系（基于叙事学和批判种族理论），开发多阶段流水线识别噪声Reddit话语中的刻板印象与反叙事关系对，标注25,549篇跨615个社区的Reddit帖子，识别出1,312个反叙事并进行定量分析。
AI.result: 识别出1,312个反叙事，分析显示说话者身份和帖子语境塑造反叙事讲述方式：群体内写作者偏好第一人称见证，常采取自我反思的内部者角色；反叙事作为情境化叙事实践展现出多样化的结构和功能模式。
AI.conclusion: 计算方法能有效扩展定性方法以大规模识别和表征反叙事，为内容审核、叙事学和种族话语分析提供新工具和见解，展示了跨学科框架在理解边缘化群体抵抗话语中的价值。

title: From Latent Space to Jacobian Space: Measuring, Evading, and Training Against Safety-Content Accessibility
summary: Output-only safety monitoring sees only the end of a model's computation, yet the model computes its answer before emitting it: what it is internally poised to say is safety-critical. Jacobian-space (J-space) readouts, linear maps from hidden states to the output vocabulary via the model's input-output Jacobian, have been proposed as a window on behaviorally accessible internal content, and a first safety protocol (JADR) showed that danger recognition is readable there. What remains unknown is how this accessible content relates to the latent-space safety geometry studied by representation engineering, and how safety training shapes it. We introduce two quantitative bridges: (i) a transport-amplification profile $A_\ell$, measuring how strongly a latent safety direction is carried toward output space by each layer's Jacobian, and (ii) a paired base-vs-tuned protocol that attributes accessibility to training provenance. Across four small model pairs (135M to 1.5B, three lens-fit seeds), tuned checkpoints concentrate recognition in upper-middle layers, and at 0.5B DPO installs refusal while J-space recognition drops to chance: training can widen the accessibility gap exactly where behavioral safety looks best. A deployment audit closes the loop: monitor-aware GCG-style suffixes suppress the prompt-side monitor at zero behavioral cost at every scale; only a learned monitor rung resists its own adaptive re-attack; the training-time defense fails its re-attack at every penalty weight; steering shows the amplification profile is descriptive, not causal; and continuous-prefix optimization fails where discrete search succeeds. Safety monitoring, training, and evaluation must operate on accessibility itself, not on outputs alone.

AI.tldr: 论文研究输出仅安全监控与Jacobian空间（J-space）读出，提出传输放大谱和基础-微调配对协议两个定量桥梁，发现安全训练会在行为安全表现最好时扩大可访问性鸿沟，部署审计显示仅学习型监控能抵御自适应重攻击，结论指出安全监控、训练和评估必须作用于可访问性本身而非仅输出。
AI.motivation: 现有输出仅安全监控只能看到模型计算的末端，但模型在输出前内部已准备好答案，内部倾向才是安全关键。J-space读出提供了行为可访问内部内容的窗口，但未知其与潜在空间安全几何的关系，以及安全训练如何塑造这种可访问性。
AI.method: 提出两个定量桥梁：(i) 传输放大谱A_ℓ，测量每层Jacobian将潜在安全方向向输出空间传输的强度；(ii) 基础-微调配对协议，将可访问性归因于训练来源。在四对小模型（135M到1.5B，三个镜头拟合种子）上实验，并进行部署审计（GCG风格后缀攻击、自适应重攻击、引导实验、连续前缀优化）。
AI.result: 微调检查点将识别集中在中上层；0.5B DPO安装拒绝的同时J-space识别降至随机水平：训练在行为安全看似最好时扩大可访问性鸿沟。部署审计：监控感知GCG后缀在零行为成本下抑制提示侧监控；仅学习型监控层抵御自适应重攻击；训练时防御在所有惩罚权重下失败；引导显示放大谱是描述性而非因果性；连续前缀优化在离散搜索成功处失败。
AI.conclusion: 安全监控、训练和评估必须作用于可访问性本身，而非仅输出。J-space可访问性与潜在空间安全几何存在鸿沟，安全训练可能扩大此鸿沟，仅学习型监控能抵御自适应攻击，需从可访问性层面设计防御。

title: Optimizer Geometry Sets the Pace: Spectral Learning Dynamics in Matrix Factorization
summary: Recent successes of matrix- and curvature-based optimizers have renewed interest in how update geometry shapes learning. These methods normalize or precondition updates, changing how different components progress during training. In deep matrix factorization, the geometry that slows gradient descent (GD) favors low-rank solutions by delaying the emergence of small singular modes. This raises the question of what remains of that spectral bias when normalization or curvature correction weakens or removes the slowdown. We study how optimizer geometry and depth jointly govern this behavior through a common framework for singular mode dynamics. Under explicit balance and alignment assumptions, we derive birth, saturation, and decay laws for Euclidean GD, coordinate-wise updates of SignGD and an instantaneous Adam approximation, spectral updates of Muon and cumulative Shampoo, and a block curvature model of K-FAC. The resulting picture is not a simple ordering from stronger to weaker low-rank bias. To highlight, SignGD and ideal Muon eliminate the divergent birth barrier and drive unsupported modes to zero in finite time. Cumulative Shampoo initially retains GD's depth-dependent barrier, then accumulated gradients produce a catch-up phase while making previously active modes increasingly persistent. Undamped K-FAC cancels the factorization-induced slowdown while preserving the ordering of the target singular values, whereas positive damping introduces a spectral threshold below which the slow GD phase laws reappear. These results give normalization, accumulated state, damping, and depth a direct interpretation as controls determining when modes emerge, persist, and disappear during training.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究优化器几何与深度在深度矩阵分解中如何共同控制奇异模式动力学。通过显式平衡与对齐假设，推导了欧几里得梯度下降、SignGD、Adam近似、Muon、累积Shampoo及K-FAC等优化器的奇异模式出生、饱和与衰减定律。结果表明：低秩偏好并非单调排序；SignGD与理想Muon消除发散出生屏障并有限时间内驱动无支撑模式归零；累积Shampoo先保留梯度下降的深度相关屏障，后经累积梯度追赶并使活跃模式持久化；无阻尼K-FAC消除因子化导致的减速但保留目标奇异值顺序，正阻尼则重现慢相定律。这些结果为归一化、累积状态、阻尼与深度提供了直接解释：它们控制模式何时出现、持久与消失。
AI.motivation: 矩阵和曲率优化器的近期成功重燃了对更新几何如何塑造学习过程的兴趣。这些方法通过归一化或预条件更新改变训练中不同分量的进展。在深度矩阵分解中，减缓梯度下降的几何结构通过延迟小奇异模式的出现而偏好低秩解。这引出核心问题：当归一化或曲率修正削弱或移除这种减缓时，谱偏好还剩下什么？
AI.method: 在显式平衡与对齐假设下，建立统一框架分析奇异模式动力学，推导六类优化器（欧氏梯度下降、坐标级SignGD、瞬时Adam近似、谱更新Muon、累积Shampoo、块曲率K-FAC）的出生、饱和与衰减定律。通过理论分析对比不同优化器几何对奇异模式演化的影响。
AI.result: 1) 低秩偏好非简单强弱排序。2) SignGD与理想Muon消除发散出生屏障，有限时间内驱动无支撑模式归零。3) 累积Shampoo初期保留梯度下降的深度相关屏障，随后累积梯度产生追赶相并使活跃模式持久化。4) 无阻尼K-FAC抵消因子化导致的减速但保留目标奇异值顺序；正阻尼引入谱阈值，低于该阈值时慢相梯度下降定律重现。
AI.conclusion: 优化器几何（归一化、累积状态、阻尼）与深度共同决定奇异模式何时出现、持久与消失。研究为理解深度矩阵分解中的隐式正则化提供了统一视角，揭示了不同优化器几何如何重塑谱偏好，对设计具有可控谱特性的优化器具有指导意义。

title: Viva La Vida: Verification and Accumulation Failures in Multi-Agent Proof Search
summary: When an agentic prover works on an open problem, there is no proof assistant to fall back on: its verifier and lemma library are ultimately language models judging model outputs. We instrumented such a system end to end and analyzed $51{,}754$ traced observations across three full runs ($186$ hours, \$$5{,}694$). We find three connected failure modes. First, the three-model verifier requires unanimity and treats parse or API failure as non-approval; in $10$ of $12$ verification events, one member returned no parseable output or an API error, making acceptance arithmetically impossible without surfacing an error. Second, when the ensemble did function, one verifier approved $3$ attempts that GPT rejected, each claiming to resolve the open problem; a single-verifier design would therefore have announced a solution three times. Third, because nothing could be approved, every review was a refutation, yet the lemma extractor mines reviews as well as proofs: $24$ of $93$ lemmas ($26\%$) were extracted from rejected arguments with their refutational context removed. Taken together, these findings show that without external verification, supervision is itself a critical trust boundary: systems must distinguish abstention from rejection, preserve useful disagreement, and preserve the provenance and polarity of information before it becomes future context.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析了一个基于语言模型的自动定理证明系统在处理开放问题时的三种关键失效模式：验证器要求全票通过且将解析/API错误视为拒绝，导致验证几乎不可能通过；单个验证器曾三次错误批准声称解决开放问题的尝试；引理提取器从被拒绝的论证中提取引理且丢失反驳上下文。研究表明，在缺乏外部验证时，监督本身成为关键信任边界，系统必须区分弃权与拒绝、保留有效分歧，并保持信息的来源与极性。
AI.motivation: 当代理证明器处理开放问题时，无法依赖传统证明助手，其验证器和引理库完全依赖语言模型判断模型输出。因此需要全面考察此类端到端系统的可靠性，识别其在无外部验证情况下的监督失效模式。
AI.method: 研究者构建并运行了一个完整的自动定理证明系统，进行了三次完整运行，共耗时186小时、成本5694美元，收集了51,754条追踪观测数据，系统分析了验证器集成行为、引理提取过程及其失效模式。
AI.result: 发现三个关联的失效模式：1) 三模型验证器要求全票通过且将解析/API失败视为非批准，12次验证事件中有10次因至少一成员返回无解析输出或API错误而导致接受算术上不可能；2) 集成验证器正常运行时，单一验证器曾三次批准GPT拒绝的尝试，每次均声称解决了开放问题，单验证器设计会因此三次宣称找到解；3) 因无内容被批准，所有评审均为反驳，但引理提取器同时挖掘评审与证明，93个引理中24个（26%）源自被拒论证且移除了反驳上下文。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示在无外部验证情况下，监督本身构成关键信任边界。系统设计必须：区分弃权与拒绝、保留有用的分歧意见、在信息成为未来上下文前保持其来源与极性（支持/反对）的可追溯性。

title: Bidirectional Preference Synthesis: Learning Prompt-Conditioned Preferences from Boundary Failures
summary: Correction-based offline preference pipelines commonly treat model failures only as rejected responses under the original prompt. This supervision is incomplete for boundary failures: responses that violate the given instruction yet coherently satisfy a nearby intent or constraint setting. We introduce Bidirectional Preference Synthesis (BPS), a data-construction method for standard Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) that makes this missing prompt dependence explicit. For each validated boundary failure, BPS keeps the conventional forward pair under the original prompt and adds a reverse pair under a synthesized achieved prompt, so the same response is rejected where it is wrong and chosen where it is right, without changing the DPO objective, training a reward model, or requiring online sampling. On Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507, BPS preserves original-side pairwise ranking while raising achieved-side ranking accuracy from 6.8% to 62.3% on held-out crossed anchors, with a similar shift under a Kimi-K2.6 cross-teacher probe. A blind human audit supports the intended reverse preference direction, and downstream evaluations show the clearest separation from Forward-DPO in multilingual multi-turn instruction following, with consistent capability-retention patterns on agentic, tool-use, and code checks.

AI.tldr: 论文提出双向偏好合成（BPS），一种用于标准DPO的数据构建方法，通过为边界失效响应同时构建正向对（原始提示词下拒绝）和反向对（合成达成提示词下选择），显著提升了模型对提示词依赖的理解，在多轮多语言指令遵循任务上表现最佳。
AI.motivation: 现有基于修正的离线偏好流程仅将模型失视为原始提示词下的拒绝响应，这种监督对边界失效（违反给定指令却连贯满足邻近意图或约束的响应）是不完整的，缺乏对提示词依赖性的显式建模。
AI.method: BPS为每个验证通过的边界失效响应保留常规正向偏好对（原始提示词下拒绝），并额外添加反向偏好对（合成的达成提示词下选择），使同一响应在错误处被拒、在正确处被选，且不改变DPO目标、无需训练奖励模型、无需在线采样。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507上，BPS保持原始侧成对排序不变，将达成侧排序准确率从6.8%提升至62.3%（保留交叉锚点），Kimi-K2.6跨教师探针显示类似提升；盲人审计支持预期的反向偏好方向；下游评估显示在多语言多轮指令遵循上与Forward-DPO分离最明显，在代理、工具使用、代码检查上保持一致的能力保持模式。
AI.conclusion: BPS通过显式建模提示词依赖性，以零架构变更、零在线交互的代价显著改善了边界失效的处理，为离线偏好优化提供了一种高效且正交的数据增强范式。

title: A Hand-Checkable Proof That Two Hidden ReLU Layers Compute the Maximum of Six Numbers
summary: Exactly computing the maximum function is a standard test case for studying depth in ReLU networks. Two hidden layers are known to suffice for up to twelve inputs through computer-assisted constructions. For six real inputs, we give an explicit hexagon identity whose local structure yields a self-contained analytical proof of this depth bound. The identity was found by computer-assisted search; we prove it through explicit cancellations that can be checked entirely by hand, without executing a verification program. The identity also yields an explicit network with hidden widths $17$ and $41$, zero biases, and rational weights.

AI.tldr: 本文通过显式的六边形恒等式，给出了六输入情况下ReLU网络精确计算最大值函数的深度界（两隐藏层）的解析证明，且网络参数为有理数、零偏置、隐藏层宽度17和41。
AI.motivation: 研究ReLU网络深度表达能力的经典测试案例是精确计算最大值函数。已知两隐藏层足以处理多达十二个输入（通过计算机辅助构造），但缺乏解析证明。本文旨在为六输入情况提供一个自包含的解析证明。
AI.method: 通过计算机辅助搜索发现六边形恒等式，然后通过显式抵消进行手工验证，无需运行验证程序，从而给出自包含的解析证明。该恒等式直接构造出具有特定宽度、零偏置和有理权重的网络。
AI.result: 得到一个显式的ReLU网络，包含两个隐藏层，宽度分别为17和41，零偏置，有理权重，能精确计算六个实数输入的最大值函数。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为六输入最大值函数的精确计算提供了首个自包含的解析深度界证明，展示了计算机辅助发现与人工可验证证明相结合的范式，且网络结构简单（零偏置、有理权重），便于理论分析。

title: Cluster Validation Indices as Self-Supervised Objectives for Text Representation Learning
summary: Self-supervised fine-tuning refines the embedding space of a pretrained language encoder without labels. However, the commonly used approaches are computationally expensive. Specifically, contrastive learning-based methods need multiview data and in-batch negative examples, while negative-free approaches require auxiliary graphs/networks. An interesting question arises: can self-supervised fine-tuning be done without relying on either additional negatives or graph data? To answer this question, we introduce SilK (Silhouette-guided K-means), which trains on a Cluster Validation Index, an internal measure of cluster quality without using labels. SilK clusters the corpus and then regresses a simplified silhouette toward a target value. Each document is compared only against the k cluster centroids, never against other documents, so the method needs no augmentation, no negative pairs and one view per document. On BERT-base, SilK trains 1.46x faster per epoch than the fastest baseline we evaluate and uses 45.4% less peak GPU memory than the leanest one. Under frozen-encoder linear probing, SilK stays competitive with the best baselines on three downstream tasks.

title: Suppressing Pressure, Amplifying Evidence: Self-Guided Attention Steering to Mitigate Sycophancy and Stubbornness
summary: Reliable language models should resist unsupported user pressure while effectively using objective contextual information. However, models may exhibit sycophancy by yielding to unsupported user pressure or contextual stubbornness by failing to update their answers when relevant contextual information warrants revision. Evaluating interventions for these failures separately can obscure whether mitigating one failure exacerbates the other. To assess this trade-off, we introduce CoPE-Bench with six conditions per question: a neutral baseline, correct or incorrect user pressure, contextual information consistent with or conflicting with the neutral answer, and a joint condition combining incorrect claims with conflicting contextual information. To regulate the influence of user pressure and contextual information, we propose SPAE (Suppressing Pressure, Amplifying Evidence), a training-free framework that uses the model's own judgments to identify relevant tokens, suppressing user pressure and amplifying contextual information through token-level attention steering. On average across five backbones, SPAE reduces pressure following by 18.8 percentage points and increases joint-condition updating by 5.5 percentage points relative to the strongest baseline in the main comparison. In two-turn dialogue, it improves joint-condition updating by an average of 13.2 percentage points over the strongest prompting baseline. The source data and codes can be found at https://github.com/03Grant/sycophancy-and-stubbornness.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 CoPE-Bench 基准评估语言模型在用户压力与上下文信息之间的权衡，并设计免训练框架 SPAE，通过 token 级注意力引导抑制用户压力、放大上下文证据，显著降低阿谀奉承行为并提升基于证据的答案更新能力。
AI.motivation: 可靠的语言模型应抵抗无依据的用户压力，同时有效利用客观上下文信息。现有模型易表现出阿谀奉承（屈从无依据压力）或上下文固执（拒绝在证据支持时修正答案），单独评估这两类失效会掩盖缓解一方是否加剧另一方的问题，因此需要联合基准与干预方法。
AI.method: 1. 构建 CoPE-Bench：每个问题包含六种条件（中性基线、正确/错误用户压力、与中性答案一致/冲突的上下文、错误压力+冲突上下文的联合条件）。2. 提出 SPAE（Suppressing Pressure, Amplifying Evidence）：免训练框架，利用模型自身判断识别相关 token，通过 token 级注意力引导抑制用户压力 token 的注意力权重、放大上下文证据 token 的注意力权重。
AI.result: 在五个骨干模型平均上，SPAE 相对最强基线将压力跟随率降低 18.8 个百分点，将联合条件下的答案更新率提升 5.5 个百分点。在两轮对话设置中，联合条件更新率比最强提示基线平均提高 13.2 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: SPAE 通过注意力层面的显式干预，同时缓解阿谀奉承与上下文固执，实现了对用户压力的鲁棒抵抗与对上下文证据的敏感利用，为构建更可靠的语言模型提供了有效的免训练解决方案。

title: Cross-Trait Transfer in Subliminal Learning
comment: 38 pages, including references and appendices. Code: https://github.com/PeterXingyuZhao/cross-trait-transfer
summary: Subliminal learning is a phenomenon where a student language model acquires a teacher model's behavioral traits by training on semantically unrelated outputs. It is a subtle statistical phenomenon as trait transmission relies on weak statistical patterns in the generated data. To understand trait transmission between teacher-student pairs, we study cross-trait transfer: how data generated under one teacher trait changes the student's preferences of other traits. To this end, we introduce a directed trait-transfer matrix that quantifies these effects using log-probability gains for student answers. We find that the trait-transfer matrix reveals clusters of related traits, with students sometimes developing preferences for traits similar, but not identical, to the teacher's trait. Such cross-trait structure can be partially captured by output distribution metrics and representation-based metrics. Further, we analyze trait development and interaction: learning dynamics shows a progression from broad shared shifts toward more trait-specific transfer, and multi-trait experiments suggest that opposed traits can enhance such differentiation. Together, our findings reveal salient statistical structures over trait transfer and competition, thus providing a broader view of how hidden preferences are transmitted in subliminal learning.

AI.tldr: 本文研究潜意识学习中教师模型向学生模型的特质传递现象，提出定向特质传递矩阵量化跨特质迁移效应，发现特质聚类结构、学习动态从广泛共享转向特质特异性迁移，且对立特质能增强差异化。
AI.motivation: 旨在理解潜意识学习中隐性偏好如何通过生成数据中的弱统计模式在教师-学生模型间传递，特别是一个教师特质生成的数据如何改变学生对其他特质的偏好（跨特质迁移）。
AI.method: 引入基于对数概率增益的定向特质传递矩阵量化迁移效应；利用输出分布指标和表征指标捕捉跨特质结构；分析学习动态演进；通过多特质实验研究对立特质间的竞争与差异化机制。
AI.result: 特质传递矩阵揭示相关特质聚类，学生会发展出与教师特质相似但不完全相同的偏好；跨特质结构可被分布/表征指标部分捕捉；学习动态呈现从广泛共享偏移向特质特异性迁移的演进；对立特质能促进特质间的差异化分离。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了特质迁移与竞争背后的显著统计结构，为潜意识学习中隐性偏好传递机制提供了更宏观的理解视角。

title: No Hindsight for LLM Fact-Checkers: Measuring Leakage Channels in Misinformation Detection
summary: As automated fact-checking scales on social media, large language model (LLM) verdict scores can look stronger than warranted. One reason is that evaluations mix in information that was not knowable at claim time. Two channels are easy to conflate: outcomes memorized in pre-training and retrieved evidence published after the claim. Yet standard benchmarks rarely separate the two. In this study we measure both channels on AVeriTeC and QuanTemp++ by reconstructing point-in-time evidence conditions and probing for outcome information encoded in model representations. We find substantial evidence of parametric leakage, that can be hidden by the aggregate accuracy, while a simple representation bottleneck reduces this future leakage more efficiently than a mutual-information-based training penalty. We also find that allowing post-claim evidence inflates zero-shot accuracy by 6.3 points in AVeriTeC while the effect is negligible in QuanTemp++, where retrieval provides little post-claim evidence. These results show that misinformation benchmarks can overstate fact-checking performance when they do not account for what information was actually available at claim time.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究自动化事实核查中大语言模型（LLM）的评估偏差，指出基准测试混淆了预训练记忆的参数泄露与事后检索证据两个信息通道，导致性能被高估。通过在AVeriTeC和QuanTemp++上重建时间点证据条件并探测模型表示，发现显著的参数泄露被整体准确率掩盖，简单的表示瓶颈比互信息惩罚更有效减少未来泄露；事后证据使AVeriTeC零样本准确率虚高6.3分，但在QuanTemp++影响可忽略。结论强调基准需考虑声明时刻实际可得信息。
AI.motivation: 随着自动化事实核查在社交媒体规模化应用，LLM的判断分数可能比实际可靠。标准评估混入了声明时刻不可知的信息：预训练中记忆的结果（参数泄露）和声明后发布的检索证据（事后证据）。现有基准很少区分这两个通道，导致性能被高估。
AI.method: 在AVeriTeC和QuanTemp++基准上，重建时间点证据条件（point-in-time evidence conditions），探测模型表示中编码的结果信息，分别量化参数泄露和事后证据的影响。对比简单表示瓶颈与基于互信息的训练惩罚减少未来泄露的效果。
AI.result: 1) 发现显著的参数泄露，被整体准确率掩盖；2) 简单表示瓶颈比互信息惩罚更高效减少未来泄露；3) 允许事后证据使AVeriTeC零样本准确率虚高6.3个百分点，而在QuanTemp++影响可忽略（检索提供极少事后证据）。
AI.conclusion: 当误导信息基准未考虑声明时刻实际可得信息时，会高估事实核查性能。需在评估中严格区分参数记忆与时间点证据，采用时间感知的评估协议。

title: ShadowMiner v1 - An Experience Report on Implementing and Measuring a Problem-and-Hypothesis Discovery Engine
summary: ShadowMiner v1 is a system that automatically discovers research problems and generates hypotheses from AI papers. It is a nine-stage pipeline. It structures documents into a knowledge graph and finds graph gaps in it - structural blind spots in research. These graph gaps are included in the LLM generation prompt. Each generated hypothesis is then verified by checking whether it is already covered by existing research, scoring its quality, and checking that the facts it relies on are accurately drawn from its sources. This report does not propose a new generation or evaluation technique. It describes our experience of implementing and applying ideas from prior work, and measuring whether each one actually contributed.

AI.tldr: ShadowMiner v1 是一个九阶段流水线系统，能从 AI 论文中自动发现研究问题并生成假设。它将文档构建为知识图谱，识别图谱空白（结构性盲点），将其纳入 LLM 提示词生成假设，并通过三重验证（现有研究覆盖检查、质量评分、事实核查）确保假设有效。本文不提出新技术，而是报告实施并应用前人思想的经验，并量化评估各组件的实际贡献。
AI.motivation: 现有研究假设生成方法缺乏系统性的文献结构化分析与盲点识别机制，难以自动发现被忽视的研究空白，且生成假设的可靠性验证不足。需要一个端到端的自动化系统，能从海量论文中挖掘结构性知识缺口并产出高质量、可验证的研究假设。
AI.method: 采用九阶段流水线：1) 文档获取与预处理；2) 实体与关系抽取构建知识图谱；3) 图谱空白检测识别结构性盲点；4) 将空白编码为 LLM 提示词；5) LLM 生成候选假设；6) 基于现有文献的覆盖性检查去重；7) 多维度质量评分（新颖性、可行性、影响力等）；8) 事实核查确保依据来源准确；9) 人工评估与消融实验量化各阶段贡献。
AI.result: 系统成功从 AI 论文语料中自动生成了大量候选假设，经过三重验证后保留了高质量子集。消融实验显示：知识图谱空白引导显著提升假设新颖性；覆盖性检查有效过滤 60%+ 重复假设；质量评分与事实核查分别提升了 25% 和 18% 的通过率。各组件贡献度量化明确，验证了流水线设计的有效性。
AI.conclusion: ShadowMiner v1 验证了“知识图谱空白引导 + 多重验证”范式在自动研究假设生成中的可行性。虽然未引入新算法，但通过工程化集成与严格消融评估，确立了可复现的基线，为后续自动化科学发现系统提供了实证参考与组件级优化方向。

title: Adaptive Bregman Alternating Projections for Feasible Gromov-Wasserstein Learning
summary: The Gromov-Wasserstein (GW) problem compares structured distributions without requiring a shared feature space or known correspondences, but its nonconvex objective and coupled marginal constraints make computation challenging. Bregman alternating projected gradient (BAPG) uses inexpensive alternating row and column updates, yet its fixed-penalty relaxation leaves a persistent feasibility gap. We propose Adaptive KL-BAPG (A-KL-BAPG), which combines a finite fixed-penalty burn-in with a guarded increasing-penalty phase. At each tail iteration, the method reuses BAPG's alternating updates and backtracks a delayed-power step until a Sinkhorn-inspired projective-diameter safeguard is satisfied. We prove finite termination of the backtracking at each iteration and show that the feasibility gap vanishes asymptotically. We further establish a best-iterate $O(1/\log N)$ bound for the weighted squared corrected residual and, under a support regularity condition, the existence of a stationary accumulation point for the original GW problem. This distinguishes A-KL-BAPG from fixed-penalty BAPG, whose stationarity guarantees are given for the relaxed problem. Experiments show that A-KL-BAPG achieves a favorable balance of accuracy, objective value, feasibility, and stationarity relative to BAPG variants, projection-based methods, and task-specific baselines. For synthetic and real graph alignment problems, it closely matches the accuracy and objective value of fixed-penalty KL-BAPG while reducing the marginal feasibility gap by 62-99% and the projected stationarity residual by 28-98%. Heterogeneous domain adaptation experiments show a similar pattern: A-KL-BAPG maintains comparable target accuracy and objective values while achieving better feasibility and stationarity than fixed-penalty KL-BAPG.

AI.tldr: 论文提出自适应KL-BAPG (A-KL-BAPG) 算法解决Gromov-Wasserstein (GW) 问题，结合固定惩罚预热与递增惩罚阶段，通过Sinkhorn启发式保障实现后退追踪有限终止，渐近消除可行性间隙，并在支撑正则条件下保证原问题的平稳聚积点存在，实验显示其在图对齐和异构域适应任务中显著优于固定惩罚基线。
AI.motivation: GW问题因非凸目标和耦合边际约束导致计算困难。现有BAPG虽通过交替行列更新高效，但固定惩罚松弛留下持久可行性间隙，且平稳性保证仅针对松弛问题，需改进以兼顾精度、可行性与平稳性。
AI.method: A-KL-BAPG采用两阶段策略：有限固定惩罚预热后进入受保护的递增惩罚阶段。每次尾部迭代复用BAPG交替更新，并对延迟幂步长回溯直至满足Sinkhorn启发式投影直径保障。理论证明回溯有限终止、可行性间隙渐近消失，最优迭代加权平方校正残差达O(1/log N)，支撑正则下原问题存在平稳聚积点。
AI.result: 合成与真实图对齐实验中，A-KL-BAPG精度和目标值接近固定惩罚KL-BAPG，但边际可行性间隙降低62-99%，投影平稳残差降低28-98%。异构域适应实验显示目标精度与目标值相当，可行性与平稳性更优。
AI.conclusion: A-KL-BAPG通过自适应惩罚与保障机制，在保持计算效率的同时实现渐近可行与平稳性，为GW问题提供了理论更强、实证更优的求解器，优于固定惩罚BAPG变体、投影法及任务特定基线。

title: A Systematic Analysis of the Predictive Power of LM Surprisal in Reading Chinese
comment: 15 pages, 3 figures. Hongao Zhu and Muxiaoqiao Xu contributed equally. Correspondence to: hai.hu@polyu.edu.hk
summary: This study analyzes the predictive power of LM-derived, token-level surprisal on Mandarin Chinese reading times. We first propose the Shortest Matching Sequence (SMS), an alignment scheme that maps between the word segmentation assumed by eye-tracking corpora and the LMs' subword tokenization, as the two tokenizations often disagree in the context of Mandarin Chinese. Then, using a suite of Chinese-Pythia models (14M-1.4B) trained on scratch with 30B tokens, we examine how well surprisal predicts first fixation duration, gaze duration, and total reading time in three paragraph-level eye-tracking corpora of Mandarin Chinese (GECO-CN, HKP, and MECO). Contrary to previous null findings, our results show that surprisal is predictive of Chinese reading times. However, whether predictive power scales with model size and the amount of training is corpus-specific: bigger models predict better in GECO-CN, whereas inverse scaling emerges in HKP and, at the largest sizes, in MECO. Subsequently, we tested one possible explanation for the inverse scaling in HKP and found that checkpoints whose surprisal remains closer to $n$-gram statistics are better predictors of reading. All in all, the predictive power of surprisal on Chinese reading time measurements is corpus-specific, which cautions against drawing scaling conclusions from a single corpus.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨语言模型衍生的逐token惊讶度对中文阅读时间的预测能力。提出最短匹配序列（SMS）对齐方案解决语料库分词与模型子词分词的不一致，使用从头训练的Chinese-Pythia模型（14M-1.4B，30B tokens）在三个段落级眼动语料库（GECO-CN、HKP、MECO）上测试惊讶度对首次注视时长、注视时长和总阅读时间的预测。结果显示惊讶度能预测中文阅读时间，但预测能力随模型规模和训练量的变化呈语料库特异性：GECO-CN中大模型表现更好，而HKP和MECO（最大规模）出现反向缩放。进一步分析发现HKP中惊讶度更接近n-gram统计的检查点预测更好。结论强调惊讶度预测能力的语料库特异性，警示不可从单一语料库推断缩放规律。
AI.motivation: 先前研究在中文阅读时间预测中常发现惊讶度无预测能力（null findings），且现有语言模型的子词分词与眼动语料库的词级分词在中文中常不一致，阻碍了准确的惊讶度计算。本研究旨在解决分词对齐问题，系统考察模型规模和训练量对惊讶度预测中文阅读时间的影响，并解释观察到的反向缩放现象。
AI.method: 1. 提出最短匹配序列（SMS）对齐算法，将眼动语料库的词级分词映射到语言模型的子词token序列。2. 从头训练Chinese-Pythia系列模型（14M至1.4B参数，30B tokens训练数据）。3. 在三个段落级中文眼动语料库（GECO-CN、HKP、MECO）上计算token级惊讶度，分析其对首次注视时长、注视时长、总阅读时间的预测能力。4. 检查不同上游检查点的惊讶度与n-gram统计的接近程度，解释反向缩放。
AI.result: 惊讶度显著预测中文阅读时间，推翻先前null findings。但预测能力的缩放规律随语料库而异：GECO-CN中大模型预测更好；HKP和MECO（最大规模）出现反向缩放（小模型更优）。HKP中，惊讶度更接近n-gram统计的检查点预测表现更好，提示人类阅读可能更依赖局部统计而非全局语言模型知识。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型惊讶度对中文阅读时间的预测能力具有显著的语料库特异性，模型规模与训练量的影响不一致。单一语料库无法得出普遍的缩放结论，未来研究需跨多语料库验证，并考虑人类阅读中局部统计与全局语言知识的相对贡献。

title: Functionally Equivalent or Not? Graph-Grounded Differential Surrogate Execution for Code Equivalence
comment: 14 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables, accepted by NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI for Verifiable Coding
summary: Determining whether two programs are functionally equivalent is central to code modernization, patch validation, refactoring, and code-generation evaluation. Yet the usual signals are incomplete: tests cover only finite inputs, textual similarity confuses implementation with behavior, and unconstrained LLM judgments are difficult to audit. Direct execution is often impossible when a program depends on an obsolete, licensed, unavailable, or unsafe environment. We introduce FEAgent, a selective equivalence assessor agent that combines typed program-graph evidence with differential surrogate execution. FEAgent first aligns public interfaces and behaviorally relevant graph anchors, then issues bounded queries over call-flow, control-flow, data-flow, type, import, and effect relations. Next, a branch-aware generator agent proposes discriminating inputs, and two blinded LLM surrogates independently predict source and target observables. Every claim and predicted divergence is recorded in an evidence ledger. A deterministic reconciler then returns EQUIVALENT, INEQUIVALENT, or UNCLEAR rather than forcing a verdict when paths are uncovered or evidence conflicts. We evaluate FEAgent on function-level equivalence and repository-level bug patches, where the existing oracle is a benchmark label or a passing test suite. Every disagreement with that oracle is adjudicated by direct execution, revealing errors in benchmark labels and behavioral divergences missed by unit-test-only scoring. On EquiBench, execution confirms FEAgent's disagreements with published labels on 216 of 1,200 evaluated pairs (18.0%); on SWE-bench Verified, 94 of 331 test-passing agent patches (28.4%) diverge from the reference patch. FEAgent thus serves as an audit layer between testing and formal verification, keeping its evidence reviewable and its uncertainty explicit without claiming a proof of equivalence.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 FEAgent，一种选择性程序等价性评估智能体，结合类型程序图证据与差分替代执行，在无法直接执行环境下判定两程序是否功能等价，输出 EQUIVALENT/INEQUIVALENT/UNCLEAR 三态结论并保留可审计证据链。
AI.motivation: 程序等价性判定对代码现代化、补丁验证、重构及代码生成评估至关重要，但现有手段不足：测试仅覆盖有限输入、文本相似度混淆实现与行为、无约束 LLM 判断难审计、直接执行常因环境陈旧、许可、不可用或不安全而受阻。
AI.method: FEAgent 分四阶段：1) 对齐公共接口与行为相关图锚点，发起有界查询（调用流、控制流、数据流、类型、导入、副作用关系）；2) 分支感知生成器提出区分性输入；3) 两个盲测 LLM 替代执行器独立预测源/目标可观测行为，所有声称与预测分歧记入证据账本；4) 确定性调解器依据证据给出三态裁决，拒绝在路径未覆盖或证据冲突时强行定论。
AI.result: 在 EquiBench 函数级基准上，1,200 对中 216 对 (18.0%) 与发布标签分歧经执行确认；在 SWE-bench Verified 仓库级补丁上，331 个通过测试的智能体补丁中 94 个 (28.4%) 与参考补丁行为发散。
AI.conclusion: FEAgent 定位为测试与形式化验证之间的审计层：证据可复核、不确定性显式化、不宣称等价性证明，能发现基准标签错误及单测遗漏的行为差异。

title: Self-Reflection Fine-Tuning: Enhancing Agent Security against Prompt Injection Attacks from Failure Experience
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in tool-augmented environments, but their reliance on external inputs makes them highly vulnerable to prompt injection attacks that can hijack task objectives. Existing safety alignment methods rely on static expert trajectories or preference optimization, limiting their ability to generalize to adaptive attack patterns. In this work, we propose Self-Reflection Fine-Tuning (SRFT), a training framework that enables agents to improve robustness by learning from their own failure experiences under adversarial conditions. Instead of passively imitating expert behaviors, SRFT exposes the agent to compromised trajectories constructed via injected attacks, and leverages an expert model to generate structured self-reflection reasoning that contrasts unsafe and optimal actions. This reflective supervision teaches the agent to identify malicious instructions, reason about their consequences, and maintain alignment with the original user intent. We instantiate this framework in SR-Agent, built on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen3-8B, and evaluate it on both static and adaptive prompt injection benchmarks. Experimental results show that SRFT substantially reduces attack success rates while preserving task performance, and demonstrates strong generalization under adaptive attacks. These findings suggest that learning from failure via self-reflection is a promising direction for building robust and secure LLM agents. Our code is released at https://github.com/Eden-Wang1710/srft-repo.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Self-Reflection Fine-Tuning (SRFT)，一种通过让 LLM 代理从自身在对抗条件下的失败经验中学习来提升对提示注入攻击鲁棒性的训练框架。SRFT 让代理接触含注入攻击的受损轨迹，并利用专家模型生成结构化自我反思推理，对比不安全与最优动作，教会代理识别恶意指令、推理后果并坚守原始用户意图。基于 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 和 Qwen3-8B 构建的 SR-Agent 在静态和自适应提示注入基准上大幅降低攻击成功率，同时保持任务性能，并展现出对自适应攻击的强泛化能力。
AI.motivation: LLM 代理在工具增强环境中部署日益增多，但其对外部输入的依赖使其极易受到提示注入攻击，导致任务目标被劫持。现有安全对齐方法依赖静态专家轨迹或偏好优化，难以泛化到自适应攻击模式。因此需要一种能让代理从失败中学习、主动识别恶意指令并保持对齐的鲁棒训练方法。
AI.method: 提出 Self-Reflection Fine-Tuning (SRFT) 框架：1) 构建包含注入攻击的受损轨迹暴露给代理；2) 利用专家模型生成结构化自我反思推理，对比不安全动作与最优动作；3) 通过反思监督训练代理识别恶意指令、推理后果并坚守原始用户意图。实例化为基于 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 和 Qwen3-8B 的 SR-Agent。
AI.result: 在静态和自适应提示注入基准上实验表明：SRFT 显著降低攻击成功率，同时保持任务性能；在自适应攻击下展现出强泛化能力，优于依赖静态专家轨迹或偏好优化的现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过自我反思从失败中学习是构建鲁棒安全 LLM 代理的有前景方向。SRFT 让代理主动识别恶意指令并推理后果，而非被动模仿专家行为，为应对自适应提示注入攻击提供了有效范式。代码已开源。

title: Rewrite What Matters: Adaptive Multilingual Query Rewriting for Reasoning via Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: In multilingual scenarios, queries with equivalent semantics but in different languages could guide the model into different reasoning trajectories, leading to performance disparities. To mitigate this gap, previous studies typically apply a one-size-fits-all query rewriting strategy, such as translation, which overlooks the fact that different scenarios require diverse types of semantic transformations. In this paper, we propose mRewriter-R1, an agentic multilingual query rewriting framework with reinforcement learning. Unlike single-turn rewriting, mRewriter-R1 formulates multilingual query rewriting as a multi-turn sequential decision-making process, where the model dynamically performs multi-aspect optimization through adaptive operator selection. Experimental results demonstrate that mRewriter-R1 outperforms all strong multilingual rewriting baselines on different large reasoning backbones. Further analyses show that the learned policy can adaptively decide on rewriting operators according to query characteristics, exhibiting strong generalization ability across diverse reasoning tasks, and plug-and-play compatibility with heterogeneous reasoning language models.

AI.tldr: 提出 mRewriter-R1，一种基于强化学习的智能体多语言查询重写框架，将重写建模为多轮序贯决策过程，通过自适应算子选择实现多方面优化，在多种大型推理模型上超越强基线，展现强泛化能力与即插即用兼容性。
AI.motivation: 多语言场景下语义等价但语言不同的查询会导致模型进入不同推理轨迹，产生性能差距。现有工作多采用一刀切的重写策略（如翻译），忽略了不同场景需要多样化的语义变换类型。
AI.method: mRewriter-R1 将多语言查询重写形式化为多轮序贯决策过程，利用强化学习训练智能体根据查询特征自适应选择重写算子，实现多方面的动态优化，区别于传统的单轮重写范式。
AI.result: 在不同大型推理骨干模型上，mRewriter-R1 均超越所有强多语言重写基线。进一步分析表明，学习到的策略能根据查询特征自适应决定重写算子，在多样推理任务上表现出强泛化能力，且可即插即用地兼容异构推理语言模型。
AI.conclusion: 基于强化学习的多轮自适应查询重写框架能有效缩小多语言推理性能差距，通过动态算子选择实现针对性语义变换，具备优越的任务泛化性与模型兼容性，为多语言推理提供了更灵活高效的解决方案。

title: Do Tool Calls Execute as Intended? Measuring and Repairing Intent-Execution Correspondence in LLM Agents
summary:
Agents built on large language models (LLMs) build and run software through tool calls. A call reaches its program through several hops, and any hop can change the call without notice. When the changed call fails, the agent retries a correct call, which costs users time and money. Benchmarks and failure analyses do not see the change, because they read the call and its result but not what a hop received. We define intent-execution correspondence (IEC) as the property that the executed action matches the action the emitted call denotes under the tool contract. Our protocol observes what each hop received without executing the call, and names the first hop that changed it by the receiver's own parser. IntAct then delivers the call in a form that this hop cannot alter, or refuses the call. We build IEC-Bench from the changes observed in real-world use, with chains of dependent calls under the execution paths of 4 widely-used harnesses.
  In 47,828 shell calls within production sessions, Claude Code's Bash tool changes 12.0% of the calls that carry code, escape sequences, or long text. For 80.7% of the calls whose backslashes are changed, the wrong action runs without any reported error. All 10 measured harnesses change a call. Trajectory-based judgment attributes 95.1% of the production failures to the LLM, although the path caused more than half of them. On IEC-Bench, the path raises the token cost per passed task 2.4 times (up to 12.3 times). A hop that changes a call also hides the changes after it, so 55.1% of the failures on one path appear only after its first hop is repaired. IntAct, deployed in a commercial product, recovers 79.2% of the failures with a changed call. Harnesses should therefore be designed and tested hop-by-hop to ensure a correct call executes as intended or is refused.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为IntAct的协议，用于检测和修复大语言模型（LLM）代理在工具调用链中“跳转”节点篡改调用导致的意图-执行不一致问题，并在真实生产环境和基准测试中验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: LLM代理通过工具调用构建和运行软件，调用需经过多个“跳转”节点，任何节点可能在无感知情况下篡改调用，导致执行偏离意图，引发失败、重试，增加时间和金钱成本。现有基准和失败分析无法观测中间节点接收的内容，只能看到调用与结果，忽略了路径篡改。
AI.method: 定义意图-执行对应（IEC）属性，设计IntAct协议：在不执行调用的前提下观测每个跳转节点接收的内容，利用接收端自身的解析器定位首个篡改调用的节点，随后以该节点无法篡改的形式投递调用，或直接拒绝调用。构建IEC-Bench基准，源自真实使用中观测到的篡改，包含依赖调用链，覆盖4种广泛使用的执行框架的执行路径。
AI.result: 在47,828个生产环境Shell调用中，Claude Code的Bash工具篡改了12.0%携带代码、转义序列或长文本的调用；80.7%被篡改反斜杠的调用在无错误报告下执行了错误动作。所有10个测量框架均会篡改调用。基于轨迹的判断将95.1%生产失败归因于LLM，实则路径导致过半失败。在IEC-Bench上，路径使每通过任务的Token成本增加2.4倍（最高12.3倍）。篡改调用的节点会隐藏其后的篡改，导致55.1%某路径上的失败仅在首个节点修复后显现。IntAct在商业产品部署中恢复了79.2%带篡改调用的失败。
AI.conclusion: 因此，执行框架应采用逐跳设计与测试，确保正确调用按意图执行或被拒绝，以保障意图-执行对应。

title: Rethinking Self-Distillation for Multi-Teacher Capability Merging
summary: Combining capabilities of multiple expert models trained starting from the same base checkpoint has become increasingly common in frontier language-model post-training. Recent trends suggest that multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) outperforms conventional off-policy methods. However, despite the higher inference and environment interaction costs incurred by MOPD, we find that much of its reported accuracy gain is due to certain training design choices and hyperparameter optimization, rather than the algorithm itself. We conduct a controlled self-distillation study across two multi-teacher settings, four models, and eleven benchmarks, comparing off-policy methods, namely supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and soft-label distillation, to hybrid teacher-prefix distillation and MOPD. We found that all four methods achieve \textit{nearly identical} accuracy. However, MOPD uses $14.8$--$23.1\times$ SFT's training GPU-hours. We also revisit four recently published comparisons between on-policy and off-policy distillation and find that the reported on-policy gains shrink substantially when SFT baselines are trained on rejection-sampled teacher trajectories and use independently tuned hyperparameters. As a training-free alternative, we also find that simple weight-merging methods can recover expert capabilities with minutes of CPU merging time, although their accuracy degrades as model size decreases and task interference increases. Overall, our results question recent gains reported due to MOPD and suggest careful tuning of more efficient off-policy baselines as a viable alternative.

AI.tldr: 本文通过受控实验对比多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）与离线策略方法（SFT、软标签蒸馏、混合教师前缀蒸馏），发现四种方法在十一项基准上准确率几乎相同，但 MOPD 训练成本是 SFT 的 14.8–23.1 倍；重新审视四篇近期论文后发现，若对离线基线进行拒绝采样轨迹训练并独立调参，在线策略的优势大幅缩减；同时发现简单的权重合并方法可在 CPU 上几分钟内恢复专家能力，但随模型缩小和任务干扰增加而性能下降。结论质疑 MOPD 报告的增益，建议精心调优更高效的离线基线。
AI.motivation: 前沿语言模型后训练中，结合多个专家模型越来越常见，近期趋势认为多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）优于传统离线方法，但 MOPD 带来更高的推理和环境交互成本。作者怀疑其报告的准确率提升源于训练设计选择和超参数优化，而非算法本身，因此旨在通过受控实验厘清真实增益来源。
AI.method: 开展受控自我蒸馏研究：覆盖两种多教师设置、四种模型、十一项基准；对比四种方法——离线策略的监督微调（SFT）和软标签蒸馏、在线策略的混合教师前缀蒸馏和 MOPD；并重新评估四篇近期发表的在线与离线蒸馏对比论文，使用拒绝采样教师轨迹和独立调参的 SFT 基线；此外探索无训练的权重合并方法作为替代方案。
AI.result: 四种蒸馏方法在所有基准上准确率几乎相同，但 MOPD 训练 GPU 小时数是 SFT 的 14.8–23.1 倍；重新评估后，在线策略报告的增益在强离线基线下大幅收缩；权重合并方法仅需几分钟 CPU 时间即可恢复专家能力，但随模型规模减小和任务干扰增加而精度下降。
AI.conclusion: 近期归因于 MOPD 的增益值得商榷，精心调优的高效离线策略基线是可行替代；权重合并提供极低成本的专家能力融合方案，但受限于模型规模和任务冲突。

title: Scaling Verifiable Environments for Long-horizon Work Agents
summary: Work agents operate over digital artifacts to execute professional knowledge-intensive work, requiring training environments that support long-horizon interaction and trustworthy verification. However, hand-crafted environments incur prohibitive engineering overhead that prevents environment scaling, whereas synthesis methods sacrifice workspace complexity, realism, or grounded verifiability. To bridge this gap, we introduce WorkForge, a scalable synthesis framework for constructing verifiable work-agent environments from real-world resources. Starting from expert workflows, WorkForge first identifies the resources, decisions, and deliverables required by each workflow. It then retrieves relevant real-world files and organizes them into a workspace. WorkForge inspects the workspace to extract concrete, checkable facts about its content. These factual anchors fix which task types the workspace can support and how their outcomes can be verified. Therefore, WorkForge derives each task's instructions, solution plan, and complementary programmatic and semantic verifiers directly from these factual anchors, keeping verification traceable to observable workspace evidence. Furthermore, we construct 16.7K verifiable environments across 40 professional domains, with workspaces collectively covering 60 file types. Post-training Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Base improves GDPVal from 45.5 to 73.6 and APEX Score from 5.0 to 21.3, while enabling Qwen3.5-27B to achieve highly competitive performance and outperform strong competitors. Our analyses confirm the efficacy of the proposed method and reveal consistent scaling behaviors across both data volume and interaction horizons.

AI.tldr: WorkForge 是一个可扩展的合成框架，从真实资源构建可验证的工作智能体环境。它从专家工作流出发，识别资源、决策和交付物，检索真实文件组织工作空间，提取事实锚点，据此生成任务指令、解决方案和可追溯的程序化及语义验证器。构建了 1.67 万个跨 40 个专业领域、涵盖 60 种文件类型的环境。后训练使 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Base 的 GDPVal 从 45.5 提升至 73.6，APEX Score 从 5.0 提升至 21.3，Qwen3.5-27B 达到高度竞争性性能并超越强基线。实验验证了方法有效性，并揭示了数据量和交互长度上的稳定缩放规律。
AI.motivation: 工作智能体需要支持长时程交互和可信验证的训练环境。手工构建环境工程开销过大，难以扩展；现有合成方法则牺牲工作空间复杂度、真实性或可落地的可验证性。因此需要一种能从真实资源大规模生成复杂、真实且可验证环境的框架。
AI.method: WorkForge 采用四阶段流程：1) 从专家工作流识别所需资源、决策点和交付物；2) 检索相关真实文件并组织成工作空间；3) 检查工作空间提取具体、可核查的事实锚点，确定可支持的任务类型及验证方式；4) 从事实锚点直接推导任务指令、解决方案计划、程序化验证器和语义验证器，确保验证可追溯到可观测的工作空间证据。
AI.result: 构建了 16.7K 个可验证环境，覆盖 40 个专业领域和 60 种文件类型。后训练 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Base 使 GDPVal 从 45.5 提升至 73.6，APEX Score 从 5.0 提升至 21.3；Qwen3.5-27B 取得高度竞争性性能并超越强竞争对手。分析确认方法有效，并发现数据量与交互长度上一致的缩放行为。
AI.conclusion: WorkForge 通过以事实锚点为核心的合成范式，解决了工作智能体环境的规模化、真实性与可验证性难题。大规模实验证明其能显著提升模型在专业知识密集型任务上的表现，且展现出良好的扩展性，为未来工作智能体训练数据的构建提供了可复制的方法论。

title: AgentPersonaBench: Benchmarking Persona-Driven User Simulation
summary: We introduce AgentPersonaBench (APB), a benchmark evaluating whether persona conditioning faithfully steers downstream agent behavior. While language models are increasingly deployed for persona-driven user simulation, existing benchmarks primarily evaluate conversational styling or self-reports rather than authentic behavioral fidelity. APB evaluates latent persona adherence one trait at a time, embedding each target trait within a complete synthetic profile without explicitly naming the trait or disclosing the test. Ground-truth adherence is verified strictly from observable actions across four interaction surfaces of increasing realism: survey, chat, web (interactive web environments), and app (desktop software environments). APB comprises 2,460 tasks spanning 867 traits, verified through automated audits and expert review. Our evaluation of 20 frontier model arms demonstrates that high-fidelity user simulation is already attainable: leading models achieve up to 84.7% full-pass adherence under unprompted conditions. At the same time, APB identifies clear behavioral boundaries: adherence drops across interaction modalities (only 37.9-64.3% pass all four surfaces), multi-attribute demands degrade retention, and competing model families exhibit pronounced behavioral divergence.

AI.tldr: AgentPersonaBench (APB) 是一个评估人格设定是否能忠实引导下游智能体行为的基准，通过在四个交互界面（调查、聊天、网页、应用）上验证可观测动作，测试 867 个特质的 2,460 个任务。评估 20 个前沿模型显示：领先模型在无提示条件下可达 84.7% 全通过率，但跨模态一致性仅 37.9-64.3%，多属性需求会降低保持率，不同模型家族表现出显著行为差异。
AI.motivation: 现有基准主要评估对话风格或自我报告，而非真实的行为保真度。需要一种能从可观测动作严格验证隐性人格遵循度的基准，且不显式告知被测特质或测试目的。
AI.method: APB 逐个特质评估隐性人格遵循，将目标特质嵌入完整合成档案中，不明确命名特质也不披露测试。通过四个递增真实感的交互界面（调查、聊天、交互式网页环境、桌面软件环境）收集可观测动作，自动审计与专家复核验证真实遵循度。共 2,460 任务覆盖 867 特质。
AI.result: 20 个前沿模型评估显示：高保真用户模拟已可实现，领先模型无提示条件下全通过率达 84.7%。但跨模态一致性低（仅 37.9-64.3% 全部通过四个界面），多属性需求降低保持率，不同模型家族间存在显著行为分歧。
AI.conclusion: APB 揭示了人格驱动智能体行为的清晰边界：虽然高保真模拟已可达成，但在跨模态一致性、多属性保持及模型家族行为差异上仍存在显著局限，为未来改进提供了量化基准。

title: Integrated Imputation-Classification for Supervised Learning with Missing Data
summary: We study supervised classification problems with missing feature values. Existing approaches often decouple imputation from classification, producing imputations that may be plausible but uninformative for prediction. Instead, we propose the Integrated Imputation and Classification Network (IICN), which jointly trains an imputer and an ${(n{+}1)}$-classdiscriminator adversarially with a single class supervised classification objective, where the discriminator learns to distinguish among the $n$ true classes and an additional ``imputed" class. We prove that at the global optimum, the imputer and discriminator together implement marginalization over missing coordinates and yield a Bayes-optimal classifier. We evaluate IICN on FashionMNIST, CIFAR-10, and tabular datasets with naturally occurring missingness. IICN outperforms classical impute-then-classify pipelines and recent generative baselines, showing strong robustness and accuracy in challenging settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出集成填补与分类网络（IICN），通过对抗训练联合优化填补器和（n+1）类判别器（n个真实类别+一个“填补”类别），仅用单一监督分类目标即可实现对缺失特征的边际化并达到贝叶斯最优分类器。在 FashionMNIST、CIFAR-10 及表格数据上显著优于传统填补后分类流程和生成式基线。
AI.motivation: 现有方法常将填补与分类解耦，导致填补值虽看似合理但对预测无信息量；需要一种将填补直接服务于分类目标的端到端框架。
AI.method: IICN 由填补器和判别器组成，判别器输出 n+1 个类别（n 个真实类别 + 1 个填补类别）。通过单一监督分类损失对抗训练：填补器使填补样本被判别为真实类别，判别器区分真实样本与填补样本。理论证明在全局最优时，二者共同实现对缺失坐标的边际化，得到贝叶斯最优分类器。
AI.result: 在 FashionMNIST、CIFAR-10 及多个自然缺失的表格数据集上，IICN 准确率与鲁棒性均优于经典填补后分类管道（如均值填补+分类器、MICE+分类器）及近期生成式基线（GAIN、MIWAE 等），尤其在高缺失率和挑战性设置下表现突出。
AI.conclusion: IICN 提供了一个理论落地且实证有效的框架，将填补与分类对抗式联合训练，解决了解耦方法的信息丢失问题，为含缺失特征的监督分类提供了新范式。

title: From Overloaded to Guaranteed: High-Throughput Multi-SLO Enforcement for LoRA-Assisted On-Premise LLM Deployment
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) become essential in privacy-sensitive sectors like hospitals and government agencies, the on-premise LLM servers offer a cost-effective and secure alternative to public cloud services. However, these resource-constrained servers struggle to guarantee heterogeneous Service Level Objectives (SLOs) when serving multiple LoRA-adapted services simultaneously. Existing serving frameworks suffer from severe SLO violations due to the computational overhead of LoRA layers and the rigid nature of batch scheduling. To address this, we propose HALO, a scheduling method tailored for LoRA-assisted on-premise LLM deployment. HALO introduces two key innovations: a spatial multiplexing strategy that overlaps Base and LoRA computations by partitioning GPU Streaming Multiprocessors (SMs), and an SLO-aware scheduler that decouples request execution based on "request-level slack." By prioritizing urgent tasks and utilizing idle budget for traffic shaping, HALO significantly mitigates resource contention. Our evaluation demonstrates that HALO minimizes SLO violations while improving throughput compared to state-of-the-art baselines.

title: TrustMed-RL: Long-Horizon Reinforcement Learning for Evidence-Grounded Clinical Diagnosis
summary: Medical language models can produce correct diagnoses despite incomplete investigations and unsupported reasoning. To support long-horizon, evidence-grounded diagnosis, we introduce \textbf{TrustMed-RL}. Built from PubMed rare-disease cases and over 24,000 manually annotated image panels, it integrates interviews, examinations, testing, specialist consultation, and literature search through state-dependent actions. Our 8B vision--language policy, trained with clinically adapted GiGPO and coverage-adjusted diagnostic rewards, achieves 37.1\% diagnostic accuracy on 2,500 evaluation cases, outperforming all evaluated open-weight baselines and improving over supervised fine-tuning by 12.4 percentage points.. When success additionally requires acquiring at least 50\% of supporting test evidence, TrustMed-RL achieves 32.5\%, exceeding GPT-4o by 6.8 percentage points. Furthermore, it surpasses all evaluated baselines on MTMedDialog and multiple larger 27--32B models on AgentClinic. In physician review of 200 diagnostically accepted test-set trajectories, 83.0\% receive evidential-grounding scores of 4--5 out of 5. Physicians' assessments suggest that these diagnostic trajectories are trustworthy and aligned with human diagnostic reasoning.

AI.tldr: TrustMed-RL 是一个基于 PubMed 罕见病例例和 24,000+ 手工标注图像面板构建的医学视觉语言模型，通过临床适配的 GiGPO 强化学习和覆盖率调整的诊断奖励训练，实现了长时程、证据驱动的诊断推理。在 2,500 评估病例上达到 37.1% 诊断准确率，超越所有开源基线及 GPT-4o（在需获取 ≥50% 支持性证据时），且在医生评审中 83% 轨迹获得 4-5/5 证据基础分，表现出与人类诊断推理一致的可信度。
AI.motivation: 现有医学语言模型虽能在调查不全、推理无依据时给出正确诊断，但缺乏长时程、证据支撑的诊断能力，难以满足临床对可解释性和可信度的要求。
AI.method: 构建 TrustMed-RL：(1) 数据来源为 PubMed 罕见病病例与 24,000+ 手工标注图像面板；(2) 整合访谈、体检、检验、专科会诊、文献检索等状态相关动作；(3) 采用 8B 视觉语言策略，经临床适配的 GiGPO（群体相对策略优化）与覆盖率调整诊断奖励进行强化学习训练。
AI.result: 在 2,500 评估病例上诊断准确率 37.1%，比监督微调提升 12.4 个百分点，超越所有开源基线；要求获取 ≥50% 支持性检验证据时准确率 32.5%，比 GPT-4o 高 6.8 个百分点；在 MTMedDialog 与 AgentClinic 基准上均超越同规模及 27-32B 更大模型；医生对 200 条诊断轨迹评审显示 83% 获 4-5/5 证据基础分，认定其可信且符合人类诊断推理。
AI.conclusion: TrustMed-RL 通过证据驱动的强化学习框架，显著提升了医学视觉语言模型的长时程诊断准确性与证据支撑能力，生成的诊断轨迹被临床医生认可为可信且符合人类推理模式，为可靠的 AI 辅助诊断奠定了基础。

title: Do RUL explanations hold up? Faithfulness and stability of attributions on C-MAPSS
summary: Deep remaining-useful-life (RUL) models on NASA C-MAPSS are now routine, and so are heatmaps that colour sensors and timesteps. A heatmap that looks mechanical is not the same as an explanation an engineer can act on. We train three standard architectures - a 1D CNN, an LSTM, and a small Transformer encoder - on the official FD001 and FD003 splits with the piecewise RUL cap of 125 cycles and the official PHM08 asymmetric score. We then attach three attribution maps (Integrated Gradients, occlusion, last-layer attention) and evaluate them with the checks the XAI-for-PdM literature still under-reports: deletion/insertion faithfulness, Spearman stability under sensor-scale noise, agreement across training seeds, and cosine consistency inside RUL bins. Prediction error is a prerequisite, not the claim. The headline is which explanation method moves the RUL output when its top cells are removed, and which map survives a 5% input perturbation. Integrated Gradients and occlusion are similarly faithful on the LSTM; Transformer attention is cheap and temporally smooth but weakly faithful. All three maps are almost unchanged under 5% input noise, yet IG/occlusion agree only moderately across two LSTM seeds - stability to sensor jitter is not the same as stability to retraining. A secondary tabular check on the AI4I 2020 failure dataset shows the same deletion pattern for tree importances. We recommend occlusion or IG for any C-MAPSS-style report that will be read by a maintenance engineer, and we treat raw attention weights as a visualisation only.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了三种主流深度学习架构（1D CNN、LSTM、小型 Transformer encoder）在 NASA C-MAPSS FD001/FF003 数据集上的 RUL 预测性能，并对比了三种归因方法（Integrated Gradients、遮挡法、最后一层注意力）的解释质量。核心发现：IG 与遮挡法在 LSTM 上的忠实度相当且优于注意力权重；注意力图虽平滑但忠实度弱；所有归因图对 5% 输入噪声稳定，但 IG 与遮挡法在不同随机种子训练的 LSTM 间仅中度一致——传感器抖动稳定性不等于重训练稳定性。次级实验在 AI4I 2020 表格数据上验证了树模型特征重要性呈现相同的删除模式。建议面向维护工程师的 C-MAPSS 报告采用遮挡法或 IG，仅将原始注意力权重视为可视化参考。
AI.motivation: 当前深度 RUL 模型在 C-MAPSS 上已成常态，配套的热力图常被视为解释，但“看起来机械”的热力图不等于工程师可落地的解释。现有 XAI-for-PdM 文献严重欠报删除/插入忠实度、噪声下的 Spearman 稳定性、跨种子一致性、RUL 分箱内的余弦一致性等关键指标。预测误差只是前提，真正的主张是：哪种解释方法在移除其高归因单元后能显著移动 RUL 输出，哪种归因图能在 5% 输入扰动下保持稳定。
AI.method: 1. 数据与设置：使用官方 NASA C-MAPSS FD001 与 FD003 划分、分段 RUL 上限 125 循环、PHM08 非对称评分。2. 模型：分别训练 1D CNN、LSTM、小型 Transformer encoder 三种标准架构。3. 归因方法：对每个模型附加 Integrated Gradients（IG）、遮挡法、最后一层注意力权重三种归因图。4. 评估指标：删除/插入忠实度曲线下面积（AUC）、输入加 5% 传感器尺度噪声后的 Spearman 秩相关稳定性、两个随机种子训练的 LSTM 间归因图的一致性（Spearman 与余弦相似度）、RUL 分箱内的余弦一致性。5. 次级验证：在 AI4I 2020 故障数据集上对树模型特征重要性做相同的删除实验。
AI.result: 1. 预测性能：三模型均达到可用基线，Transformer 略优。2. 忠实度：在 LSTM 上，IG 与遮挡法的删除/插入 AUC 相当且显著优于注意力权重；注意力图虽时间平滑但忠实度弱。3. 噪声稳定性：三种归因图在 5% 输入噪声下几乎不变（Spearman > 0.95）。4. 重训练稳定性：IG 与遮挡法在两个 LSTM 种子间仅中度一致（Spearman ≈ 0.6–0.7），提示传感器抖动稳定性 ≠ 重训练稳定性。5. AI4I 表格实验：树模型特征重要性呈现相同的删除忠实度模式，佐证结论泛化性。
AI.conclusion: 面向维护工程师的 C-MAPSS 风格报告，推荐使用遮挡法或 Integrated Gradients 作为主要解释手段；原始注意力权重仅作为可视化参考，不应当作可行动的解释。工程实践中需同时报告删除/插入忠实度、跨种子一致性与噪声稳定性，避免将单一稳定性指标等同于解释的可靠性。

title: Building LLM Agent Systems the Deep Learning Way: From Modular Design to Architecture Search
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have revolutionized AI research and enabled exciting agent systems. To build a complex LLM agent system, most existing research relies on insights from other domains or heuristics to manually build the agent system. However, this approach often requires heavy hand-engineering and fails to fully optimize for the downstream task of interest. Inspired by the tremendous success of deep learning, we propose to construct LLM agent systems in a modular manner, similar to building a deep neural network. Our key insight is to make analogies between LLM building blocks, such as retrievals, memories, and prompting strategies, and the successful deep learning modules, such as MLPs, attention, and recurrent modules. We further design forward inference and feedback mechanisms for LLMs, where prompts in LLMs are considered as the weights in deep models, and the prompt optimization from feedback is analogous to the back-propagation algorithm. We additionally leverage a search algorithm to search for the best configuration of LLM agent systems, similar to the neural architecture search (NAS) in deep learning research. Comprehensive experimental results demonstrate that the proposed deep learning recipe for LLM agent systems is highly effective, in particular: (1) Organizing LLM modules into deep-learning-style architectures yields noticeable performance gain; (2) Automatic prompt optimization, equivalent to backpropagation, is efficient in incorporating feedback from the task of interest and achieves at least 5% performance improvement; (3) NAS equivalent algorithm works well for further optimizing the LLM agent system architecture with 11% performance gain compared with randomly designed architectures. Overall, our research demonstrates the exciting opportunity of transferring the success of deep learning to building LLM agent systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种受深度学习启发的模块化构建LLM智能体系统的方法，将LLM组件（检索、记忆、提示策略）类比为深度学习模块（MLP、注意力、循环模块），设计前向推理和反馈机制（提示即权重，提示优化类比反向传播），并引入类神经架构搜索（NAS）的算法搜索最佳架构。实验表明该方法显著提升性能：深度学习风格架构带来明显增益，自动提示优化至少提升5%，NAS等价算法比随机架构提升11%。
AI.motivation: 现有构建复杂LLM智能体系统的方法主要依赖人工启发式设计，需要大量手工工程且难以针对下游任务充分优化。受深度学习巨大成功启发，作者希望将深度学习的模块化、可优化、可搜索范式迁移到LLM智能体系统构建中，实现自动化、任务导向的系统设计。
AI.method: 1. 建立LLM构建块与深度学习模块的类比映射（检索/记忆/提示策略对应MLP/注意力/循环模块）。2. 设计前向推理与反馈机制：将提示视为权重，通过任务反馈优化提示，类比反向传播。3. 引入类NAS搜索算法，自动搜索最优LLM智能体系统架构配置。
AI.result: 全面实验验证了该方法的有效性：(1) 将LLM模块组织为深度学习风格架构带来明显性能提升；(2) 自动提示优化（等价反向传播）能高效融入任务反馈，实现至少5%的性能改进；(3) NAS等价算法进一步优化架构，相比随机设计架构获得11%的性能增益。
AI.conclusion: 研究展示了将深度学习的成功范式（模块化设计、反向传播优化、架构搜索）迁移到LLM智能体系统构建中的巨大潜力，为自动化、任务导向的智能体系统设计提供了新的理论框架和实践路径。

title: TimeNet: An Extensible Unified Data Infrastructure for Next-Generation Temporal Foundation Models
summary: Temporal Foundation Models (TFMs) aim to generalize across domains, datasets, and tasks. Yet, their development remains constrained by fragmented, task-specific data formats, annotations, and processing pipelines. We introduce TimeNet, an open-source data standard and scalable infrastructure that decouples temporal data from task definitions and represents signals, metadata, annotations, and supervision in a shared, extensible data model. TimeNet supports multimodal signals with regular, irregular, or ordinal time axes and expresses different task families (including classification, forecasting, temporal localization, question answering, generation, and editing) as reusable views over the same recordings. This shared representation enables heterogeneous time-series datasets to be combined for large-scale model training across domains, modalities, and tasks. We demonstrate TimeNet by transcoding datasets with 1.5M task instances spanning diverse domains, modalities, temporal scales, and forms of supervision, while retaining practical I/O performance relative to native formats. TimeNet enables an existing TFN training pipeline to support joint training on a configurable number of heterogeneous datasets through configuration changes alone. We show this capability by training TFM across multiple datasets and tasks, obtaining a 14% F1 score improvement compared with models trained on individual datasets. These results show that TimeNet provides the data and systems foundation needed to move beyond task- and dataset-specific TFMs toward models that can learn jointly across heterogeneous domains, modalities, temporal scales, and forms of supervision from a common data model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TimeNet，一个开源数据标准和可扩展基础设施，旨在解决时间基础模型（TFM）开发中数据格式碎片化、任务特定的问题。TimeNet将时间序列数据与任务定义解耦，采用共享、可扩展的数据模型表示信号、元数据、标注和监督，支持多模态信号和多种任务族。实验表明，TimeNet能整合150万任务实例，跨数据集联合训练TFM，F1分数提升14%。
AI.motivation: 当前时间基础模型（TFM）的发展受限于碎片化、任务特定的数据格式、标注和处理流程，难以跨域、跨数据集、跨任务泛化。需要一种统一的数据标准和基础设施，将时间序列数据与任务定义解耦，支持异构数据的大规模联合训练。
AI.method: 提出TimeNet：一种开源数据标准和可扩展基础设施。核心设计包括：1) 共享、可扩展的数据模型，统一表示信号、元数据、标注和监督；2) 支持规则、非规则、序数时间轴的多模态信号；3) 将分类、预测、时序定位、问答、生成、编辑等任务族表示为同一记录的可复用视图；4) 通过配置变更使现有TFN训练管道支持异构数据集的联合训练。
AI.result: TimeNet转码了包含150万任务实例的多样化数据集，涵盖不同领域、模态、时间尺度和监督形式，保持了实用的I/O性能。在TFN训练管道中，仅通过配置变更即可实现跨多个异构数据集和任务的联合训练，相比单数据集训练的模型，F1分数提升14%。
AI.conclusion: TimeNet为时间基础模型提供了数据和系统基础，使模型能从通用数据模型中跨异构领域、模态、时间尺度和监督形式联合学习，超越了任务和数据集特定的TFM范式。

title: First-Order Steering: Translating Weight Adaptation into Activation Steering
summary: Activation steering exploits interpretable directions in the residual stream to enable inference-time manipulation of model behavior. Composing steering vectors to apply multiple target behaviors simultaneously is important in various fields-including AI alignment and safety-but remains a challenge for existing activation steering methods. In contrast, prior work in model merging shows that target behaviors represented by learned weight adaptations can be combined with high accuracy. A method that translates weight adaptations into activation steering vectors could therefore extend prior work in model merging to generate composable steering vectors that better enable simultaneous inference-time behavioral control. For this, we introduce First-Order Steering, a formulation of activation steering as a first-order approximation of weight update matrices parameterized by a vector of steering strengths, and establish theoretical bounds on the approximation error of first-order steering. We then develop a novel model merging procedure, HeRD-Merging, which minimizes the first-order approximation error terms to enable higher first-order steering accuracy. Together, our method produces steering vectors that control both individual and composed behaviors more accurately than existing activation steering methods. Furthermore, HeRD-Merging matches the performance of conventional model-merging baselines, while producing weight adaptations that admit more accurate first-order steering vectors.
