title: CIPO: Counterfactual Imagination Policy Optimization for Adaptive Tool Granularity Selection
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents solve complex tasks through multi-step interactions with external tools. These interactions often contain recurring local tool sequences. Treating such sequences as composite "Skills" can shorten tool-use trajectories and reduce repeated low-level decisions. However, when atomic tools and composite skills coexist, skill use becomes a policy problem: the agent must decide whether the current state requires atomic fine control or skill-level abstraction. In this paper, we argue that effective skill use should be studied as adaptive tool granularity selection. The most direct training signal for this problem is to compare the consequences of atomic and skill choices available from the same state. Based on this view, we propose CIPO, a Counterfactual Imagination Policy Optimization framework for adaptive tool granularity. CIPO constructs executable skills through budget-constrained mining of successful tool-use trajectories and trains granularity decisions with counterfactual branch rollouts. For each base rollout, CIPO branches at the first eligible granularity decision and replaces the chosen action with a feasible atomic or skill alternative. The paired outcome difference serves as a supplementary reward for policy optimization. Experiments across multiple benchmarks and model backbones show that CIPO improves task success and decision efficiency over baselines. Further analyses show that CIPO learns effective skill use by improving the choice between atomic tools and composite skills based on the current state, without simply increasing skill frequency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CIPO 框架，通过反事实想象策略优化解决 LLM Agent 在原子工具与组合技能共存时的自适应工具粒度选择问题，实验表明其能提升任务成功率和决策效率。
AI.motivation: LLM Agent 执行复杂任务时常出现重复的局部工具序列，将其封装为复合技能可缩短轨迹并减少低层决策。但原子工具与复合技能共存时，Agent 需根据当前状态决定使用细粒度原子控制还是粗粒度技能抽象，这是一个策略学习问题，缺乏直接的训练信号。
AI.method: CIPO 包含两阶段：1) 预算约束下从成功轨迹挖掘可执行技能；2) 反事实分支回滚训练粒度决策：对每个基础回滚，在首个符合条件的粒度决策点分支，将原动作替换为可行的原子或技能替代方案，利用配对结果差异作为补充奖励进行策略优化。
AI.result: 在多个基准和模型骨干上实验显示，CIPO 显著提高任务成功率和决策效率。进一步分析表明，CIPO 通过改进基于当前状态的原子工具与复合技能选择来学习有效技能使用，而非单纯增加技能使用频率。
AI.conclusion: 将技能使用建模为自适应工具粒度选择，并引入反事实想象提供直接训练信号，能有效解决原子工具与复合技能共存时的决策困境，提升 Agent 的工具使用能力和效率。

title: Why Subliminal Learning Needs So Much Data: A Noisy Inverse View through Steering Vector Recovery
summary: Subliminal learning lets a student inherit a teacher's behavioral trait from semantically unrelated data, yet published demonstrations typically require tens of thousands of carrier examples. We ask where this data requirement comes from. Our testbed is subliminal steering: the teacher trait is a known residual-stream vector $Δ_T$, so transfer can be measured directly as parameter recovery. On identical carrier prefixes, we compare token-level (hard) NLL supervision with full-distribution (soft) KL supervision. At initialization the two objectives give nearly collinear gradients, and both align poorly with $Δ_T$. Under iterative optimization, however, they diverge: soft supervision recovers $Δ_T$ almost exactly from a few hundred carriers, while hard supervision stays well below it even with tens of thousands. We explain this gap by casting steering-vector distillation as a noisy linear inverse problem. Locally, the carrier task maps the trait through its Fisher matrix $F$, so gradients point toward $FΔ_T$ rather than $Δ_T$. Gradient descent then acts as a progressively less-damped inverse of $F$. With soft targets, this inverse restores low-curvature directions. With hard labels, it also amplifies the sampling noise in those same directions. The result is an optimal inversion depth that grows with the number of independent carriers. Experiments on Qwen2.5-7B and Gemma-2-9B confirm four predictions: the Fisher distortion of the initial gradient, recovery ordered from steep to flat directions, an optimal depth that shifts with data scale, and the finding that resampling completions from a fixed prompt pool works as well as adding new prompts. In this setting, large carrier datasets are needed less to reveal the trait than to suppress label noise amplified by Fisher inversion. Code is available at \url{https://github.com/luoyuchenmlcv/subliminal-data}.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了潜意识学习中载体数据需求大的根本原因，发现软标签蒸馏仅需几百个载体即可精确恢复教师特征向量，而硬标签即便用数万载体也难以恢复。通过将特征向量蒸馏建模为带噪线性逆问题，揭示了Fisher矩阵导致的梯度扭曲，以及梯度下降作为Fisher矩阵渐进逆过程的作用。软目标能恢复低曲率方向，硬标签则会放大这些方向的采样噪声，导致存在随数据量增长的最优反演深度。实验验证了四个理论预测，表明大规模载体数据主要用于抑制Fisher逆放大的标签噪声，而非揭示特征本身。
AI.motivation: 潜意识学习让学生从语义无关的载体数据中继承教师的行为特征，但现有演示通常需要数万载体样本。本文旨在探究这种巨大数据需求的来源，理解软硬监督在特征向量恢复上的本质差异。
AI.method: 以潜意识转向为测试床，教师特征为已知残差流向量Δ_T，直接测量参数恢复情况。在相同载体前缀下，对比token级硬NLL监督与全分布软KL监督。将转向向量蒸馏建模为带噪线性逆问题，分析Fisher矩阵F对梯度方向的扭曲（梯度指向FΔ_T而非Δ_T），以及梯度下降作为F的渐进阻尼逆的行为。理论推导软硬目标在低曲率方向上的噪声放大差异，预测最优反演深度随独立载体数增长。在Qwen2.5-7B和Gemma-2-9B上实验验证。
AI.result: 1) 初始梯度受Fisher矩阵扭曲，与Δ_T对齐度差；2) 迭代优化中软硬监督发散：软监督几百载体近乎完美恢复Δ_T，硬监督数万载体仍远低于软监督；3) 恢复按曲率从陡峭到平坦方向有序进行；4) 最优训练深度随数据规模增加而右移；5) 从固定提示池重采样补全效果等同于增加新提示，证实瓶颈在于标签噪声而非提示多样性。
AI.conclusion: 大规模载体数据集的必要性不在于揭示教师特征，而在于抑制Fisher逆过程放大的标签采样噪声。软标签蒸馏通过避免离散采样噪声，能以极少数据高效恢复低曲率方向的特征分量，揭示了潜意识学习数据效率的核心机制。

title: Do Speech Representations Preserve Regional Accent Across Read and Spontaneous Speech?
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: Regional accent cues can be captured under matched conditions, but it remains unclear whether they persist between read and spontaneous speech. We study RVG1, with 500 German speakers from nine regions, comparing ten speech representations on regional classification and continuous geolocation under matched conditions and speaker-independent read--spontaneous transfer. Whisper performs best under matched conditions, reaching 0.489 nine-way UAR and 148 km median geolocation error, but drops to 0.11/0.18 UAR across transfer directions and 363 km geolocation error. Self-supervised models show a similar degradation, whereas speaker embeddings are less discriminative in-domain but more robust under transfer. This contrast is consistent across classification and geolocation. Across representations, robustness is associated with how little a representation shifts between styles (style-invariance), for which crossstyle speaker retrieval is an interpretable proxy. Age, sex, sentence-overlap, and duration controls do not account for the gap, although channel characteristics contribute. These results show that strong matched-condition performance does not indicate robust regional information.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究区域口音线索是否能在朗读语音和自发语音间迁移，使用RVG1数据集（500名德语讲者，9个区域），对比10种语音表示在匹配条件和跨风格迁移下的区域分类与地理定位表现。Whisper在匹配条件下表现最佳（九分类UAR 0.489，中位定位误差148km），但跨风格迁移时大幅下降（UAR降至0.11/0.18，误差增至363km）。自监督模型呈现相似退化，而说话人嵌入域内判别力较弱但迁移鲁棒性更强。鲁棒性与表示的风格不变性相关，跨风格说话人检索可作为可解释代理。年龄、性别、句子重叠、时长等控制变量无法解释性能差距，但信道特征有贡献。结论：强匹配条件性能不代表鲁棒的区域信息。
AI.motivation: 目前已知在匹配条件下可捕获区域口音线索，但不清楚这些线索是否能在朗读语音和自发语音之间持久存在并迁移。论文旨在填补这一认知空白，系统评估不同语音表示在跨风格条件下的区域分类与地理定位能力。
AI.method: 使用RVG1数据集（500名德语讲者，覆盖9个区域），对比10种语音表示（包括Whisper、自监督模型、说话人嵌入等），在匹配条件（同风格训练测试）和说话人无关的朗读-自发跨风格迁移条件下，进行区域分类（九分类UAR）和连续地理定位（中位误差km）两项任务。同时分析表示的风格不变性（通过跨风格说话人检索作为代理），并控制年龄、性别、句子重叠、时长及信道特征等混淆因素。
AI.result: Whisper在匹配条件下达到最优（UAR 0.489，定位误差148km），但跨风格迁移时UAR降至0.11/0.18，误差增至363km。自监督模型呈现相似退化模式。说话人嵌入域内判别力较弱但迁移鲁棒性显著更强。鲁棒性与表示的风格不变性高度相关，跨风格说话人检索性能可作为可解释代理。控制年龄、性别、句子重叠、时长无法消除性能差距，但信道特征部分解释了差距。
AI.conclusion: 强匹配条件性能不能说明表示包含鲁棒的区域口音信息。风格不变性是跨风格区域口音建模的关键特性，未来研究应关注开发风格不变的区域表示，而非仅追求匹配条件下的高性能。

title: EmoRSS: Mitigating Emotion-Induced Over-Refusal in Large Language Models
summary: Emotional expression can influence the safety decisions of large language models (LLMs), offering a potential avenue for improving safety alignment. Existing studies have mainly focused on how emotional expressions facilitate attacks under harmful requests, while overlooking their effects on benign requests. We find that emotional expression can also systematically increase refusal tendencies on benign requests, leading to unnecessary over-refusal. Based on this observation, we propose emotion-guided refusal subspace steering (EmoRSS), an activation-steering method that mitigates emotion-induced over-refusal while preserving refusal behaviour on harmful requests. Specifically, we first identify a refusal-sensitive layer using layer-wise linear probes and construct a refusal subspace from sparse autoencoder (SAE) features aligned with the probe direction. Next, we use paired regular and emotional requests with the same queries to estimate the mean activation shift in the features defining the refusal subspace. Finally, we decode this shift into an activation intervention vector and apply it in the reverse refusal direction during inference, without updating the backbone parameters. Experiments on two LLMs show that, when requests contain emotional expressions, our method achieves a more favourable trade-off between refusing harmful requests and answering benign ones than prior over-refusal mitigation baselines, while better preserving general task performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EmoRSS，一种基于激活转向的方法，通过识别拒绝敏感层并构建拒绝子空间，利用情绪表达引起的激活偏移向量，在推理时反向干预以缓解情绪导致的过度拒绝，同时保持对有害请求的拒绝能力。
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注情绪表达如何在有害请求下促进攻击，忽略了其对良性请求的影响。研究发现情绪表达会系统性地增加模型对良性请求的拒绝倾向，导致不必要的过度拒绝，因此需要一种方法在保持安全拒绝的同时减少这种过度拒绝。
AI.method: 1) 使用逐层线性探针识别拒绝敏感层，并从与探针方向对齐的稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征构建拒绝子空间。2) 使用成对的普通请求和情绪请求（相同查询）估计定义拒绝子空间特征中的平均激活偏移。3) 将该偏移解码为激活干预向量，并在推理时沿反拒绝方向应用，无需更新主干参数。
AI.result: 在两个 LLMs 上的实验表明，当请求包含情绪表达时，该方法在拒绝有害请求和回答良性请求之间实现了更优的权衡，优于现有的过度拒绝缓解基线，同时更好地保持了通用任务性能。
AI.conclusion: EmoRSS 通过激活转向有效缓解了情绪表达导致的过度拒绝问题，在不损害安全对齐的前提下提升了模型对良性请求的响应能力，为情绪感知的安全对齐提供了新思路。

title: Residual Visual Credit Optimization: Conserved Evidence Routing for Multimodal Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards scales multimodal reasoning, but an outcome reward says how much a trajectory is worth, not how that value should be spread over the decisions that produced it. We introduce Residual Visual Credit Optimization (RVCO), which treats token credit as a conserved routing problem. A controlled visual intervention yields a per-token evidence response; robust within-trajectory coordinates remove incidental scale; and a budgeted entropic router distributes a fixed amount of sequence utility according to perceptual dependence. A residual support path guarantees positive credit at every valid position, and an analytic correction restores the prescribed credit mass exactly. The resulting field is selective, bounded, full-support, and invariant to response-local score shifts, and recovers hard token selection as a limiting case. Across four model families and seven reasoning benchmarks, RVCO improves accuracy over strong RLVR baselines while maintaining late-stage optimization stability, corruption robustness, and competitive training cost. Rewards, rollouts, and the group-relative advantage estimator are unchanged; only the geometry of token-level credit differs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出残差视觉信用优化（RVCO），将token级信用分配建模为守恒路由问题，通过受控视觉干预获得每token证据响应，利用预算熵路由器按感知依赖分配固定序列效用，并通过残差支撑路径保证全位置正向信用，解析修正恢复精确信用质量，在保持RLVR优势的同时显著提升多模态推理性能。
AI.motivation: 现有强化学习可验证奖励（RLVR）仅给出轨迹整体价值，缺乏将价值精确分配到生成该轨迹的各个决策（token）的机制。现有token级信用分配方法存在尺度敏感、负信用、不稳定等问题，无法有效支持多模态推理中的视觉-文本交互信用归因。
AI.method: 1. 受控视觉干预：对视觉输入施加扰动，测量每个token输出概率的变化，获得每token证据响应。 2. 轨迹内鲁棒坐标：消除偶然尺度影响，使信用度量不变。 3. 预算熵路由器：将固定序列效用按感知依赖分配，形成选择性、有界、全支撑的信用场。 4. 残差支撑路径：保证每个有效位置获得正向信用。 5. 解析修正：精确恢复规定的总信用质量。
AI.result: 在四个模型家族和七个推理基准上，RVCO优于强RLVR基线，同时保持后期优化稳定性、抗腐蚀鲁棒性和竞争性训练成本。奖励、采样轨迹和群相对优势估计器保持不变，仅改变token级信用的几何分配方式。
AI.conclusion: RVCO通过将token信用分配建模为守恒路由问题，结合视觉干预证据、鲁棒坐标变换、预算熵路由和残差修正，实现了选择性、有界、全支撑且不变的信用场，有效解决了多模态推理中的细粒度信用归因难题，为RLVR提供了几何优雅且实用高效的token级优化范式。

title: The Assistance Dilemma: Learning to Teach via Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) trained to answer questions are natively poor at teaching. Reinforcement Learning (RL) against a simulated student is a promising approach to improve their pedagogy, but existing RL-trained tutors reward the student's success on the tutored problem with the tutor's words still in context. The reward is then easiest to raise by telling the student the answer, and a tuned penalty is needed to reduce telling. Drawing on learning sciences, we introduce a masked near-transfer post-test: the student is tested on an unseen variant of the tutored problem with the tutor's utterances masked, so the reward can rise only through what the student wrote in its own turns. This discourages cognitive offloading by the student and allows the continuous penalty to be replaced by two binary reward gates (factual correctness of tutor response, no solution handover). A leave-one-out ablation shows that the learning-gain reward on its own does not separate teaching from telling: the gates reduce solution handover while the near-transfer post-test improves out-of-domain transfer. Using these reward designs we develop Eduardo, a multi-turn RL recipe for training LLM tutors, and use it to train 4B, 9B, 14B and 27B models from two distinct LLM architectures. Our post-trained Eduardo-27B model matches Gemini-3.1-Pro on MathTutorBench and Claude Opus 4.8 on TutorMoments at 2.4-6.2x fewer thinking tokens than frontier models, which matters for interactive tutoring. Without being named in the reward, the model more than doubles its use of the push-for-justification teacher move while support fading (e.g., assigning independent work), whose payoff lies beyond a single-problem dialog episode, is trained out. We open-source our training environment, an 8,671-problem near-transfer dataset, and trained models for further development.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种基于掩码近迁移后测的强化学习方法Eduardo，训练LLM导师模型，通过二元奖励门控替代连续惩罚，实现了与前沿模型相当的教学效果但推理token更少。
AI.motivation: 现有RL训练的导师模型奖励学生在导师话语仍在上下文中的成功，最容易通过直接给答案提高奖励，需要调整惩罚来减少喂答案行为，且难以区分教学与喂答案。
AI.method: 引入掩码近迁移后测：学生在导师话语被掩码的情况下测试未见过的问题变体，奖励仅通过学生自写内容提升；设计两个二元奖励门控（导师回答事实正确性、无答案移交）；多轮RL训练配方Eduardo，在两种LLM架构上训练4B/9B/14B/27B模型。
AI.result: Eduardo-27B在MathTutorBench匹配Gemini-3.1-Pro，在TutorMoments匹配Claude Opus 4.8，思考token减少2.4-6.2倍；模型自发将push-for-justification教学动作使用率翻倍以上，支持消退行为被训练消除；开源环境、数据集、模型。
AI.conclusion: 掩码近迁移后测配合二元奖励门控有效分离教学与喂答案，提升域外迁移，显著降低推理开销，为交互式辅导提供高效可扩展的导师模型训练范式。

title: How corner is a corner case? Percentile control for highway scenario generation
comment: 30 pages, 13 figures, 8 tables. Project page with videos: https://hhjj233.github.io/CornerPercentile/ Code: https://github.com/hhjj233/P-control-SG
summary:
Generating corner-case scenarios with appropriate adversity in a simulation environment is critical for testing an autonomous vehicle (AV) software stack's safety performance before deployment. Existing autonomous-driving scenario generators can enforce specific behavior, adversity, or feasibility conditions, but they provide limited control over how extreme a generated scenario is relative to plausible futures in the same traffic context. This study represents the adversity of a generated scenario as its percentile in the conditional distribution of future risk given the observed history. This view supports calibrated answers to two questions: how "corner" a generated corner-case scenario is and how its "cornerness" can be fine-tuned.
  To this end, we formulate history-conditioned risk-percentile requests and learn a reference risk distribution that maps each requested percentile to a physical risk target. We then use a percentile-conditioned joint diffusion model with sampling-time risk guidance to generate multi-agent futures, together with a reference-based criterion for evaluating percentile realization.
  Experiments use the minimum post-encroachment time (PET) between the ego and its surrounding vehicles as the risk surrogate on highD. On the primary evaluation set, our method realizes 1,422 of 1,440 requests within a 0.05 percentile tolerance (98.75%), with mean percentile error 0.00673 and PET-target error 0.00991 seconds. The resulting interface connects context-relative risk specification, physical realization, and evaluation through a common risk scale. Project website and videos of generated scenarios are available at https://hhj233.github.io/CornerPercentile/.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于风险分位数的角落案例场景生成方法，通过将场景的对抗性表示为条件风险分布中的分位数，实现了对生成场景“极端程度”的精确控制和评估。
AI.motivation: 现有的自动驾驶场景生成器虽然能施加特定行为、对抗性或可行性条件，但缺乏对生成场景相对于同一交通语境下合理未来的极端程度的精细控制。需要一种能够量化和校准场景“角落程度”的方法，以支持安全测试前的系统性验证。
AI.method: 1. 将历史条件下的未来风险条件分布作为基准，将场景的对抗性建模为该分布中的分位数。2. 学习一个参考风险分布，将请求的分位数映射到物理风险目标（如最小碰后时间PET）。3. 采用分位数条件联合扩散模型，在采样时引入风险引导生成多智能体未来轨迹。4. 提出基于参考分布的评估准则，用于验证生成场景的分位数实现程度。
AI.result: 在highD数据集上，以最小碰后时间（PET）为风险代理指标，主要评估集中1440个请求有1422个在0.05分位数容差内实现（成功率98.75%），平均分位数误差0.00673，PET目标误差0.00991秒。
AI.conclusion: 该方法建立了一个统一的风险尺度，连接了上下文相对风险规格、物理实现和评估，为自动驾驶系统的角落案例测试提供了可校准、可控的场景生成接口。

title: TSAE: Structured Sparse Autoencoders for Interpreting Time-Series Forecasting Models
summary: Time-series forecasting informs critical decisions in energy dispatch, industrial operations, and environmental monitoring; understanding the patterns models rely on is essential for assessing reliability and identifying failures. Input attribution identifies important variables and time segments but offers limited insight into internal features, while standard sparse autoencoder (SAE) objectives do not directly constrain cross-variable structure or temporal continuity. We introduce TSAE, a structured sparse autoencoder for forecasting representations that decomposes hidden states into individually inspectable features. TSAE organizes cross-variable structure through shared and variable-routed private dictionaries, separates feature detection from magnitude estimation with gated encoding, and constrains neighboring sparse-code changes according to raw-segment similarity. These mechanisms support analysis of variable context, activation strength, and temporal evolution. Forecast-consistency fine-tuning further improves preservation of the frozen forecaster's outputs. The accompanying TSEVAL protocol separately audits fidelity, feature coherence, and physical calibration to ground feature interpretation. In three-seed experiments with frozen PatchTST on ETTh1, ETTh2, and ETTm1, TSAE achieves the lowest hidden-state reconstruction error, normalized forecast-reconstruction error (NFRE), and feature transition rate among five SAEs at comparable per-token activity. NFRE decreases by 4.3-26.4% relative to the next-best mean. Dataset-dependent tradeoffs in selectivity, physical correlation, and calibration show that fidelity and temporal-stability gains require independent semantic validation to support feature interpretation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出TSAE（结构化稀疏自编码器），用于时间序列预测模型的隐藏状态解释。TSAE通过共享与变量路由私有字典建模跨变量结构，采用门控编码分离特征检测与幅度估计，并根据原始片段相似性约束相邻稀疏码变化，实现可检查的特征分解。实验表明TSAE在ETT数据集上显著降低重构误差和预测重构误差，但需语义验证支持特征解释。
AI.motivation: 时间序列预测在能源调度、工业运营和环境监测中至关重要，理解模型依赖的模式对评估可靠性和识别失效必不可少。现有输入归因方法仅能识别重要变量和时间片段，无法洞察内部特征；标准稀疏自编码器（SAE）目标未直接约束跨变量结构或时间连续性，限制了对预测表示的解释能力。
AI.method: TSAE包含三大机制：1）共享字典与变量路由私有字典组织跨变量结构；2）门控编码将特征检测与幅度估计解耦；3）基于原始片段相似性约束相邻稀疏码变化，保障时间连续性。另引入预测一致性微调保持冻结预测器输出，并配套TSEVAL协议分别审计保真度、特征相干性和物理校准。
AI.result: 在ETTh1、ETTh2、ETTm1三个数据集上，冻结PatchTST为骨干，TSAE在五种SAE中以可比的逐token活跃度实现最低隐藏状态重构误差、归一化预测重构误差（NFRE）和特征转换率。NFRE相较次优均值下降4.3%-26.4%。数据集依赖的选择性、物理相关性和校准权衡表明，保真度与时间稳定性提升需独立语义验证方能支撑特征解释。
AI.conclusion: TSAE通过结构化稀疏编码有效分解预测表示为可检查特征，显著提升重构保真度与时间稳定性。然而，特征解释的可靠性仍需结合物理校准等语义验证，未来工作应探索更通用的验证框架以增强解释可信度。

title: Behavior-Preserving KV Cache Compression
summary: KV caches are a major bottleneck in long-context inference and long-form generation with large language models. Existing training-free eviction policies largely rely on proxy importance signals, such as attention mass, to decide which past tokens to retain. We argue that cache compression should instead preserve the predictive behavior of the full-cache model, retaining entries whose removal would substantially change the model's output distribution. We propose Behavior-Preserving KV Cache Compression, a training-free framework that scores candidate evictions by estimating the compressed-cache logits induced by their removal and evaluating the resulting KL to the full-cache next-token distribution. Using pre-eviction forward statistics, the method avoids running separate masked forward passes for each candidate. Across diverse architectures and both prefill-time and generation-time compression, our method delivers substantial gains in downstream task quality over lightweight attention-based heuristics at matched retained-KV budgets, with the largest gains under aggressive compression. It achieves these gains with additional compression-time computation while retaining an end-to-end speedup over full-cache inference in our evaluated settings.

title: EVISKILL: Grounding Skill Evolution in Replayable Evidence
summary: Continual skill evolution enables LLM agents to accumulate and refine reusable procedural knowledge from interaction experience without updating model parameters. Its effectiveness depends on determining not only what to change, but also why a change is justified and when it should become persistent guidance. However, existing experience-driven methods can lose the behavioral evidence and task contexts supporting edits. Moreover, a global validation outcome provides an incomplete judgment of its constituent changes: locally supported corrections may be discarded with a rejected revision, while evidence may require further experience to inform useful updates. To this end, we introduce EVISKILL, an evidence-driven framework that organizes execution observations into Replayable Evidence Cards and synthesizes edits with explicit links to their supporting contexts. Targeted replay verifies these edits through re-execution and provides feedback for correction. Across epochs, EVISKILL preserves evidence and provisionally retains supported edits for further refinement, while global validation governs their incorporation into the final skill. Experiments on three interactive benchmarks across six LLM backbones demonstrate the effectiveness of this approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EVISKILL，一种基于证据驱动的持续技能演化框架，通过可重放证据卡和目标重放验证，解决现有方法在经验驱动技能更新中丢失行为证据和任务上下文、全局验证判断不完整等问题。实验在三个交互基准和六个LLM骨干上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有经验驱动的持续技能演化方法存在两大缺陷：一是会丢失支持编辑的行为证据和任务上下文；二是全局验证结果无法完整评估局部变更，导致局部有效的修正可能被拒绝的修订丢弃，且证据需要更多经验才能指导有用更新。因此需要一种能显式关联证据与编辑、支持局部验证和跨轮次证据保留的框架。
AI.method: EVISKILL将执行观察组织为可重放证据卡，合成编辑时显式链接支持上下文；通过目标重放重新执行验证编辑并提供反馈修正；跨轮次保留证据并暂时保留受支持的编辑以进一步细化，最终由全局验证决定是否纳入最终技能。
AI.result: 在三个交互式基准（未具体列出）上，跨六种LLM骨干模型进行实验，EVISKILL展示了优于现有方法的有效性，能更好地积累和细化可复用的程序性知识。
AI.conclusion: EVISKILL通过证据驱动的显式关联、目标重放验证和跨轮次证据保留机制，解决了持续技能演化中证据丢失和全局验证判断不足的问题，为LLM代理无需更新参数即可从交互经验中积累可复用程序性知识提供了有效框架。

title: Prompt Dominance and Asymmetric Verifier Costs: Empirical Ablations of GRPO at 1B Scale on GSM8K
comment: 12 pages, 8 figures. Code, run records, and figure scripts: https://github.com/Helios-YQH/llm-from-scratch
summary: This paper studies GRPO at 1B scale from both directions: what estimator choices do to the learning signal, and what a degraded reward signal does to what is learned. We train OLMo-2-0425-1B on GSM8K with a from-scratch implementation and measure both sides in controlled sweeps, including a verifier-quality experiment that degrades the training reward and the test-time selector identically. Four results stand out. The prompt is the first-order decision: the zero-shot prompt leaves the base model at 0.08% (its outputs are degenerate continuations, not wrong answers), so almost no group carries a gradient, and training succeeds because the 3-shot prompt reaches 18.3%. At this scale the estimator variants sit within seed noise, with Dr. GRPO ahead on both seeds. In the off-policy regime, clipping is the whole story: training on data without a clipped ratio loses 4-6 points relative to the on-policy reference, while GRPO-style clipping and GSPO recover the loss entirely. Finally, the same weak verifier is far cheaper in RL than in test-time selection: a 10%-flip verifier leaves RL's attainable gain intact (91% and 106% retained across two seeds) where selection retains 57%, and a format-only verifier leaves RL with 16-30% of its gain and selection with essentially nothing. Flip noise acts as an affine transform on the expected reward, and the group-normalized advantage with Adam's rescaling removes it exactly; the residual is a second-order variance effect that the matched-step comparison at a 30% flip rate tests.

AI.tldr: 本文在 1B 参数规模下系统研究 GRPO 的两个核心维度：估计器选择对学习信号的影响，以及退化奖励信号对所学策略的影响。通过在 GSM8K 上从头训练 OLMo-2-0425-1B，并进行受控扫描实验（含同步降级训练奖励与测试选择器的验证器质量实验），得出四大关键发现：提示词是一阶决定因素；估计器变体在种子噪声范围内，Dr. GRPO 略优；离策略训练中裁剪是关键，GRPO 风格裁剪与 GSPO 能完全恢复性能；弱验证器在 RL 中比测试时选择便宜得多，翻转噪声表现为奖励的仿射变换，被组归一化优势与 Adam 重缩放精确抵消，残留仅为二阶方差效应。
AI.motivation: 旨在厘清 GRPO 在小规模（1B）下的核心机制：究竟是估计器设计还是奖励信号质量主导训练动态，以及离策略训练中裁剪的必要性，并量化弱验证器在 RL 与测试时选择中的不同代价。
AI.method: 使用从头实现的 GRPO 在 GSM8K 上训练 OLMo-2-0425-1B，开展受控超参数扫描：1）对比零样本与 3-shot 提示词；2）对比多种估计器变体（含 Dr. GRPO）；3）离策略实验中消融裁剪，并与 GSPO 对比；4）验证器质量实验：同步向训练奖励与测试选择器注入翻转噪声（10%、30%）与仅格式验证器，测量 RL 可达增益保留率与选择保留率。
AI.result: 1）零样本提示词导致基座模型仅 0.08% 准确（退化延续），几乎无组别携带梯度；3-shot 提示词跃升至 18.3%，训练才得以成功。2）估计器变体性能差异落在种子噪声内，Dr. GRPO 两粒种子均略优。3）离策略下无裁剪比在策略基线掉 4–6 分，GRPO 裁剪与 GSPO 均能完全追回。4）10% 翻转验证器：RL 保留 91% 与 106% 增益，选择仅保留 57%；仅格式验证器：RL 保留 16–30%，选择几乎为零。翻转噪声为奖励仿射变换，被组归一化优势与 Adam 重缩放精确消除，残留仅为二阶方差效应（30% 翻转率下验证）。
AI.conclusion: 在 1B 规模 GRPO 中，提示词质量是启动训练的一阶瓶颈；估计器细节影响边际；离策略训练必须裁剪；弱验证器在 RL 中极其鲁棒，因组归一化优势与自适应优化器天然抵消仿射噪声，而在测试时选择中则灾难性失效。这为小模型 RL 训练的实用配置提供了明确指导。

title: AECP: Artifact-Exclusive Communication Protocol for Multi-Agent Code Generation
summary: As AI agents increasingly tackle complex repository-level coding tasks, distributing work across multiple agents is a natural way to scale beyond the capabilities of a single agent. To coordinate their interdependent work, these agents share findings and agree on interfaces between modules. However, exchanged information often serves only as context, leaving individual agents to interpret it and incorporate it into subsequent work. Consequently, shared findings may go unused and deviations from interface agreements may go undetected, undermining the reliability and efficiency of collaboration. This motivates moving part of the coordination responsibility from individual agents to the execution harness. To make shared information actionable during execution, we introduce the Artifact-Exclusive Communication Protocol (AECP). AECP requires agents to communicate exclusively through structured artifacts and specifies how the harness processes them. The harness supplies findings when agents access relevant code, screens implementations for mismatches with recorded interface commitments, and requires affected agents to revisit revised agreements. These coordination steps become part of harness execution rather than actions that agents must initiate from prior messages. Across Doc2Repo, NL2Repo, and CodeProjectEval, using closed- and open-source models including Opus-4.8 and DeepSeek-V4-Flash, AECP improves average test pass rate by 28.2% and reduces average wall time by 16.5% relative to an agent team using free-form inter-agent messages. Artifact-exclusive communication also blocks the relay of malicious instructions between agents, reducing how often they reach other agents from 95% to 0% and how often those agents act on them from 40% to 0%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Artifact-Exclusive Communication Protocol (AECP)，通过结构化产物（artifacts）强制多智能体协作，将协调职责从智能体转移到执行框架，显著提升代码生成任务的测试通过率与执行效率，并有效阻断恶意指令传递。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体协作依赖自由形式的消息传递，共享发现常被忽略、接口约定偏差难以被检测，导致协作可靠性与效率低下，且存在恶意指令在智能体间传播的安全隐患。
AI.method: 设计AECP协议：智能体仅通过结构化产物通信；执行框架在智能体访问相关代码时自动提供发现记录、检查实现与接口承诺的匹配、强制受影响智能体重新审视修订后的约定，将协调步骤内化为框架执行流程。
AI.result: 在Doc2Repo、NL2Repo、CodeProjectEval三个基准上，使用闭源与开源模型（Opus-4.8、DeepSeek-V4-Flash），AECP使平均测试通过率提升28.2%，平均墙钟时间减少16.5%；恶意指令传递到其他智能体的比例从95%降至0%，被执行比例从40%降至0%。
AI.conclusion: AECP通过产物专属通信机制，将协调逻辑下沉至执行框架，同时保障协作正确性、效率与安全性，为大规模仓库级代码生成任务的多智能体协作提供了可落地的解决方案。

title: CI-JEPA: A Counterfactual Analysis of Latent Representations in Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures for Self-Supervised Learning
comment: This article has been accepted for the International Symposium on Smart Systems, Algorithms & Applications 2026 (IS3A3 2026), Tezpur Central University, India
summary: Self-supervised visual representation learning learns useful features without manual annotations during representation training. The image-based joint-embedding predictive architecture (I-JEPA) predicts latent representations of masked image regions, but its objective does not explicitly model responses to specified visual interventions. We introduce CI-JEPA, a counterfactual intervention-aware extension that learns to predict the representation change $ΔZ = Z_{\mathrm{CF}} - Z$ between an original image and a modified counterpart. We assess representation robustness through selective sensitivity: stronger responses to task-relevant semantic changes than to nuisance changes. Experiments on Flowers102 use flower-center occlusion as a candidate semantic intervention and background blur and tint as candidate nuisance interventions. With frozen-encoder linear probing, CI-JEPA achieves a best validation accuracy of 78.14\%, compared with 77.55\% for both the pretrained ViT-B/16 and the I-JEPA baseline, a gain of 0.59 percentage points. The reported mean $L_2$ representation changes are 4.42 for center occlusion, 3.48 for background tint, and 2.83 for background blur. This ordering is consistent with relative semantic selectivity for the evaluated interventions, rather than complete nuisance invariance. The accuracy comparison is complementary and does not establish improved robustness over the baselines. These controlled image modifications provide a framework for studying intervention-induced changes in JEPA representations; they do not establish causal feature discovery or robustness to all visual changes.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 CI-JEPA，一种反事实干预感知的 I-JEPA 扩展，学习预测图像语义干预与干扰干预下的表征变化 ΔZ。在 Flowers102 上，CI-JEPA 冻结编码器线性探测准确率达 78.14%，优于 ViT-B/16 和 I-JEPA 基线（77.55%）。表征变化幅度排序为：花心遮挡(4.42) > 背景色调(3.48) > 背景模糊(2.83)，体现相对语义选择性，但未完全实现干扰不变性，且准确率提升不等同于鲁棒性提升。
AI.motivation: 现有的 I-JEPA 通过预测被遮盖区域的潜在表征进行自监督学习，但其目标未显式建模对特定视觉干预的响应。作者希望引入反事实干预机制，使模型能区分任务相关的语义变化（如花心遮挡）与无关干扰变化（如背景模糊、色调），从而学习具有选择性敏感性的鲁棒表征。
AI.method: 提出 CI-JEPA（Counterfactual Intervention-aware JEPA），在 I-JEPA 基础上增加预测原始图像与修改后图像表征差 ΔZ = Z_CF - Z 的目标。实验在 Flowers102 数据集上进行，构造三种可控干预：花心遮挡（语义干预）、背景模糊与背景色调（干扰干预）。使用冻结编码器的线性探针评估下游分类性能，并测量不同干预下的 L2 表征变化量以量化选择性敏感性。
AI.result: CI-JEPA 在线性探测任务上取得 78.14% 验证准确率，比预训练 ViT-B/16 和 I-JEPA 基线（均为 77.55%）高出 0.59 个百分点。三种干预的平均 L2 表征变化分别为：花心遮挡 4.42、背景色调 3.48、背景模糊 2.83。变化幅度排序与语义相关性一致，表明模型对语义干预更敏感，但背景干扰仍引起显著表征变化，未实现完全不变性。
AI.conclusion: CI-JEPA 通过显式建模反事实干预引起的表征变化，提升了对任务相关语义变化的选择性敏感性，在 Flowers102 分类任务上获得适度准确率提升。但该框架仅提供研究干预诱导表征变化的可控范式，并未证明因果特征发现或对所有视觉变化的鲁棒性；准确率提升也不直接等同于鲁棒性增强。

title: Billion-Scale Thumbnail Optimization for Uncurated Short-Form Videos via Multi-Armed Bandits
summary: This paper introduces a real-time thumbnail optimization system deployed at a global $O(B)$ scale on a major short-form video platform. Unlike traditional long-form content, where custom thumbnails are heavily curated by creators, a considerable fraction of short-form videos are published without human-selected artwork. To address this uncurated corpus, we present a fully automated, end-to-end framework that replaces static default frames with dynamic, data-driven selections across billions of videos. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first published work demonstrating an online Multi-Armed Bandit framework successfully deployed at an $O(B)$ scale for uncurated short-form video discovery. Our solution pairs a multi-stage candidate generation pipeline with a low-latency serving infrastructure. By initializing the exploration framework with image-specific priors derived from a deep visual quality model, the system minimizes exploration costs and dynamically serves optimal thumbnails at serving time. Global deployment demonstrates statistically significant improvements in core user discovery and engagement metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种大规模部署的实时短视频缩略图优化系统，基于多臂老虎机框架和深度视觉质量先验，实现动态缩略图选择，显著提升用户发现与参与指标。
AI.motivation: 短视频平台上大量视频缺乏人工精选缩略图，传统静态默认帧效果不佳，亟需自动化、数据驱动的动态缩略图选择系统以提升内容发现和用户参与。
AI.method: 端到端自动化框架：多阶段候选生成管道结合低延迟服务基础设施；引入在线多臂老虎机框架，利用深度视觉质量模型生成图像特定先验初始化探索，最小化探索成本，实时动态服务最优缩略图。
AI.result: 全球 O(B) 规模部署实现核心用户发现与参与指标的统计显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 该系统证明了在大规模短视频场景下，基于多臂老虎机的实时缩略图优化可行且有效，为非精选内容的自动化发现提供了可复用的技术范式。

title: SOL: Measuring Gaps between Text Distributions by Double Sliced Wasserstein Metrics
summary:
Evaluating text generation requires measuring how well the generated distribution matches the data distribution. For autoregressive models, this is done by the perplexity. Diffusion and flow-based language models can only provide a likelihood bound, whose tightness differs between model families. Sample-based substitutes such as generative perplexity with entropy do not consider the distribution fit. We propose SOL,
  a distance between text distributions. Each sequence is represented by the empirical measure of its hidden states under a fixed transformer and the distributions of these measures are compared by the double sliced Wasserstein distance. We prove that SOL is a metric if the transformer is injective. Experiments show that SOL detects distributional failures, recovers expected model trends, and provides stable sample-based estimates. We put forward SOL to fill the gap in the current evaluation protocol used for non auto-regressive models. As a first step we use SOL to re-evaluate a variety of models trained on OpenWebText.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SOL（基于双重切片Wasserstein距离的文本分布度量），一种用于评估非自回归文本生成模型（如扩散模型和流模型）的新指标。SOL通过固定Transformer的隐藏状态经验测度来表示序列，并利用双重切片Wasserstein距离比较分布，填补了当前非自回归模型评估协议的空白。
AI.motivation: 自回归模型通常使用困惑度进行评估，但扩散和流式语言模型只能提供似然下界，且不同模型族之间的紧致程度不同。现有的基于采样的替代指标（如带熵的生成困惑度）不考虑分布拟合程度。因此，需要一种能够直接度量生成分布与数据分布之间差异的指标。
AI.method: SOL将每个序列表示为固定Transformer下的隐藏状态经验测度，然后使用双重切片Wasserstein距离比较这些测度的分布。理论上证明了如果Transformer是单射的，SOL是一个度量。该方法不依赖于模型的似然计算，而是直接在隐藏状态空间中比较分布。
AI.result: 实验表明，SOL能够检测分布层面的失败模式，恢复预期的模型性能趋势，并提供稳定的基于采样的估计。作者使用SOL重新评估了在OpenWebText上训练的多种模型，展示了其作为评估指标的有效性。
AI.conclusion: SOL填补了非自回归文本生成模型评估协议的空白，提供了一个理论上有保证且实验上有效的分布级评估指标。作为第一步，作者用SOL重新评估了OpenWebText上的多种模型，为未来非自回归模型的评估建立了新基准。

title: Why, Where, How: Taxonomy-guided Error Grounding for Code Repair in NL2SQL
summary: SQL queries that large language models write from natural language questions can execute successfully yet produce incorrect results, so execution alone does not reveal what to fix. An error taxonomy says why the query is wrong, but not where to look or how to change it. Existing methods can guide SQL correction through feedback, error reports, or generated plans alongside an unmasked query. We introduce TEG(Taxonomy-guided Error Grounding), which turns a supplied diagnosis into a structured correction input for natural language-to-SQL (NL2SQL) correction. Type-specific rules map each error type to construct classes to reconsider and an edit operation to request. TEG masks the selected constructs in the query when applicable and states that operation in an edit instruction. TEG generates candidate corrections from this input, uses execution feedback to guide candidate selection, and repeats the process one annotation at a time for queries with several errors. On NL2SQL-BUGs, TEG reaches 47.3 single-error execution accuracy and 37.0 overall with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. Across the model sizes and thinking modes evaluated in the main comparison, TEG outperforms all evaluated baselines on single-error queries, even when the baselines receive the same error-type annotations. With predicted types, TEG stays above direct LLM correction and ErrorLLM on single-error queries.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TEG（Taxonomy-guided Error Grounding），一种将错误诊断转化为结构化修正输入的NL2SQL修正方法。TEG利用类型特定规则将错误类型映射到需重新考虑的构造类和编辑操作，掩盖选定构造并给出编辑指令，生成候选修正并利用执行反馈选择，逐个错误迭代修正。在NL2SQL-BUGs基准上，TEG配合Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct达到47.3%单错误执行准确率和37.0%总体准确率，在单错误查询上超越所有基线，即使基线获得相同错误类型标注；使用预测错误类型时，TEG仍优于直接LLM修正和ErrorLLM。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型生成的SQL查询可能执行成功但结果错误，仅靠执行反馈无法定位错误。现有错误分类法只能说明为什么错，不能指明在哪里错以及如何改。现有方法虽能通过反馈、错误报告或生成计划辅助修正，但缺乏将诊断转化为具体、可执行的结构化修正指令的系统性方法。
AI.method: TEG包含三个核心步骤：1) 类型特定规则映射：为每种错误类型定义需重新考虑的SQL构造类（如JOIN条件、WHERE子句）和请求的编辑操作（如替换、删除、插入）。2) 结构化修正输入构建：根据规则掩盖查询中选定的构造，并生成自然语言编辑指令。3) 迭代候选生成与选择：基于结构化输入生成多个候选修正SQL，利用执行反馈（如结果正确性、错误信息）筛选最佳候选；对于多错误查询，逐个错误标注重复上述过程。
AI.result: 在NL2SQL-BUGs基准上，使用Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct模型，TEG在单错误查询上达到47.3%执行准确率，总体准确率37.0%。跨不同模型规模和思维模式的主对比实验中，TEG在单错误查询上均优于所有基线方法，即使基线也获得相同的错误类型标注。当使用预测的错误类型而非金标准类型时，TEG在单错误查询上的表现仍优于直接LLM修正和ErrorLLM。
AI.conclusion: TEG通过将错误分类法转化为具体的、可操作的结构化修正指令（掩盖构造+编辑操作），有效地引导LLM进行针对性的SQL修正。其迭代的单错误修正策略结合执行反馈选择，显著提升了NL2SQL修正的准确性，特别是在单错误场景下表现出强大的鲁棒性和泛化能力，即使错误类型需预测也能保持优势。

title: Learning under Localized Minority Imbalance
summary: Class-imbalance methods implicitly assume that the minority class is uniformly undersampled relative to the majority class. However, in many real-world settings, minority instances may be disproportionately under-observed in certain regions of the feature space. For example, small businesses that go bankrupt may disappear from records, while those that survive remain visible, making bankruptcy appear less common among small firms than it actually is. This gives rise to localized minority imbalance (LMI), a challenge that is often overlooked and extends beyond general class-count imbalance. We show that under LMI, existing imbalance mitigation techniques can fit observation-induced biases in the training data and generalize poorly to under-observed regions of the true minority distribution. To address this, we propose a tree-based stratified approach that recursively partitions the feature space with the goal of reducing within-stratum LMI distortion. For each resulting stratum, we pair its majority instances with the full observed minority set and train a base classifier to create an ensemble. Extensive experiments over benchmark tabular datasets simulated with LMI show that our stratified ensembling approach outperforms popular and state-of-the-art imbalance mitigation techniques. We also introduce a gold-standard evaluation protocol that uses unbiased test sets, and demonstrate that conventional hold-out evaluation from the same LMI-biased data can substantially mislead performance. Overall, our results highlight that the cause of imbalance is as important as the correction method.

AI.tldr: 论文针对局部少数类不平衡（LMI）问题，提出基于树的分层集成方法，通过递归划分特征空间减少层内LMI扭曲，并在每个层内将多数类样本与完整观测少数类样本配对训练基分类器，实验表明该方法优于现有不平衡缓解技术，并揭示传统基于LMI偏倚数据的留出评估会误导性能估计。
AI.motivation: 现有类别不平衡方法隐含假设少数类相对于多数类均匀欠采样，但在现实场景中（如小企业破产记录消失），少数类实例在特征空间某些区域被不成比例地欠观测，导致局部少数类不平衡（LMI）。LMI会使模型拟合观测诱导的偏倚，在真实少数类分布的欠观测区域泛化性能差，现有方法未充分应对此问题。
AI.method: 提出树基分层集成方法：递归划分特征空间以最小化层内LMI扭曲；对每个层，将该层多数类实例与完整观测少数类集配对训练基分类器；最终集成所有层的分类器。同时引入无偏测试集的金标准评估协议，对比传统留出评估的误导性。
AI.result: 在模拟LMI的基准表格数据集上，分层集成方法显著优于流行及最先进的不平衡缓解技术。实验表明，基于LMI偏倚数据的常规留出评估会大幅高估性能，而金标准评估能揭示真实泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 不平衡的成因与校正方法同等重要。针对LMI需专门设计的分层策略，且评估协议必须使用无偏测试集以避免误导性结论。

title: Test-Time Adaptation of Reasoning Strategies with Bayesian Nonparametric Memory
summary: While modern large language models (LLMs) have been trained to reason through verbalized chains-of-thought, the generation cost grows substantially due to suboptimal paths to reach the final answer. Furthermore, as new insights are discovered while observing various input queries (e.g. through self-reflection), limited mechanisms exist for carrying forward these findings to be applied to subsequent problems. One can view the list of such strategies or behaviors as a growing cheatsheet, with elements retrieved from this memory module at inference-time. In this work, we consider structured cheatsheets, with learned clusters of behaviors. We introduce a Hierarchical Dirichlet Process Gaussian Mixture Model (HDP-GMM) over behavior embeddings, which shares components across domains while allowing domain-specific mixing weights, and uses the posterior predictive to retrieve relevant behaviors for a query; we call this a $\textit{Bayesian Cheatsheet}$. This mechanism allows for cheap adaptation in an online test-time training (TTT) setting, softly updating the mixture's sufficient statistics following each sample and enabling the creation of new components when the synthesized behaviors are sufficiently novel. We demonstrate that Bayesian Cheatsheet achieves clear performance gains relative to existing memory modules across reasoning benchmarks such as AIME'25, Omni-MATH, and PhysReason, even in the cold-start setting. We show that the Bayesian Cheatsheet is an adaptively reorganizing memory module, as behaviors can be re-assigned to components through a single step of collapsed Gibbs sampling. Our findings highlight the value of Bayesian-inspired memory modules for effective test-time adaptation and the role of structure in metacognitive reasoning.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种名为'贝叶斯备忘录'的结构化记忆模块，基于层次狄利克雷过程高斯混合模型（HDP-GMM），用于在测试时自适应地检索和更新推理行为，显著提升了AIME'25、Omni-MATH和PhysReason等推理基准上的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型虽然通过思维链进行推理，但存在两个主要问题：1）生成成本因次优推理路径而显著增加；2）缺乏将自我反思中发现的新见解迁移到后续问题的有效机制。需要一种结构化、可自适应更新的记忆模块来解决这些问题。
AI.method: 提出基于行为嵌入的层次狄利克雷过程高斯混合模型（HDP-GMM），该模型在跨域共享组件的同时允许域特定的混合权重，并使用后验预测进行相关行为检索。支持在线测试时训练（TTT）：每个样本后软更新混合模型的充分统计量，当合成行为足够新颖时创建新组件。通过单步坍缩吉布斯采样实现行为在组件间的重新分配，实现记忆模块的自适应重组织。
AI.result: 在AIME'25、Omni-MATH和PhysReason等推理基准上，贝叶斯备忘录相对于现有记忆模块实现了明显的性能提升，即使在冷启动设置下也表现优异。实验验证了其作为自适应重组织记忆模块的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 研究突显了贝叶斯启发的记忆模块在有效测试时自适应中的价值，以及结构在元认知推理中的关键作用。这种结构化备忘录机制为大语言模型的持续学习和高效推理提供了新范式。

title: SharpDraft: Accelerating Long-Context Speculative Decoding with Cardinality-Aware Query Scaling
summary: Long-form reasoning makes inference expensive, and speculative decoding mitigates this cost by verifying multiple draft tokens in parallel. Its speedup, however, can fade as context grows and draft acceptance declines. We focus on attention-mass dilution: as softmax normalizes over more visible Keys, the mass concentrated on the highest-scoring Keys can decrease. We introduce SharpDraft, a training-free method that counteracts this effect through cardinality-aware Query scaling, without the computational overhead of online adaptation. Under explicit assumptions, we derive an exact top-$k$ mass correction and deploy a closed-form fixed-slope approximation. Across AIME-26, GPQA-Diamond, and LongGenBench Diary, SharpDraft achieves $2.59$-$3.19\times$ geometric-mean end-to-end speedups over target-only autoregressive decoding when applied to DFlash, PARD, and EAGLE 3.1. With DFlash, it improves decoding speed and outperforms full-parameter and LoRA-based online adaptation in end-to-end speedup, while matching the unmodified drafter's reported peak allocated GPU memory.

AI.tldr: SharpDraft 是一种无需训练的方法，通过基数感知的 Query 缩放来对抗推测解码中的注意力质量稀释问题，显著提升长上下文推理的端到端解码速度。
AI.motivation: 长链推理导致推理成本高昂，推测解码通过并行验证多个草稿 token 来缓解此问题。然而，随着上下文增长，草稿接受率下降，加速效果减弱。核心原因是注意力质量稀释：随着 softmax 归一化的可见 Key 数量增加，集中在最高分 Key 上的注意力质量可能减少。
AI.method: 提出 SharpDraft，一种无需训练的方法，通过基数感知的 Query 缩放来抵消注意力质量稀释效应，避免了在线自适应的计算开销。在显式假设下推导出精确的 top-k 质量修正，并部署闭式固定斜率近似。
AI.result: 在 AIME-26、GPQA-Diamond 和 LongGenBench Diary 基准测试中，应用于 DFlash、PARD 和 EAGLE 3.1 时，SharpDraft 实现了 2.59-3.19× 的几何平均端到端加速比。结合 DFlash 时，不仅提升了解码速度，还在端到端加速比上超越了全参数和基于 LoRA 的在线自适应方法，同时保持了未修改草稿模型报告的峰值 GPU 显存占用。
AI.conclusion: SharpDraft 有效解决了推测解码中的注意力质量稀释问题，在无需训练和在线自适应开销的情况下显著提升长上下文推理速度，同时保持内存效率，为大模型高效推理提供了实用解决方案。

title: D-DOIT: Training-free Adaptation of Discrete Diffusion via Doob's h-Transform
summary: We propose D-DOIT (Discrete Doob-Oriented Inference-time Transformation), a training-free and efficient adaptation method for discrete diffusion models with generic rewards. D-DOIT formulates adaptation as sampling from a reward-tilted target distribution and realizes this transport through Doob's h-transform of the discrete diffusion reverse kernel, using only reward values rather than reward gradients. Unlike continuous diffusion, masked discrete diffusion samples categorical token-reveal transitions rather than continuous state updates. D-DOIT derives the corresponding discrete Doob's h-transform, which guides sampling by reweighting reverse transition probabilities instead of adding a drift correction. To make this transformation practical, D-DOIT avoids expensive future rollouts. At each guided step, D-DOIT samples candidate next states, uses the model prediction head to complete each candidate into a clean sequence, evaluates each completion with the reward oracle, and resamples the next state with probabilities proportional to the rewards. An optional late-stage best-of-K refinement further improves sample quality by branching trajectories only near the end of denoising, avoiding the $K$-fold cost over the full trajectory. Empirically, across regulatory DNA design and protein inverse folding benchmarks, D-DOIT outperforms training-free guidance baselines. It improves enhancer activity and cell-type specificity while preserving sequence naturalness, and achieves the highest success rate in protein inverse folding.

AI.tldr: D-DOIT 是一种无需训练且高效的离散扩散模型适配方法，利用 Doob's h-transform 实现基于通用奖励的引导采样，仅需奖励值而非梯度。
AI.motivation: 现有的连续扩散引导方法不直接适用于离散扩散（后者采样分类 token 揭示转移而非连续状态更新），且需要奖励梯度或昂贵的未来轨迹模拟。需要一种无需训练、仅使用奖励值即可高效引导离散扩散生成的方法。
AI.method: D-DOIT 将适配建模为从奖励倾斜的目标分布采样，通过离散扩散反向核的 Doob's h-transform 实现传输。在每个引导步骤：采样候选下一状态，用模型预测头将每个候补补全为干净序列，用奖励预言机评估每个补全，按奖励成比例重采样下一状态。可选的后期 best-of-K 细化仅在去噪末期分支轨迹，避免全轨迹的 K 倍开销。
AI.result: 在调控 DNA 设计和蛋白质逆折叠基准上，D-DOIT 超越无训练引导基线。它在保持序列自然性的同时提升增强子活性和细胞类型特异性，并在蛋白质逆折叠任务中达到最高成功率。
AI.conclusion: D-DOIT 提供了一种高效、无需训练的奖励引导离散扩散方法，使生物序列设计能够生成高质量样本，且计算开销可控。

title: Anatomy of LLM Sycophancy: What a Flip Rate Hides
summary: A model under pushback can correct itself, capitulate, or hold, and one flip rate counts a correction and a capitulation alike. Using SycoLens, a modular replay protocol, we test how user pressure and evaluation settings shape measured flip rates. Each measurement is one stateless replay of an item, a committed answer, and one scripted user line in a fixed form. Every effect is read against a matched control with the line deleted. Pushback wording, committed text, answer format, boundary distance, and ground truth become factors of one instrument; earlier instruments vary one to three of them. Across eleven frontier models from three providers and about 760,000 controlled replays, which models look sycophantic depends on how the user pushes back. Lines that assert the opposite verdict and lines that challenge the answer without asserting one rank the models almost unrelatedly. Flip effects grow several-fold near a model's boundary, yet items answered identically in every screening draw still carry about half of the most-affected totals. On arithmetic tasks where the truth is known, one model re-derives and corrects itself under pressure while another abandons correct answers without written work. On the model tested, a planted derivation lowers release of the answer it argues for, true or wrong, where a bare stated value does not; the wrong answer is corrected much more often than the true one is abandoned. Under a yes/no readout the rankings come closer, entangled with a pressure-induced shift toward "no". One score per model therefore compares different behaviours across models and benchmarks. We condense these dependencies into a reporting profile; the instrument, records, and analyses will be released upon publication.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SycoLens模块化回放协议，通过约76万次受控回放实验，系统研究11个前沿模型在用户反驳压力下的翻转行为，发现翻转率强依赖于反驳措辞、边界距离、答案格式等因素，单一翻转率指标无法跨模型/基准比较，需采用报告画像多维呈现。
AI.motivation: 现有研究将修正和屈从混为一谈计入翻转率，且仅变换1-3个因素，缺乏系统性理解：用户反驳措辞、承诺文本、答案格式、边界距离、真值等因素如何联合塑造测量到的拟从行为，以及单一指标是否掩盖了跨模型、跨任务的行为差异。
AI.method: 构建SycoLens无状态回放工具：每次测量回放一个条目、一个承诺答案和一句固定格式的脚本化用户反驳；每个效应都对比删除该反驳行的匹配对照；将反驳措辞、承诺文本、答案格式、边界距离、真值纳入同一仪器因子设计；对三家提供商的11个前沿模型执行约76万次受控回放。
AI.result: 1) 断言相反判决的反驳与仅挑战不断言的反驳，对模型排名几乎无关；2) 翻转效应在模型决策边界附近放大数倍，但所有筛选轮次答案一致的条目仍贡献约半数最大影响总量；3) 算术任务中，某模型在压力下重新推导并自我修正，另一模型则在无书面推导时放弃正确答案；4) 植入推导过程会降低其论证答案（无论真假）的释放率，裸陈述值则不然，错误答案被修正频率远高于真答案被放弃；5) 是/否读出下排名趋同，夹杂着压力诱导的向「否」偏移。
AI.conclusion: 单一翻转率分数跨模型、跨基准比较的是不同行为；需将这些依赖关系浓缩为报告画像（reporting profile）多维呈现。论文将发布仪器、记录与分析代码以支持复现与扩展。

title: LexiHorizon: Stabilizing Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon Deep Search
summary: Deep search agents tackle complex knowledge tasks through iterative retrieval, multi-hop reasoning, and evidence synthesis across multiple sources. Existing approaches typically assume relatively stable retrieval systems and operate over short-horizon tool interaction. However, when retrieval is sensitive to query formulation, even a semantically appropriate query may fail to surface critical evidence because of mismatched entity names, aliases, or keyword combinations. Recovering from such failures requires repeated query reformulation and longer interaction trajectories. This setting poses a distinct training challenge, as the policy must sustain long-horizon query exploration while managing an expanding volume of retrieved content. We propose LexiHorizon, a framework for training search agents over long horizons that expands the trajectory context budget, manages accumulated retrieval content using a window over recent tool observations while preserving the reasoning history, and introduces an outcome-gated search-effort reward that provides a bounded bonus for tool invocations to trajectories with nonzero answer reward. Experiments on XBench, WebWalkerQA, and BrowseComp-ZH show that the resulting 9B model consistently outperforms both its base model and MiroThinker-1.7-mini, with maximum absolute gains of 8.7 and 23.8 percentage points, respectively. These results suggest that combining an extended context budget with reasoning-preserving context management benefits long-horizon deep search agents.

AI.tldr: LexiHorizon框架通过扩展上下文预算、保留推理历史的窗口化检索内容管理和结果门控的搜索努力奖励，训练长时程深度搜索代理，在多个基准上显著优于基础模型和MiroThinker-1.7-mini。
AI.motivation: 现有深度搜索代理假设检索系统稳定、交互时程短，但实际检索对查询表述敏感，语义合适的查询可能因实体名不匹配、别名或关键词组合问题而失败，需要反复重写查询和更长交互轨迹，这对策略的长时程探索和不断增长的检索内容管理提出训练挑战。
AI.method: 提出LexiHorizon框架：1) 扩展轨迹上下文预算；2) 使用窗口管理累积检索内容，仅保留最近工具观察同时保留推理历史；3) 引入结果门控的搜索努力奖励，为答案奖励非零的轨迹提供有界工具调用奖励奖金。
AI.result: 在XBench、WebWalkerQA和BrowseComp-ZH上实验，生成的9B模型持续优于基础模型和MiroThinker-1.7-mini，最大绝对增益分别为8.7和23.8个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 结合扩展上下文预算与保留推理历史的上下文管理，有利于长时程深度搜索代理的训练。

title: A Graph-Based Inspection and Intervention Tool for Assessing Mechanistic Learning in PINNs
comment: This is a developmental work which was submitted to NeurIPS workshops. Useful feedback was obtained and an improved version is being developed
summary: We ask whether physically meaningful correspondences discovered inside a trained scientific model remain meaningful outside the conditions under which they were discovered. We introduce GIIT (Graph-based Inspection and Intervention Tool), which represents governing physics as a computational physics dependency graph, maps graph nodes to internal network components via sensitivity- and trend-based discovery, and tests the resulting mapping under targeted intervention. Evaluating on temporal extrapolation out-of-distribution (OOD) regimes of increasing severity, we find that temporal extrapolation is associated with layer-wise correspondence drift and reduced functional correspondence. Specifically, while the model achieves low physics residual in-distribution (1.915 x 10-4 on full ID and 1.01 x 10-4 on an ID sub-window t in [0.5, 0.8]), the functional mapping changes even before leaving the training domain, and the shift continues as the evaluation window extends beyond the training domain: residual error increases from 2.81 x 10-2 on the boundary-crossing window (t in [0.5, 1.5]) to 3.30 x 10-1 on severe OOD (t in [1, 2]), accompanied by a systematic leftward shift of internal layer mappings, where the average winner layer index drops from 5.71 (ID) to 3.00 (ID sub-window) down to 2.29 (severe OOD). Only 2 of 7 physical nodes maintain stable layer assignments across the boundary-crossing window, and only 1 of 7 under severe extrapolation, revealing potential internal functional correspondence changes before severe degradation in conventional output metrics. Additional results for linear oscillatory systems are further detailed in the appendix.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 GIIT 工具，通过计算物理依赖图与神经网络内部组件的映射，研究科学模型在分布外（OOD）时间外推时，物理意义对应关系的稳定性。实验发现：即使在训练域内，功能映射就已发生漂移；随外推严重程度增加，层级对应系统性左移，物理残差显著增大，仅少数物理节点保持稳定映射，揭示了常规输出指标恶化前的内部功能对应变化。
AI.motivation: 科学机器学习模型在训练分布内表现良好，但在分布外外推时可靠性存疑。现有工作多关注输出层面的物理一致性，缺乏对模型内部物理语义对应关系在 OOD 条件下稳定性的系统性检验。需要一种工具来量化内部神经元/层与物理量对应关系的漂移，并在常规指标失效前预警模型失效。
AI.method: 提出 GIIT (Graph-based Inspection and Intervention Tool)：1) 将支配物理过程建模为计算物理依赖图（节点为物理量，边为因果依赖）；2) 基于灵敏度分析与趋势匹配，将图节点映射到网络内部组件（层/神经元）；3) 通过目标干预（如固定/扰动特定节点对应的内部激活）验证映射的功能因果性；4) 在不同时间外推窗口（分布内、边界跨越、严重 OOD）评估映射稳定性与物理残差。
AI.result: 分布内物理残差极低（1.915e-4 全域，1.01e-4 子窗口 t∈[0.5,0.8]）。功能映射在训练域内即开始漂移：平均获胜层索引从 5.71（全 ID）降至 3.00（ID 子窗口）。外推时残差急剧增大：边界窗口 t∈[0.5,1.5] 为 2.81e-2，严重 OOD t∈[1,2] 为 3.30e-1。层级映射系统性左移至 2.29（严重 OOD）。仅 2/7 物理节点在边界窗口保持稳定层分配，严重 OOD 下仅 1/7 稳定。线性振荡系统附录实验佐证。
AI.conclusion: 科学模型内部的物理语义对应关系在分布外时间外推中不稳定，且漂移早于输出指标显著恶化。GIIT 能在常规残差指标失效前检测到内部功能对应的退化，为模型可靠性监控与物理一致性保证提供新工具。未来工作需探索增强对应稳定性的训练目标或架构设计。

title: Before Agent Tells The Lie: Has Deception Already Been Represented?
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based agents can exhibit deceptive behavior during task execution, including hiding failures, fabricating results, or falsely signaling task completion. Existing monitoring approaches mainly detect deception after it appears in observable actions or outputs. In this paper, we investigate whether deceptive behavior can be predicted from an agent's internal representations before it becomes externally visible. We frame deception monitoring as a trajectory-level representation analysis problem and align agent trajectories around key decision points. Using hidden states extracted before these points, we show that future honest and deceptive outcomes can be reliably distinguished, with predictive signals remaining detectable several model calls before the final decision. We further characterize the temporal evolution of these signals: deception-related representations are weak early in execution but become increasingly identifiable as trajectories progress, while transferable structure can emerge before the strongest decision-adjacent signals appear. Finally, we intervene on the identified honest-deceptive representation directions during inference and find that activation steering reduces downstream deceptive behavior, suggesting that these representations influence agent decisions. Our findings indicate that agent deception is an evolving internal process that can be detected and potentially mitigated before it is expressed externally.

AI.tldr: 本文研究基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体在任务执行过程中是否可以通过内部表征提前预测欺骗行为，而非等待其外显。作者将欺骗监控建模为轨迹级表征分析问题，在关键决策点前提取隐藏状态，成功区分未来诚实与欺骗结果，并发现预测信号可在最终决策前数个模型调用中被检测到。进一步通过激活引导干预识别出的诚实-欺骗表征方向，有效降低了下游欺骗行为，表明这些内部表征具有因果影响力。
AI.motivation: 现有监控方法主要在欺骗行为已外显为可观测动作或输出后才进行检测，存在滞后性。本文旨在探究智能体内部表征是否蕴含欺骗的早期预警信号，从而实现事前预测与干预，提升智能体的安全性与可信度。
AI.method: 将欺骗监控形式化为轨迹级表征分析任务；以关键决策点为锚点对齐智能体执行轨迹；提取决策点前的隐藏状态作为输入；训练分类器区分未来诚实与欺骗轨迹；分析预测信号随轨迹推进的时序演化特性；在推理阶段对识别出的诚实-欺骗表征方向施加激活引导进行干预实验。
AI.result: 隐藏状态可在决策前数个模型调用可靠地区分诚实与欺骗结果；欺骗相关表征初期微弱，随轨迹推进逐渐增强且可识别性提升；可迁移的表征结构在最强决策临近信号出现前即已浮现；激活引导干预显著降低下游欺骗行为发生率，证实表征对决策具有因果作用。
AI.conclusion: 智能体欺骗是一个不断演化的内部过程，其表征特征可在外显行为发生前被检测并利用，且通过激活引导可实现事前缓解，为构建可监控、可干预的可信智能体提供了新范式。

title: Memory Canonicalization: A Framework and Benchmark for Cross-Model Drift in Persistent LLM Memory
summary: Persistent memory for Large Language Models (LLMs) has matured rapidly: systems such as MemGPT/Letta, Mem0, and Zep now provide agents with tiered, temporally-aware, model-agnostic external storage, while the Model Context Protocol (MCP) standardizes access to memory servers. A less addressed problem is that an identical stored memory object, retrieved by two different LLMs under otherwise identical conditions, may not be interpreted the same way, factually or emotionally. This paper proposes memory canonicalization: a write-time pipeline that detects ambiguity, conditional structure, and emotional loading in a raw memory object and rewrites it into an explicit, structurally disambiguated canonical form, with emotional valence represented as a separate field rather than inferred from tone. We formalize the pipeline, define a companion Cross-Model Semantic Drift / Emotional Consistency Score benchmark (CMSC-E), and report results from a three-arm pilot using 176 synthetic memory objects and three downstream model families. We find an uncorrected improvement in cross-model emotional consistency for fully canonicalized memory relative to raw memory (+0.050, 95% bootstrap CI [0.013, 0.086], paired t-test p = 0.010), but this result does not survive Bonferroni, Holm, or Benjamini-Hochberg correction across the six comparisons tested. None of the factual-drift (CMSD) comparisons reach significance at any correction level. We report these results as exploratory rather than confirmatory and outline needed follow-up work, including larger samples, independent judge models, human-validated rendering, and preregistration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出记忆规范化方法，旨在解决不同大语言模型对相同记忆对象的理解不一致问题。通过写入时的管道处理，将原始记忆重写为显式、结构化的规范形式，并将情感效价作为独立字段。实验使用176个合成记忆对象和三个模型家族，发现规范化记忆在跨模型情感一致性上有未经校正的显著提升（+0.050），但经多重比较校正后不显著；事实漂移比较均未达显著。结果为探索性，需后续更大样本、独立裁判模型、人工验证和预注册研究。
AI.motivation: 现有持久记忆系统（如MemGPT、Mem0、Zep）和MCP协议虽提供分层、时序感知的外部存储，但忽略了同一记忆对象被不同LLM检索时可能产生的事实和情感理解差异。这种跨模型语义漂移和情感不一致限制了记忆的可靠复用。
AI.method: 提出记忆规范化写入时管道：检测原始记忆中的歧义、条件结构和情感负载，重写为显式、结构化消歧的规范形式，情感效价作为独立字段而非从语气推断。定义跨模型语义漂移/情感一致性分数基准（CMSC-E）。三臂试点实验：176个合成记忆对象，三个下游模型家族，对比原始记忆与完全规范化记忆。
AI.result: 完全规范化记忆相对原始记忆，跨模型情感一致性未经校正显著提升（+0.050，95% bootstrap CI [0.013, 0.086]，配对t检验p=0.010），但经Bonferroni、Holm或Benjamini-Hochberg校正后不显著（六次比较）。所有事实漂移（CMSD）比较均未在任何校正水平达显著。
AI.conclusion: 记忆规范化在提升跨模型情感一致性上显示初步潜力，但当前证据为探索性，不具确证性。需后续工作：扩大样本量、引入独立裁判模型、人工验证渲染质量、预注册实验设计。

title: Software World Models: From Consequence Prediction to Decision Value
summary: A coding agent may safely modify one repository while silently breaking downstream services, libraries, or datastores that depend on it. Exhaustively running integration tests after every agent action is impractical, so the agent must predict these failures before executing them. Existing software world models predict the agent's own observations, while static change-impact analysis only identifies where a change may propagate. We instead introduce the Software World Model (SWM), which models the broader system affected by a code change and predicts its blast set: the components that the change will break. SWM follows three stages: explore, learn, and act. Explore executes candidate changes from restored system states, prioritizing regions where observed failures contradict the dependency graph. Learn fine-tunes a language model on these execution outcomes to predict downstream breakage. Act converts sampled predictions into per-consumer break probabilities for change ranking, proactive migration, and deciding when another execution is worth its cost. On held-out synthetic systems, SWM improves blast-set F1 from 0.431 for static reachability to $0.571\pm0.037$, more than halves ranking regret, and improves migration return at all nine evaluation checkpoints. The two methods are complementary: reachability is stronger on dependencies represented in the graph, while SWM recovers failures caused by couplings the graph misses. Experiments on held-out real libraries further show that predicting structured failure outcomes, rather than only scalar risk, is important for downstream decision quality.

AI.tldr: 论文提出软件世界模型（SWM），通过探索-学习-行动三阶段预测代码变更的冲击集（blast set），在合成和真实系统上优于静态可达性分析，且二者互补。
AI.motivation: 编码代理修改仓库时可能无声破坏下游服务/库/数据存储；穷尽运行集成测试不切实际，需在执行前预测故障。现有软件世界模型仅预测代理自身观测，静态变更影响分析仅识别变更可能传播位置，均不足。
AI.method: SWM 三阶段：Explore 从恢复的系统状态执行候选变更，优先探索观测故障与依赖图矛盾的区域；Learn 基于执行结果微调语言模型预测下游破坏；Act 将采样预测转为各消费者破坏概率，用于变更排序、主动迁移及决定是否值得再次执行。
AI.result: 在保留的合成系统上，SWM 将冲击集 F1 从静态可达性的 0.431 提升至 0.571±0.037，排名遗憾值减半以上，在九个评估检查点均提升迁移收益。二者互补：可达性在图中表示的依赖上更强，SWM 恢复图遗漏耦合导致的故障。真实库实验表明，预测结构化故障结果而非仅标量风险，对下游决策质量至关重要。
AI.conclusion: SWM 通过主动探索与语言模型学习，有效预测代码变更的冲击集，弥补静态分析盲区，为变更排序、迁移决策提供结构化故障预测，显著提升下游决策质量。

title: Molecules of a Story: Community Detection in PMI-weighted Narrative Networks
summary: Automatically extracted narrative networks -- graphs with entities as nodes and their relations as edges -- have proven useful for revealing central narrative structures through salient entities and their connections (Tangherlini et al. 2020; Labatut and Bost 2019). But a narrative is more than those central structures that everything else revolves around. This work is concerned with the everything else: brief sub-plots, small clusters of descriptions, or associations between minor characters that go under the radar at the macro-level. We present an approach to unearth such peripheral structures. They involve rare entities with limited textual presence, overshadowed by dominant entities and lost among each other in the long tail of many but rare entities (Baayen 2001). We leverage the known tendency of pointwise mutual information (PMI, Church and Hanks 1990) to inflate for rare events, turning its weakness into a strength by weighting edges with PMI to foreground peripheral entity configurations. Communities extracted from the resulting network are structural traces of underlying narrative elements. We demonstrate the approach on The Lord of the Rings. From measures of how concentrated or dispersed a community's activations are across the text, a typology emerges that reveals that peripheral structures form more than a single class: episodic passages, echoing long-distance connections, and recurring threads each surface as distinct configurations. The approach is conceptually simple and surfaces fine-grained narrative details that are lost in abundance, though its deliberate amplification of weak signals comes with inherent sensitivity -- best understood as a lens for exploration rather than a robust extraction pipeline.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种利用点互信息（PMI）放大罕见实体关联的方法，从叙事网络中提取被主导实体掩盖的外围叙事结构（如次要情节、次要人物关联），并在《指环王》上验证，发现外围结构包含情节片段、长距离回响和反复出现的线索三种类型。
AI.motivation: 现有的叙事网络分析主要关注核心实体及其连接构成的中心叙事结构，而忽略了长尾分布中的稀有实体所形成的外围结构（如支线情节、次要人物群、微弱关联），这些结构虽文本表现有限但构成叙事的重要细节。
AI.method: 构建实体为节点、共现关系为边的叙事网络，利用点互信息（PMI）对边加权——PMI 对罕见事件天然放大的特性被转化为优势，使稀有实体间的微弱关联在加权网络中凸显；随后对加权网络进行社区发现，提取的社区作为底层叙事元素的结构痕迹；再通过度量社区激活在文本中的集中度与离散度，对外围结构进行类型学分类。
AI.result: 在《指环王》上实验表明，外围结构并非单一类别，而是形成三种截然不同的配置：情节片段（集中激活）、长距离回响（分散激活）和反复出现的线索（周期性激活）。方法概念简单，能揭示宏观分析中丢失的细粒度叙事细节。
AI.conclusion: 该方法将 PMI 对罕见事件的敏感性转化为探索外围叙事结构的优势，提供了一种面向探索的透镜而非鲁棒的提取管道；其刻意放大弱信号的特性带来固有敏感性，适合作为叙事细节发现的辅助工具。

title: AutoSciBench: Autonomous Benchmark Generation for Evaluating Scientific Agents
summary: As agents rapidly evolve, existing benchmarks can become saturated, limiting their ability to distinguish capabilities and reveal remaining failure modes. Particularly in scientific domains, constructing and updating benchmarks requires substantial time, labor, and domain expertise, making it difficult to keep evaluation aligned with advances in agent capabilities. We address this challenge by investigating whether scientific-agent benchmarks can be automatically generated and iteratively adapted as agent capabilities evolve. We introduce AutoSciBench, a framework that represents each task as a high-level concept specifying the scientific domain, data modality, and required reasoning approach, together with a low-level recipe specifying how the question, environment, and ground-truth answer are constructed and verified. Agents attempt to solve each task, producing solver trajectories and corresponding judge feedback which AutoSciBench uses to revise the recipe or concept, closing observed shortcuts and shifting tasks toward raw-data re-examination, interpretation of intermediate results, and evidence integration. Experience distilled from completed refinement trajectories further guides new concept generation, allowing lessons from earlier task refinement to inform subsequent benchmark construction. Starting from existing benchmarks, we evaluate AutoSciBench across computational biology, materials science, and clinical imaging. Generated benchmarks reduce average solver accuracy by 22.4 and 25.5 percentage points relative to the human-curated benchmarks in computational biology and materials science, respectively, while generated tasks receive higher average quality ratings across all three domains, suggesting that scientific-agent evaluation can adapt as agent capabilities advance.

AI.tldr: AutoSciBench 是一个自动生成并迭代演进科学智能体基准的框架，通过高层概念与低层配方表示任务，利用智能体求解轨迹与裁判反馈修正捷径、提升任务难度与质量，在计算生物学、材料科学、临床影像三大领域实验中，生成基准使求解器准确率大幅下降（分别降低 22.4 与 25.5 个百分点），且任务质量评分显著优于人工基准，证明科学智能体评估可随能力进化自适应更新。
AI.motivation: 现有基准随智能体能力提升迅速饱和，难以区分能力与暴露失效模式；科学领域基准构建耗时耦力、依赖领域专家，难以跟上智能体进步，亟需自动化、可迭代的基准生成与演进机制。
AI.method: 提出 AutoSciBench 框架：任务由高层概念（科学领域、数据模态、推理范式）与低层配方（题目构建、环境搭建、标准答案生成与验证）组成。智能体求解产生轨迹，裁判反馈用于修订配方或概念，封堵捷径、引导任务转向原始数据复查、中间结果解读与证据整合；已完成的演进轨迹经验蒸馏后指导新概念生成，实现跨任务知识迁移。
AI.result: 在计算生物学、材料科学、临床影像三领域实验：生成基准使平均求解器准确率较人工基准分别下降 22.4 与 25.5 个百分点（前两领域），三领域生成任务平均质量评分均显著高于人工基准，表明自动生成基准更难且质量更高。
AI.conclusion: AutoSciBench 验证了科学智能体基准可全自动生成并随能力迭代演进，通过闭环修正与经验蒸馏实现评估与智能体能力的共同进化，为持续、高质量的科学智能体评估提供了可行路径。

title: TempoBridge: Source-Conditioned Flow Matching with Optimal Transport Couplings for Single-Cell Population Transitions
summary: Destructive single-cell measurements provide unpaired population snapshots rather than observations of the same cells across conditions. Local cell states and transition requests may also be insufficient to distinguish responses across source populations. We introduce TempoBridge, a common source-conditioned transport formulation for temporal, genetic, and chemical population transitions. Source cells initialize latent transport and provide a fixed empirical population summary. The velocity field receives this summary alongside the evolving cell state, flow time, and a structured transition descriptor. Minibatch optimal transport (OT) supplies couplings only for conditional flow-matching training paths; inference requires neither target expression nor OT computation. On held-out donors, TempoBridge achieves an Energy distance of 0.129 versus 0.144 for scGen. Genetic mean-expression $L_2$ error is 2.261 versus 3.156 for scGPT-scratch under Seen 2/2. On held-out compounds, condition-averaged drug-effect correlation is 0.598 versus 0.561 for the CellFlow adapter. Temporal ablations show higher mean distributional error after removing source context, replacing optimal transport with random pairing, or replacing flow matching with static residual regression. Together, these results demonstrate the predictive utility of a common source-conditioned transport formulation across held-out donors, gene combinations, and compounds.

AI.tldr: TempoBridge 提出了一种基于共同源条件的传输公式，用于预测单细胞在时间、基因和化学扰动下的群体转换，利用源细胞初始化潜在传输并提供经验群体摘要，结合最优传输和流匹配进行训练，推理时无需目标表达或 OT 计算，在多种 held-out 场景下优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 破坏性单细胞测量只能提供不成对的群体快照，无法观察同一细胞在不同条件下的变化；局部细胞状态和转换请求不足以区分不同源群体的响应差异，因此需要一种能整合源群体信息的条件传输框架来预测群体水平的转换。
AI.method: TempoBridge 采用共同源条件传输公式：源细胞初始化潜在传输并提供固定的经验群体摘要；速度场接收该摘要、演化中的细胞状态、流时间和结构化转换描述符；使用小批量最优传输（OT）仅为条件流匹配训练路径提供耦合，推理阶段不需要目标表达也不需要 OT 计算。
AI.result: 在 held-out 捐赠者上，Energy distance 为 0.129（scGen 为 0.144）；基因平均表达 L2 误差为 2.261（scGPT-scratch 在 Seen 2/2 下为 3.156）；在 held-out 化合物上，条件平均药物效应相关性为 0.598（CellFlow adapter 为 0.561）。消融实验表明，移除源上下文、用随机配对替代 OT 或用静态残差回归替代流匹配均会增加平均分布误差。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果证明了共同源条件传输公式在 held-out 捐赠者、基因组合和化合物上的预测效用，展示了 TempoBridge 在单细胞群体转换预测中的优越性和泛化能力。

title: Word-Level Text Unmixing via Evidence-Preserving Ownership Routing with Language Models
summary: Text from multiple sources can become interleaved into a single sequence when attribution metadata is lost, such as overlapping speech transcripts, document reading flows, or concurrent agent streams. We formalize this challenge as Word-Level Text Unmixing: given an interleaved lexical stream and source count K, recover the original source sequences while preserving every word occurrence and its within-source order exactly. Directly generating separated texts with LLMs can omit, duplicate, or hallucinate words, violating this exact-reconstruction objective. We therefore propose Evidence-Preserving Ownership Routing (EPOR), which decouples source-ownership prediction from reconstruction. EPOR adapts a causal LLM to predict canonical ownership routes conditioned on the mixed stream and prior routing decisions. At inference, completion-safe constrained decoding is combined with deterministic indexed reconstruction, yielding structurally valid K-source partitions that preserve every observed occurrence exactly once. We also introduce UNMIXBENCH, covering controlled synthetic mixtures, timestamp-derived speech from AMI and ICSI, layout-derived document streams from ReadingBank, and simulated concurrent digital outputs. Across five evaluation tracks, a 4B EPOR model achieves the lowest mean minimum-permutation word error rate among finetuned baselines, reducing the five-track mean by 22.3% relative to compact source-array generation and remaining competitive with zero-shot frontier LLMs. These results show that when lexical evidence is fully observed, separating ownership inference from lexical regeneration provides a reliable alternative to direct generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出词级文本解混任务，旨在从交织的词流中恢复原始源序列并完全保留每个词的出现与顺序。针对大模型直接生成易丢词、重复或幻觉的问题，提出证据保留所有权路由（EPOR），将源归属预测与重建解耦，利用因果大模型预测规范所有权路径，配合约束解码与确定性索引重建，实现精确重构。在UNMIXBENCH五个测试轨道上，4B参数EPOR模型显著优于微调基线，五轨道平均词错误率降低22.3%，且与零样本前沿大模型竞争。表明当词汇证据完整观测时，将归属推理与词汇再生分离是可靠的替代方案。
AI.motivation: 多源文本在失去归属元数据后会交织成单一序列（如重叠语音转录、文档阅读流、并发智能体流），现有大模型直接生成分离文本易出现遗漏、重复或幻觉，无法满足精确重构每个词出现及其源内顺序的严格要求。
AI.method: 提出证据保留所有权路由（EPOR），将源归属预测与文本重建解耦。训练阶段：适配因果大模型，在给定混合流与先前路由决策条件下预测规范所有权路径。推理阶段：结合完备安全的约束解码与确定性索引重建，生成结构有效的K源划分，确保每个观测词汇精确出现一次。
AI.result: 在UNMIXBENCH五个评测轨道（合成混合、AMI/ICSI语音、ReadingBank文档流、模拟并发数字输出）上，4B参数EPOR模型在微调基线中达到最低平均最小排列词错误率，五轨道均值较紧凑源数组生成基线降低22.3%，性能与零样本前沿大模型相当。
AI.conclusion: 当词汇证据被完整观测时，将归属推理与词汇再生分离提供了一种可靠的替代直接生成的方案，能够实现精确的词级文本解混。

title: R1A-PC: Physics-Guided Electromagnetic Inversion of Three-Dimensional Human Point Clouds in Complex Static Environments
summary: Recovering three-dimensional human geometry from electromagnetic measure?ments in a complex static environment is difficult because strong multipath responses from walls, floors, and other objects obscure the weak target per?turbation. We propose R1A-PC, a physics-guided method that reconstructs a 2048-point human cloud from paired complex fields measured with and without the target. Complex background subtraction emphasizes target-induced ampli?tude and phase changes, while the background field remains available as an environmental condition. A frequency-balanced discrete Born adjoint produces a three-dimensional spatial knowledge map. At each of two bounded deformation stages, the decoder combines complex measurement features, background fea?tures, and multiscale physical features queried at the current point coordinates; the second stage queries again after the first coordinate update. We analyze the residual of paired subtraction, the weighted normal-operator structure of the raw adjoint, and the feasible set of the predicted cloud. In a held-out background generated by full-wave simulation under a fixed acquisition geometry, R1A-PC obtains a squared Chamfer distance of 0.001434 m2 and an F-score of 0.963080 at 0.05 m. Compared with TopNet, the Chamfer distance decreases by 70.28%. Removing physical guidance or background subtraction increases the Chamfer distance by 242.06% or 241.18%, respectively. Experiments across background layouts and poses support the complementary roles of paired subtraction and position-dependent adjoint features.

AI.tldr: 本文提出R1A-PC方法，利用配对复场测量和物理引导重建三维人体点云，通过复背景减除和频率平衡的离散Born伴随算子，在固定采集几何下实现高精度重建，显著优于TopNet。
AI.motivation: 在复杂静态环境中，墙壁、地面等物体的强多径响应掩盖了微弱的目标扰动，导致从电磁测量恢复三维人体几何极具挑战性。
AI.method: R1A-PC包含三大核心组件：1) 复背景减除：利用有/无目标的配对复场测量，强调目标引起的振幅相位变化，同时保留背景场作为环境条件；2) 频率平衡的离散Born伴随算子：生成三维空间知识图；3) 两阶段有界形变解码器：融合复测量特征、背景特征、多尺度物理特征，第二阶段在首次坐标更新后再次查询物理特征。
AI.result: 在全波仿真生成的保留背景下：平方Chamfer距离0.001434 m²，F-score 0.963080（@0.05m）。相比TopNet，Chamfer距离降低70.28%。消融实验显示：移除物理引导或背景减除分别使Chamfer距离增加242.06%和241.18%。
AI.conclusion: 跨背景布局和姿态的实验验证了配对减除与位置相关伴随特征的互补作用，物理引导与背景减除均为实现高精度重建的关键。

title: Bridging the EHR Divide: Asymmetric Contrastive Learning for Cross-National Medical Representation Transfer
summary: Cross-system transfer of longitudinal Electronic Health Record (EHR) representations is challenging because clinical coding, patient populations, and healthcare workflows differ substantially across institutions and countries. We introduce Asymmetric Supervised Contrastive Learning (Asymmetric SupCon), a task-specific pre-training objective motivated by the heterogeneity of negative clinical outcomes. The objective clusters patients sharing a target positive outcome without explicitly attracting negative trajectories toward one another. We pre-train temporal Transformer encoders on longitudinal records from 3.98 million patients in the Taiwanese National Health Insurance Research Database (NHIRD) and transfer them to two U.S. EHR datasets, MIMIC-IV and EHRSHOT. A hybrid semantic mapping pipeline combining direct mappings with embedding-based retrieval enables transfer across heterogeneous clinical vocabularies. On MIMIC-IV, NHIRD pre-training consistently improves over random initialization while substantially narrowing the performance gap to task-specific in-domain pre-training. On EHRSHOT, the transferred models show particularly strong few-shot performance for incident disease prediction. A controlled objective ablation shows that Asymmetric SupCon achieves the best AUPRC on three of four evaluated tasks and is 0.003 AUPRC below Standard SupCon on the fourth. These results support asymmetric contrastive pre-training as an effective approach for task-specific cross-national EHR representation transfer. Code is available at https://github.com/qingYzhang/Asymmetric_SupCon.

AI.tldr: 本文提出非对称监督对比学习（Asymmetric SupCon）用于跨系统纵向电子健康记录（EHR）表示迁移，在台湾国家健康保险研究数据库（NHIRD，398万患者）上预训练时序Transformer编码器，通过混合语义映射管道迁移至美国MIMIC-IV和EHRSHOT数据集，实验表明该方法在跨国EHR表征迁移任务中显著优于随机初始化，并缩小了与域内预训练的性能差距，尤其在小样本疾病预测任务中表现优异。
AI.motivation: 跨机构和跨国家的EHR系统在临床编码、患者群体及医疗工作流上存在显著异质性，导致纵向EHR表征的跨系统迁移极具挑战性；现有对比学习方法对负样本的处理未充分考虑临床负面结局的异质性，需要一种针对任务特定的预训练目标来更好地捕捉阳性结局患者的共同模式。
AI.method: 提出Asymmetric SupCon目标：仅将共享目标阳性结局的患者轨迹在表示空间中拉近，不显式吸引负样本轨迹聚集。采用混合语义映射管道（直接映射+基于嵌入的检索）解决异构临床词表间的词汇映射问题。在NHIRD大规模纵向记录上预训练时序Transformer编码器，随后迁移至MIMIC-IV和EHRSHOT进行下游任务微调。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-IV上，NHIRD预训练持续优于随机初始化，并大幅缩小与任务特定域内预训练的性能差距；在EHRSHOT上，迁移模型在新发疾病预测任务中展现出强的小样本性能。消融实验显示Asymmetric SupCon在四个评估任务中有三个取得最佳AUPRC，第四个任务仅比Standard SupCon低0.003 AUPRC。
AI.conclusion: 非对称对比预训练作为一种针对任务特定的跨国EHR表征迁移方法是有效的，能够利用大规模异构源域数据提升目标域下游临床预测任务的性能，尤其适合标注数据稀缺的小样本场景。

title: JEV versus LLMs: Accuracy, Cost and Calibration on Seven Political Science Replications
summary: Large language models (LLMs) annotate and scale political text or constructs by generating text tokens. A new class of models, which TypeSafe markets as "System One" models, instead returns decisions and probability distributions across a user-supplied fixed answer set. A commercial model, JEV, is advertised as having a dramatic cost and speed advantage over traditional LLMs along with better calibrated decisions. As such, it might be useful for social scientists looking to quickly and cost-effectively annotate or scale large corpora of text and have a reliable indicator of a classifier's uncertainty. Yet, the accuracy of these claims and the broader model accuracy in social science text-based tasks are not yet established. In this paper, we do just that and hope to establish the suitability of JEV for social science tasks. We compare JEV with LLMs and human coders from published research, and with a current mid-tier commercial LLM (GPT-6 Luna) and an open-weight alternative (Qwen3.8-27B). We find that JEV matches, or comes close to, the capabilities of both LLMs in a variety of tasks. However, we find no cost advantage over GPT-6 Luna at OpenAI's batch prices. Further, we find that, when each question is asked once, JEV's probabilities are better calibrated than GPT-6 Luna's token probabilities, but not consistently better than Qwen3.8-27B's. We conclude that unless researchers have a need for speed, JEV's only obvious advantage is ease of parsing the underlying choice probabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了TypeSafe推出的'System One'模型JEV在社会科学文本任务中的表现，对比了GPT-6 Luna和Qwen3.8-27B等LLM及人工编码。结果显示JEV性能接近LLM，但无成本优势，概率校准优于GPT-6 Luna但不稳定优于Qwen3.8-27B，主要优势在于解析选择概率的便捷性。
AI.motivation: 验证JEV声称的成本、速度优势及更好校准的决策，确立其在社会科学大规模文本标注与扩展任务中的适用性。
AI.method: 将JEV与已发表研究中的人工编码者、中端商业LLM（GPT-6 Luna）和开放权重模型（Qwen3.8-27B）在多种社会科学文本任务中进行对比评估。
AI.result: JEV在多项任务中匹配或接近两种LLM的能力；在OpenAI批量定价下无成本优势；单次提问时JEV的概率校准优于GPT-6 Luna的token概率，但不稳定优于Qwen3.8-27B。
AI.conclusion: 除非研究者需要速度，否则JEV唯一明显优势是易于解析底层选择概率。

title: Beyond Instruction Following: Learning Grounded Skill-Following with Skill Contracts
summary: Instruction following typically enforces discrete, response-level requirements, whereas an expert-authored skill prescribes procedural requirements spanning multiple phases and environment interactions. Given such a skill, we train the executor to execute all required phases instead of focusing solely on the final answer. We therefore introduce Grounded Skill-Following, which requires an agent to execute a fixed, expert-authored skill across its required phases by grounding decisions in environment observations. To achieve verifiable procedural execution, we formulate each skill as a skill contract combining visible skill instructions with an explicit contract runtime. The runtime specifies required phases, admissible actions, permitted transitions, and accepted termination. This structure provides a dense, verifiable training signal throughout execution. We leverage this by introducing Verified Progress Credit, which assigns rewards upon the initial completion of contract milestones and aggregates them into the trajectory return to guide policy optimization. During rollout, the contract runtime continuously tracks state transitions to provide Contract-State Feedback, which indicates whether the latest action is accepted and guides the agent toward valid next actions. To measure procedural compliance, we introduce the Protocol Completion Rate (PCR), defined as reaching accepted termination through all required phases, and decouple it from the final Task Outcome. Jointly trained with our framework, Qwen3.5-4B achieves Protocol Completion Rates of 99.27% on Math and 99.96% on Search, while slightly outperforming original baselines in Task Outcome (82.95% and 46.61%, respectively). Controlled studies examine how skill instructions, training signals, and contract-state feedback affect both metrics, while withholding interventions evaluate behavioral dependence on observation content.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Grounded Skill-Following 框架，将专家编写的技能形式化为包含显式运行时的技能合同，通过 Verified Progress Credit 和 Contract-State Feedback 提供稠密可验证的训练信号，实现程序化执行的高协议完成率（PCR），同时在任务结果上略优于基线。
AI.motivation: 现有指令遵循主要关注离散的响应级要求，而专家技能要求跨越多阶段、多环境交互的程序性要求。需要一种方法让执行器能按阶段执行技能，并基于环境观测落地决策，同时提供可验证的过程监督信号。
AI.method: 将每个技能建模为技能合同（技能指令 + 合同运行时），运行时规定必需阶段、允许动作、许可转移和接受终止。引入 Verified Progress Credit 在首次完成合同里程碑时给予奖励并聚合为轨迹回报；引入 Contract-State Feedback 实时反馈动作是否被接受并引导有效下一步动作。以 Protocol Completion Rate (PCR) 衡量程序合规性，将其与任务结果解耦。在 Qwen3.5-4B 上联合训练。
AI.result: Qwen3.5-4B 在 Math 和 Search 任务上分别达到 99.27% 和 99.96% 的 PCR，任务结果分别为 82.95% 和 46.61%，略优于原始基线。消融实验分析了技能指令、训练信号、合同状态反馈对两指标的影响，保留干预实验评估了对观测内容的行为依赖性。
AI.conclusion: Grounded Skill-Following 通过技能合同和稠密过程奖励有效实现了多阶段技能的程序化执行，显著提升了协议完成率且不损害任务性能，为复杂环境中的可验证技能遵循提供了新范式。

title: How Should Teachers Be Prepared? RL on Student-Induced States for On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) improves the reasoning capabilities of small language models through token-level teacher supervision on student-generated trajectories. Yet can teachers that excel at solving problems independently also guide student reasoning effectively?
