title: Rethinking Tabular Foundation Models On Data Streams
summary: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) outperform established machine learning models on tabular benchmarks through in-context learning. Building on this success, interest is growing in applying them to data streams, where data arrive continuously and evolve over time. On a stream, a TFM adapts by updating its context rather than its parameters, so its accuracy and cost depend on which examples it keeps and how often it rebuilds its context. We therefore present a systematic study of TFMs on data streams, covering memory management, computational cost, and stream-specific challenges such as concept drift and delayed labels. We find that TFMs achieve the highest predictive performance and that simply retaining the most recent examples is as effective as existing memory management techniques. They also recover faster than streaming learners after drift and keep the highest accuracy under label delay. This accuracy, however, comes at a high serving cost, since a nearly unchanged context is re-encoded at every prediction. These results point to architectural efficiency as the way forward for in-context stream learning.

AI.tldr: 表格基础模型 (TFMs) 在数据流上通过上下文学习表现优异，简单保留最近样本即可匹配现有记忆管理技术，且在概念漂移恢复和标签延迟下表现最好，但因每次预测需重新编码几乎不变的上下文导致服务成本高昂，未来需聚焦架构效率提升。
AI.motivation: TFMs 在表格基准测试中通过上下文学习超越传统机器学习模型，研究兴趣转向应用于持续演化的数据流场景。在数据流中，TFMs 通过更新上下文而非参数适应，其精度和成本取决于保留哪些样本及上下文重建频率，因此需要系统研究 TFMs 在数据流上的表现，涵盖记忆管理、计算成本及概念漂移、标签延迟等流特有挑战。
AI.method: 系统性实证研究：在数据流基准上评估 TFMs，对比不同记忆管理策略（包括简单保留最近样本与现有技术），测量预测性能、概念漂移恢复速度、标签延迟下的准确率，以及服务成本（上下文重新编码开销）。
AI.result: TFMs 实现最高预测性能；保留最近样本的简单策略与现有记忆管理技术效果相当；TFMs 在概念漂移后恢复更快，在标签延迟下保持最高准确率；但由于每次预测几乎都重新编码未变的上下文，导致服务成本极高。
AI.conclusion: TFMs 通过上下文学习在数据流上展现出强大的预测能力和鲁棒性，但当前的高服务成本限制了实际部署。研究指明提升架构效率（如避免重复编码不变上下文）是推进上下文学习在流式场景应用的关键方向。

title: Process Constitutions and Process Stewards: Towards the Next Generation of BPM for Agentic Organizations
summary: Business Process Management (BPM) was built on a foundational assumption that organizations are populated primarily by human actors whose work can be made visible, governable, and improvable through process models. That assumption is depreciating. AI agent ecosystems increasingly execute, coordinate, and adapt organizational work with limited human direction, challenging not only BPM's methods but its core conception of what a process is. We argue that BPM faces a constitutive shift from modeling human work to governing autonomous agents, for which we propose two new concepts: the \emph{Process Constitution}, a machine-interpretable, value-laden framework that defines the space of admissible agent behavior, and the \emph{Process Steward}, a governance agent that interprets and enforces it. The central value proposition of this new generation of BPM is not efficiency but \emph{organizational legibility}: the capacity to keep agentic organizations accountable, contestable, and humanly understandable. We outline what this means and sketch the research agenda it opens.

AI.tldr: 论文指出传统业务流程管理（BPM）建立在“人类执行者”假设上，但AI代理生态系统的兴起使该假设失效，提出从“建模人类工作”转向“治理自主代理”的范式转移，引入“流程宪章”（Process Constitution）与“流程管家”（Process Steward）两大核心概念，核心价值从效率转向“组织可读性”（organizational legibility），即让代理型组织保持可问责、可争辩、人类可理解。
AI.motivation: 当前BPM的理论基础假设组织主要由人类行动者构成，流程模型用于使其工作可见、可治理、可改进。然而，AI代理生态系统已能在有限人类指导下自主执行、协调、适应组织工作，动摇了BPM的方法论核心与流程本体论认知，亟需重构治理框架以应对自主代理带来的失控风险。
AI.method: 提出两大新概念构建治理新范式：1）流程宪章——机器可解释、带价值导向的框架，定义允许的代理行为空间；2）流程管家——治理型代理，负责解释并强制执行宪章。将BPM的核心价值主张从“效率”重定义为“组织可读性”，即保持代理型组织的可问责性、可争辩性与人类可理解性。
AI.result: 确立了从“流程建模”到“代理治理”的本构性转移（constitutive shift），给出了流程宪章与流程管家的形式化定位，明确了组织可读性作为新一代BPM核心指标的内涵，并勾勒出包含形式化规范、可验证合规、人机协同治理等方向的研究议程。
AI.conclusion: BPM必须从以人类工作为中心的建模学科，演进为以自主代理为治理对象的宪制性学科；流程宪章与流程管家为这一转型提供了最小可行的理论基座，未来研究需在规范语言、运行时监控、价值对齐、责任归属等维度展开，以确保代理型组织始终处于人类可理解与可控的边界内。

title: FACET: Factorized Asymmetric Conditioning for Efficient Transport in High-Fidelity Fluorescence Microscopy Synthesis
summary: Fluorescence microscopy reveals where proteins localize, but only a limited number of proteins can be imaged in the same cell; generating these images from amino-acid sequence and the cell's morphological context enables in silico localization of unimaged proteins. The two conditions, however, play asymmetric roles: morphological context is spatially aligned with the target, whereas sequence is non-spatial and must specify protein-dependent localization within it, with recurring coarse patterns shared across proteins and finer protein-specific variation. Existing generators condition on both jointly, without separating what each explains. We introduce FACET (Factorized Asymmetric Conditioning for Efficient Transport), a probabilistic generative framework that encodes this structure as an explicit inductive bias: sequence semantics are learned from what context leaves unexplained, coarse localization regularities are shared across proteins through a semantic memory, and protein-specific variation is a bounded residual around them. A variance-preserving state projection further lets FACET perform continuous stochastic transport through a pretrained diffusion predictor with minimal parameter overhead. On held-out proteins, FACET improves spatial overlap by 34.3% on the Human Protein Atlas and 14.0% on OpenCell over a backbone-matched baseline, and reduces FID by 27.2% and 46.5%, respectively, with 75% fewer network evaluations. It also substantially improves protein-association structure recovery and yields better-calibrated predictions, while detailed ablations show complementary contributions from its design choices. These results identify factorized asymmetric conditioning, rather than generator capacity alone, as a key lever for high-fidelity, efficient, and biologically meaningful cellular image synthesis.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 FACET，一种用于从氨基酸序列和细胞形态背景生成荧光显微镜图像的概率生成框架，通过显式的因式分解非对称条件机制，将序列语义与形态背景解耦，显著提升了未见蛋白的定位预测精度与生成效率。
AI.motivation: 荧光显微镜只能同时成像有限数量的蛋白；从氨基酸序列和细胞形态背景生成图像可实现未成像蛋白的硅基定位。现有生成器将序列与形态背景联合建模，未区分二者的非对称作用：形态背景与目标空间对齐，序列则是非空间的，需在背景内指定蛋白依赖的定位模式，且存在跨蛋白共享的粗略规律与蛋白特有的精细变异。
AI.method: FACET 引入因式分解非对称条件作为显式归纳偏置：1) 序列语义从形态背景未解释的残差中学习；2) 粗略定位规律通过语义记忆跨蛋白共享；3) 蛋白特异性变异建模为围绕共享规律的有界残差。另引入保方差状态投影，使 FACET 能以极小参数开销在预训练扩散预测器上执行连续随机传输。
AI.result: 在保留蛋白测试集上，FACET 相较于同骨干基线：空间重叠度在 Human Protein Atlas 提升 34.3%、在 OpenCell 提升 14.0%；FID 分别降低 27.2% 和 46.5%；网络评估次数减少 75%。同时显著改善蛋白关联结构恢复，预测校准更优，消融实验证实各设计选择的互补贡献。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明，因式分解非对称条件而非单纯扩大生成器容量，是实现高保真、高效且生物学意义的细胞图像合成的关键杠杆。

title: What Does a Harness Repair? A Preregistered Study of Visibility, Baseline Adequacy and Evaluation Defects
comment: 43 pages, 2 figures, 35 tables. Ancillary files in anc/: the frozen preregistration, its addenda (row keys of five rows withheld) and the aggregate analysis report, with a README
summary: Harness search keeps a change to the prompts, reasoning switches, token budgets or parsers around a frozen model if the change raises a score. Such a gain can come from answers the parser could not read before, a weak comparison, or a defect in the evaluation. We preregistered a study of where these gains come from, with three small models, three benchmarks, replication and test partitions, a GEPA search arm and six evaluation defects injected one at a time, and we report all 47 primary endpoints. Turning thinking off raised accuracy over a capped thinking setting in 5 of 9 model-benchmark cells, and in each the gain came mostly from questions where the capped setting gave no readable answer. The thinking-off setting was not meaningfully worse than a rescue configuration or four GEPA-selected harnesses in 11 of 13 comparisons, and lost to the rescue on GSM8K for two models. GEPA repaired its broken starting points, but none of its selected harnesses was more accurate than the thinking-off setting. A thinking budget in the serving engine, which also allows a longer answer, lowered truncation and raised the parse rate in 6 of 9 cells. In 6 of 15 evaluable defect-model pairs, replication through the same pipeline reproduced the defect's distortion instead of revealing it. On the LongevityBench multiple-choice tasks, only the longevity-tuned model beat the strongest constant-label baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了'束缚搜索'在冻结模型上通过调整提示、推理开关、token预算或解析器来提升分数的来源，发现关闭思考模式在多数情况下优于限制思考模式，且GEPA搜索虽能修复缺陷但不优于关闭思考模式。
AI.motivation: 探究束缚搜索带来的性能提升究竟源于真正的能力改进，还是来自解析器之前无法读取的答案、弱比较或评估缺陷。
AI.method: 预注册研究，使用三个小模型、三个基准测试、复制和测试分区、GEPA搜索臂，并注入六种评估缺陷，报告所有47个主要终点。
AI.result: 关闭思考模式在9个模型-基准单元格中有5个提升了准确率，增益主要来自限制思考模式无可读答案的问题；关闭思考模式在13次比较中有11次不显著劣于救援配置或GEPA选定的束缚，但在GSM8K上对两个模型落后；GEPA修复了其破损的起点，但选定的束缚均不优于关闭思考模式；服务引擎中的思考预算降低了6/9单元格的截断并提高了解析率；15个可评估缺陷-模型对中有6个通过同一管道复制重现了缺陷扭曲而非揭示它；在LongevityBench多选任务中，仅长寿调优模型击败了最强常数标签基线。
AI.conclusion: 束缚搜索的收益往往源于评估管道的伪影而非真实能力提升；关闭思考模式是一个强基线，GEPA搜索虽能修复缺陷但未超越该基线；复制实验可能无法揭示评估缺陷。

title: The Effect of Missingness-Pattern Mismatch on Method Selection for Time-Series Classification: A Controlled Empirical Study
summary: Classifiers for time-series classification are commonly selected on validation data, but the temporal pattern of missing observations at deployment may differ from the pattern seen during validation. We examine whether such a mismatch affects validation-based classifier selection. In a controlled $2 \times 2$ design, validation and test sets of 64 univariate UCR datasets were masked with either random point missingness or circular block missingness at six rates from 5% to 30%, imputed by linear interpolation, and used to select among three prespecified candidates: 1NN-DTW, MiniRocket with a Ridge classifier, and a statistical-feature Random Forest. Training data remained complete, and selections made under matched and mismatched validation patterns were compared on the same masked test sets. Mismatched validation reduced the test balanced accuracy of the selected classifier by 1.14 percentage points on average (95% CI 0.79 to 1.51), with losses on 49 of the 64 datasets. The loss was negligible at 5% missingness and increased to 2.46 percentage points at 30%. It was concentrated in point-masked deployment (1.84 percentage points), where block-masked validation shifted selection away from the usually best candidate, while the effect for block-masked deployment was small and not significant. Mismatch changed the selected classifier in 35.5% of paired comparisons, but a changed selection did not always reduce performance. A supplementary analysis with non-wrapping linear blocks reproduced these findings with a larger effect (1.67 percentage points). Matching the missingness pattern of validation data to the expected deployment pattern is therefore a simple safeguard for method selection, particularly at higher missingness rates.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了时间序列分类中验证集缺失模式与部署环境缺失模式不匹配对分类器选择的影响，实验表明模式不匹配会显著降低测试准确率，特别是在高缺失率和点缺失部署场景下，建议验证集缺失模式应与预期部署模式一致。
AI.motivation: 时间序列分类器通常基于验证数据选择，但部署时的缺失观测时间模式可能与验证阶段不同，这种不匹配是否会影响基于验证的分类器选择？
AI.method: 采用受控 2×2 设计，在 64 个 UCR 单变量数据集上，分别以随机点缺失和圆形块缺失（6 个缺失率 5%–30%）对验证集和测试集进行掩码，线性插值填补后，在三个预设候选分类器（1NN-DTW、MiniRocket+Ridge、统计特征随机森林）中选择；训练数据保持完整，比较匹配与不匹配验证模式下的选择在相同测试集上的表现。
AI.result: 不匹配验证导致测试平衡准确率平均下降 1.14 个百分点（95% CI 0.79–1.51），64 个数据集中有 49 个下降；5% 缺失时损失可忽略，30% 时增至 2.46 个百分点；损失主要集中在点缺失部署场景（1.84 个百分点），块缺失验证使选择偏离通常最优候选；块缺失部署场景影响小且不显著。不匹配在 35.5% 的配对比较中改变了所选分类器，但改变选择不一定降低性能。补充实验（非环绕线性块）复现结果且效应更大（1.67 个百分点）。
AI.conclusion: 将验证数据的缺失模式与预期部署模式对齐，是模型选择的简单有效保障，尤其在较高缺失率下至关重要。

title: Don't Judge an LLM Only by Its Activations: Discovering Suppressed Safety Features via Counterfactual Activation Potential
comment: 28 pages, 3 figures, 15 tables. Submitted to ICLR 2027
summary: Mechanistic interpretability has emerged as the primary means to understand safety behavior of LLMs. However, existing tools primarily focus on the activating neurons or features of a model. The role of the remaining large set of inactive components is invisible to such methods. This work demonstrates that the inactive set contains safety-critical features that are causally relevant for refusal of harmful prompts. Suppressing such features could turn refusals into compliance, while passing undetected by prevalent interpretability tools. We introduce the Counterfactual Activation Potential (CAP), a metric that quantifies a suppressed feature's latent activation tendency as the product of its encoder alignment (how strongly the input drives it), suppression strength (how strongly active features inhibit it), and safety criticality (how much refusal depends on it). To find suppressed safety features at scale, we propose CAP-guided Safety Feature Discovery (CSFD), a two-stage filtering algorithm that identifies candidate safety features from hundreds of thousands of transcoder features without exhaustive ablation. A significant fraction of trials turn compliant with harmful prompts when a candidate feature is ablated. Under natural jailbreaks, the suppression acting on the highest-CAP features rises 2-4x, and their activation correspondingly falls by up to 80%. Amplifying a feature's suppressors pushes its activation down and raises harmful compliance with prompts related to the suppressed feature, with no such effect for random features. Our experiments span five Gemma, Qwen, and Llama models across various parameter sizes. Our findings indicate that jailbreaks could operate in part by suppressing safety-critical features rather than solely activating harmful ones, and that suppressed features are a necessary complement to activation-focused interpretability of safety behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文发现大语言模型中被抑制的非激活特征包含关键安全特征，提出CAP指标和CSFD算法来识别这些特征，实验表明越狱攻击部分通过抑制安全特征而非仅激活有害特征起作用，被抑制特征是安全行为解释性的必要补充。
AI.motivation: 现有机制性解释性工具主要关注激活的神经元或特征，忽视了大量非激活组件的作用。研究动机是揭示这些被抑制特征中包含因果相关的安全关键特征，它们对拒绝有害提示至关重要，但被主流解释性工具忽略。
AI.method: 提出Counterfactual Activation Potential (CAP)指标，量化被抑制特征的潜在激活倾向，计算为编码器对齐度×抑制强度×安全关键性的乘积。开发CAP引导的安全特征发现(CSFD)两阶段筛选算法，从数十万超编码器特征中识别候选安全特征，无需详尽消融实验。在Gemma、Qwen、Llama五个不同规模模型上进行实验验证。
AI.result: 消融候选特征显著比例使模型对有害提示从拒绝转为服从。自然越狱下，最高CAP特征的抑制强度上升2-4倍，激活下降高达80%。放大特征的抑制因子降低其激活并增加相关有害提示的服从率，随机特征无此效应。
AI.conclusion: 越狱攻击部分通过抑制安全关键特征而非仅激活有害特征起作用。被抑制特征是激活聚焦解释性的必要补充，安全行为的完整理解需要同时考虑激活和被抑制的特征。

title: Grounded Joint-Attention Other-Play for Zero-Shot Coordination
summary: Joint attention - the human ability to share a common visual or cognitive focus with others - enables a meeting of minds that lets us coordinate even with unfamiliar partners. In this work we investigate whether equipping AI agents with a similar mechanism can enable such zero-shot coordination. We introduce Mutual Attention for zero-shot TEaming (MATE): a novel multi-agent reinforcement learning method inspired by human joint attention. MATE encourages agents to coordinate their actions by aligning their visual attention on scene-salient objects during the interaction rather than relying on arbitrary partner-dependent conventions established during training. Unlike symmetry-breaking approaches that merely prevent brittle conventions from emerging, MATE actively promotes coordination through an environment-grounded signal that is naturally shared across partners. We evaluate MATE on three benchmarks: our Card Alignment Game, designed to isolate brittle convention formation, and the more challenging Level-Based Foraging and OvercookedV2 benchmarks. Our experiments consistently show that a joint-attention-inspired signal improves coordination with unknown partners, underlining MATE's potential as a general coordination mechanism that complements and surpasses symmetry-breaking approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MATE（Mutual Attention for zero-shot TEaming），一种受人类共同注意启发的多智能体强化学习方法，通过在交互过程中对齐智能体对场景显著物体的视觉注意，实现零样本协调，优于现有的对称性打破方法。
AI.motivation: 人类通过共同注意能够与陌生伙伴协调，现有多智能体强化学习方法依赖训练中形成的依赖伙伴的约定，导致零样本协调能力差。现有的对称性打破方法仅防止脆弱约定的出现，而非主动促进协调。
AI.method: MATE 引入共同注意机制，鼓励智能体在交互过程中将视觉注意对齐到场景显著物体上，利用环境接地的共享信号主动促进协调，而非依赖训练中形成的任意伙伴依赖约定。
AI.result: 在 Card Alignment Game、Level-Based Foraging 和 OvercookedV2 三个基准上实验表明，MATE 持续提升与未知伙伴的协调性能，验证了共同注意信号作为通用协调机制的有效性，且优于对称性打破方法。
AI.conclusion: 受人类共同注意启发的 MATE 方法为零样本协调提供了一个通用且有效的机制，通过环境接地的共享注意信号主动促进智能体间协调，超越了现有的对称性打破方法，展示了广泛的应用潜力。

title: Robust Ensemble Guidance for Scientific Inverse Problems
summary: Ensemble guidance combines pretrained diffusion priors with black-box forward models to solve inverse problems without differentiating through the physical simulator. However, observation coordinates with large predictive spread or extreme residuals can dominate the ensemble correction, degrading reconstruction accuracy. We show that two simple modifications, weighting and clipping, substantially improve this correction. Our method, Robust Ensemble Guidance (REG), uses ensemble predictive spread to balance observation scales and adaptively clips standardized residuals to limit the influence of extreme discrepancies. Both operations reuse existing particles and forward predictions, requiring no additional denoiser or forward-model evaluations. Under a local linear Gaussian model, we derive conditions for reduced one-step estimation risk, bound the influence of individual observation coordinates, and characterize when these benefits persist with finite ensembles. Experiments on Navier-Stokes inversion, black-hole imaging, and acoustic full-waveform inversion demonstrate improved reconstruction over the underlying ensemble solver. In particular, REG increases black-hole reconstruction PSNR by 6.2-8.2 dB across three observation regimes and reduces Navier-Stokes reconstruction error by 26.4\% in a matched-budget comparison. These findings highlight the importance of observation heterogeneity and residual influence in designing reliable generative solvers for scientific inverse problems.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了鲁棒集成引导（REG），通过加权和裁剪两个简单修改，解决集成引导中观测坐标预测分布大或残差极端主导集成校正导致重建精度下降的问题。REG利用集成预测分布平衡观测尺度，自适应裁剪标准化残差限制极端差异影响，无需额外去噪器或前向模型评估。理论分析给出了降低单步估计风险的条件，并界定了单个观测坐标的影响。实验在纳维-斯托克斯反演、黑洞成像和声波全波形反演中验证了REG的优越性，黑洞重建PSNR提升6.2-8.2 dB，纳维-斯托克斯重建误差降低26.4%。
AI.motivation: 集成引导结合预训练扩散先验与黑盒前向模型求解反问题，但观测坐标的预测分布大或极端残差会主导集成校正，降低重建精度。现有方法未充分考虑观测异质性和残差影响，导致生成式求解器在科学反问题中不可靠。
AI.method: 提出鲁棒集成引导（REG），包含两个核心修改：1）加权：利用集成预测分布平衡观测尺度；2）裁剪：自适应裁剪标准化残差以限制极端差异的影响。两者均复用现有粒子和前向预测，无需额外去噪器或前向模型评估。在局部线性高斯模型下，推导了降低单步估计风险的条件，界定了单个观测坐标的影响，并刻画了有限集成下收益持续的条件。
AI.result: 在纳维-斯托克斯反演、黑洞成像和声波全波形反演实验中，REG优于基础集成求解器。黑洞重建PSNR在三种观测机制下提升6.2-8.2 dB；纳维-斯托克斯重建误差在匹配预算下降低26.4%。
AI.conclusion: 观测异质性和残差影响是设计可靠生成式科学反问题求解器的关键因素。REG通过简单的加权和裁剪有效缓解了这些问题，显著提升了重建精度，且无需额外计算开销。

title: Expanding LLM Reasoning
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS Main Conference '26 with a score of 4.33
summary: Extra inference compute is usually spent on sampling more reasoning chains. We study where inside an existing chain an additional continuation should begin. We define expansion utility, the change in correctness from restarting a chain at a stored step, and measure it at every eligible step for nine models on six benchmarks (41 model and benchmark cells). Restart position matters: steps selected on one set of continuations beat uniform placement when scored on disjoint ones, in held-out audits on 5, 16, and 38 cells (+4.25 points [+2.51, +6.63] in a fresh five-cell audit). A fixed rule that restarts from the last eligible steps, always-last, is a strong baseline: our learned router beats uniform placement but shows no detected gain over it, and on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B/MATH-500 always-last exceeds the exact self-consistency frontier at matched aggregate generated output by +0.052 [+0.008, +0.098], using 0.774x the aggregate generated output of four-sample self-consistency. Cross-fitted oracle selection still finds held-out headroom beyond declared positional classes, a target for future selectors. Finally, breaking step-label ties by earliest index flips the sign of a pointwise selector's gain over uniform placement in every seed of a five-seed diagnostic with four rollouts per step; randomized ties remove the bias.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在推理链的何处重启续写能最大化正确率提升，定义“扩展效用”并在9模型×6基准（41细胞）上实测。发现重启位置显著影响性能：基于部分续写选出的步骤在保留集上优于均匀采样（+4.25分）。固定规则“总是从最后合格步重启”是强基线，学习型路由虽胜均匀采样但未超越该基线；在DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B/MATH-500上，always-last以0.774×的生成量超越4样本自一致性前沿+0.052。交叉拟合神谕仍显示位置类别之外的提升空间；步骤标签平局处理（最早索引 vs 随机）会翻转点选器相对均匀采样的增益符号。
AI.motivation: 推理时额外计算通常用于采样更多完整推理链，但可在现有链中间插入续写。核心问题是：在链的哪个步骤重启续写能带来最大正确率提升？
AI.method: 定义扩展效用（重启后正确率变化），在9个模型、6个基准的41个模型-基准细胞上，对每个合格步骤测量效用。用部分续写训练/选择重启步骤，在不相交续写上评估；对比均匀采样、always-last基线、学习型路由器、交叉拟合神谕；在DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B/MATH-500上与自一致性前沿对比；诊断平局处理（最早索引 vs 随机）对点选器增益的影响。
AI.result: 1. 重启位置关键：基于部分续写选步骤在保留集上击败均匀采样（5/16/38细胞显著，新鲜5细胞审计+4.25分[+2.51,+6.63]）。2. always-last是强基线：学习路由胜均匀采样但未检测到超越always-last。3. DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B/MATH-500上，always-last以0.774×生成量超越4样本自一致性前沿+0.052[+0.008,+0.098]。4. 交叉拟合神谕显示声明位置类别外仍有提升空间。5. 平局处理偏差：最早索引在5种种子/4轮滚动中每次翻转点选器相对均匀采样的增益符号；随机平局消除偏差。
AI.conclusion: 在现有推理链中插入续写时，重启位置选择至关重要。简单固定规则always-last已是强基线，超越自一致性前沿且生成量更少；学习型选择器尚未稳定超越该基线。未来选择器可挖掘位置类别之外的隐含提升空间；实验设计中须注意步骤标签平局处理引入的偏差。

title: RocketAgent: A Long-Horizon Engineering Agent for Multidisciplinary Design of Liquid-Rocket Thrust Chambers
summary: Liquid-rocket thrust-chamber design involves interdependent analyses in which downstream constraints can require earlier design decisions to be revisited. Managing these dependencies across heterogeneous tools requires consistent design information and coordinated updates throughout the workflow. We present RocketAgent, a long-horizon engineering agent for multidisciplinary preliminary design of liquid-rocket thrust chambers. A single plan-owning Coding Agent coordinates engineering skills for performance sizing, subsystem optimization, geometry generation, and multiphysics assessment. A provenance-aware knowledge graph supports method selection, while a typed Design Intermediate Representation maintains shared parameters, artifacts, and decisions. Revision-aware checks invalidate affected results and block superseded inputs, with consequential changes subject to engineering approval. In a representative simulation-based design, RocketAgent continued from an infeasible cooling search through an engineer-authorized operating-point revision, identified feasible subsystem designs, and coordinated subsequent geometry generation and multiphysics assessment to support final configuration selection. Separate module tests assessed surrogate predictions and nozzle adaptation. A two-configuration comparison across three controlled scenarios verified the expected dependency invalidations and superseded-input blocking before solver execution. The representative case demonstrates sustained coordination across a multidisciplinary design workflow, while the controlled tests establish the behavior of the revision mechanisms supporting that execution.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了RocketAgent，一种用于液体火箭推力室多学科初步设计的长时程工程智能体，通过计划拥有的编码智能体协调工程技能，利用溯源感知知识图谱和类型化设计中间表达管理依赖关系，实现了跨异构工具的一致设计信息和协调更新。
AI.motivation: 液体火箭推力室设计涉及相互依赖的分析，下游约束可能要求重新审视早期设计决策。跨异构工具管理这些依赖需要一致的设计信息和协调的工作流更新，现有方法难以支持长时程、多学科的协同设计。
AI.method: 1. 单一计划拥有的编码智能体协调性能尺寸设计、子系统优化、几何生成和多物理场评估等工程技能。2. 溯源感知知识图谱支持方法选择。3. 类型化设计中间表达（DIR）维护共享参数、制品和决策。4. 修订感知检查使受影响结果失效并阻止被取代的输入，后续变更需工程师批准。
AI.result: 在代表性仿真设计中，RocketAgent从不可行的冷却搜索开始，经工程师授权的工作点修订，识别可行子系统设计，协调后续几何生成和多物理场评估以支持最终配置选择。模块测试评估了代理预测和喷管适应。双配置对比的三个受控场景验证了求解器执行前的依赖失效和被取代输入阻塞行为。
AI.conclusion: 代表性案例展示了跨多学科设计工作流的持续协调能力，受控测试确立了支持该执行的修订机制行为。RocketAgent为液体火箭推力室初步设计提供了有效的长时程工程智能体框架。 }

title: Distributed Subliminal Learning: Replacing Model Updates with Random-Carrier Outputs
comment: Accepted to the Collaborative, Open, and DECentralized training of Foundation Models workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Collaborative learning typically exchanges model parameters: federated clients communicate updates, while independently adapted foundation models are combined by exchanging adapters or checkpoints. This makes communication scale with model size and requires local specializations to be reconciled in weight space, where interference is common. We ask whether knowledge can instead be shared through model behavior on task-unrelated inputs. We introduce Distributed Subliminal Learning (DSL), a collaborative learning primitive in which participants adapt a common model locally, probe it with task-unrelated inputs, and transmit only the resulting carrier outputs. A coordinator pools these outputs and distills them into a shared model. The primitive supports one-shot foundation-model composition through carrier completions and iterative federated learning through carrier logits, without transmitting model updates or requiring task-related proxy data. In LLM composition, compared with LoRA averaging, DSL achieves higher preference retention (94.56% vs. 87.76%) and a larger GSM8K gain over the base model (22.0 vs. 0.6 points), while reducing upload by 30.6-49.0$\times$. In federated classification, DSL reaches 96.83% on MNIST with 8.9$\times$ less uplink than FedAvg and provides lower-communication operating points on CIFAR-10 and Tiny ImageNet. These results establish random-carrier outputs as a practical communication primitive for knowledge sharing across distinct collaborative learning paradigms.

title: ColdDDI: Evaluating Knowledge Utilization in Cold-Start Drug-Drug Interaction Prediction
summary: Cold-start drug-drug interaction (DDI) prediction tests whether models can identify clinically significant interactions for drugs without training-time interaction history. Existing benchmarks mostly report aggregate edge-prediction scores, leaving a key evaluation question unanswered: when models receive molecular, textual, or knowledge-graph (KG) evidence, do they actually use the evidence that pharmacologically supports the interaction? We introduce ColdDDI, a reconstructible diagnostic benchmark built from DrugBank 5.1.13, with 1,900 approved small-molecule drugs and 565,731 positive DDI pairs. ColdDDI evaluates pairs with zero, one, or two unseen drugs. It also annotates each interaction by whether it changes drug exposure or drug effect, and by whether the biomedical knowledge graph contains shared enzymes, transporters, or targets that can plausibly mediate the interaction. These annotations separate evidence availability from predictive dependence. We evaluate eight conventional DDI methods and 13 LLMs; for open-weight LLMs, we test five prompt patterns and use masking, drug replacement, and channel-sensitivity metrics to probe knowledge utilization. ColdDDI exposes that, in the hardest split where both drugs are unseen, the main performance divide is mediator availability. A fine-tuned 1B LLM recovers 89-93% of interactions with a shared enzyme, transporter, or target, but only 40-62% without such a mediator. More importantly, KG-provided evidence is not always used; several KG-augmented baselines change little when the shared mediator is masked or disrupted, whereas fine-tuned LLMs respond strongly to this intervention. Thus, ColdDDI evaluates knowledge utilization rather than knowledge access alone, showing where cold-start DDI models rely on mechanistic evidence and where they fail despite receiving it. Code is available at https://github.com/0217ljh/ColdDDI-NeurIPS2026.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ColdDDI 基准，用于评估冷启动药物-药物相互作用（DDI）预测中模型对药理学证据的实际利用情况，而非单纯的知识获取。实验表明，在双药物均未见的最难分割中，共享酶/转运体/靶点等中介者的可用性决定性能分水岭；微调后的 1B LLM 能利用机制证据，而 KG 增强基线模型对证据屏蔽不敏感。
AI.motivation: 现有冷启动 DDI 基准多报告聚合边预测分数，未回答模型在接收到分子、文本或知识图谱（KG）证据时，是否真正利用了药理学上支持相互作用的证据。需要一个可重构的诊断性基准，将证据可获得性与预测依赖性分离，探究模型对机制证据的实际利用。
AI.method: 基于 DrugBank 5.1.13 构建 ColdDDI，包含 1,900 个获批小分子药物和 565,731 个阳性 DDI 对。按零、一、两个未见药物分割；标注相互作用是否改变药物暴露或药物效应，以及 KG 中是否存在共享酶、转运体或靶点等合理中介者。评估 8 种传统 DDI 方法和 13 个 LLM；对开放权重 LLM 测试 5 种提示模式，并通过掩码、药物替换和通道敏感性指标探测知识利用。
AI.result: 在双药物均未见的最难分割中，性能分水岭在于中介者可用性。微调后的 1B LLM 对有共享中介者的相互作用恢复率达 89-93%，无中介者时仅 40-62%。KG 增强基线在中介者被掩码或破坏时性能变化不大，而微调 LLM 对该干预强烈响应，揭示了知识利用而非知识获取的差异。
AI.conclusion: ColdDDI 通过将证据可得性与预测依赖性分离，评估模型对机制证据的实际利用。结果显示冷启动 DDI 模型在有中介者时依赖机制证据，但即便接收到证据也可能在无中介者时失效。基准代码已开源，为诊断模型知识利用行为提供了工具。

title: Benchmarking Jailbreak Guardrails for Embodied Agents
summary: Embodied agents powered by large language models and vision-language models are increasingly deployed in physical environments, but jailbreak attacks can induce these agents to perform physically harmful actions. A growing number of guardrail methods have been proposed to intercept dangerous behavior before it is executed, yet existing safety benchmarks evaluate the embodied models themselves, leaving it unclear how well these guardrails actually defend an embodied agent in practice. We present the first systematic evaluation of jailbreak guardrails for embodied agents. To compare guardrails under identical conditions, we build a pluggable evaluation framework that treats the embodied agent as a fixed backend and each guardrail as a module that can intervene at the perception, planning, or control stage. We subject six representative guardrails to template-based and automated jailbreak attacks as well as safe instructions, and assess them at the system level along three dimensions: defense effectiveness, measured by the bypass rate and the hazard success rate in the simulator; usability, measured by the false-positive rate and the task completion rate on safe instructions; and efficiency, measured by the latency overhead added at runtime. Experiments on guardrails that span different intervention stages, decision mechanisms, and input modalities reveal a clear trade-off among the three dimensions, and show that no single guardrail dominates in all settings. We further analyze how intervention stage, decision mechanism, and input modality shape safety outcomes, and we offer practical guidance for selecting and designing guardrails for embodied agents.

AI.tldr: 该论文首次系统评估了针对具身智能体的越狱护栏，构建了可插拔评估框架，在感知、规划、控制三阶段测试六种代表性护栏，从防御有效性、可用性、效率三维度量化权衡，揭示无单一护栏全优，并提供选型设计指导。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型和视觉语言模型驱动的具身智能体越来越多部署于物理环境，越狱攻击可诱导其执行物理有害动作。虽有越来越多护栏方法被提出以在执行前拦截危险行为，但现有安全基准仅评估具身模型本身，护栏在实际部署中对具身智能体的防御效果仍不清楚。
AI.method: 构建可插拔评估框架，将具身智能体作为固定后端，护栏作为可在感知、规划、控制阶段干预的模块。选取六种代表性护栏，施以模板化和自动化越狱攻击及安全指令，在仿真器中从系统层面沿三维度评估：防御有效性（绕过率、危害成功率）、可用性（误报率、安全指令任务完成率）、效率（运行时延迟开销）。
AI.result: 实验揭示三维度间存在明显权衡，无单一护栏在所有设置下均占优。进一步分析了干预阶段、决策机制、输入模态对安全结果的影响，并给出了为具身智能体选择和设计护栏的实用指导。
AI.conclusion: 首个系统性评估确立了具身智能体越狱护栏的基准评测范式，量化了防御-可用性-效率的三元权衡，为实际部署中的护栏选型与设计提供了实证依据与原则性建议。

title: Does Explainability Survive Data Drift?
summary: Model performance monitoring is a standard practice in machine learning deployments. Detection performance is tracked continuously, and model decay is expected as the relationship between the feature and target variables degrades, a phenomenon known as concept drift. Explanation fidelity, however, is rarely monitored with the same discipline, even in domains such as financial systems, healthcare, and other regulated environments where explanations are required for governance purposes. This paper investigates whether explanations can decay under data drift, even when the feature-target relationship remains stable, and whether explanations produced before drift occurs remain faithful to the decisions of the model that replaces them. Using the IEEE-CIS Transaction Fraud Detection dataset, we find statistically significant covariate shift but no statistically significant evidence of concept drift under the implemented conditional-drift tests, thereby providing an empirical setting in which input distributional change can be studied separately from detectable changes in the feature-target relationship. Local explanations are generated with ExIFFI and evaluated at three levels: path validity, structural behaviour, and fidelity under controlled intervention. Results show that while prior explanations retain substantial decision relevance to a retrained model, they are consistently less faithful than newly generated explanations, with no evidence of a systematically widening gap across the evaluated windows. The study shows that explanation fidelity requires its own monitoring, that structural stability of explanations does not guarantee functional fidelity, and that explanations should be treated as artifacts tied to the model that produced them.

AI.tldr: 论文研究解释在数据漂移下是否会衰减，即使特征-目标关系稳定，以及漂移前的解释是否仍忠实于替代模型的决策。使用欺诈检测数据集，发现协变量漂移显著但无概念漂移证据。解释保留决策相关性但忠实度低于新生成的解释，解释忠实度需单独监控，结构稳定不保证功能忠实，解释应视为与生成它的模型绑定的工件。
AI.motivation: 模型性能监控是标准实践，但解释忠实度很少被同等监控，尤其在需要解释用于治理的金融、医疗等受监管领域。研究解释是否会在数据漂移下衰减，即使特征-目标关系稳定，以及旧解释对新模型的忠实度。
AI.method: 使用IEEE-CIS交易欺诈检测数据集，实施条件漂移测试检测协变量漂移和概念漂移。用ExIFFI生成局部解释，在三个层面评估：路径有效性、结构行为、受控干预下的忠实度。比较漂移前的解释与重新训练模型生成的新解释。
AI.result: 发现统计显著的协变量漂移但无统计显著的概念漂移证据。旧解释保留大量决策相关性，但始终低于新生成解释的忠实度，且评估窗口间无系统性扩大差距的证据。
AI.conclusion: 解释忠实度需要独立监控；解释的结构稳定性不保证功能忠实性；解释应被视为与生成它们的模型绑定的工件。

title: On Impact of Loss Function on the Performance of Neural Networks in Melanoma Diagnosis
comment: Presented at the 30th Conference on Medical Image Understanding and Analysis (MIUA 2026)
summary: Melanoma is the deadliest type of skin cancer, whose early diagnosis is crucial for patients' survival. Image classification using deep learning models has shown promising results for melanoma diagnosis. However, the performance of these models on the melanoma datasets such as SIIM-ISIC melanoma classification dataset is a challenge due to the class imbalance. One of the methods to deal with this challenge is using loss function modifications. In this work, we have investigated the effect of different loss functions on the performance of deep neural networks. We trained these networks using focal loss, logit-adjusted softmax cross-entropy (CE) loss, and weighted softmax CE loss, and we report different metrics for evaluating performance and uncertainty calibration. Our results suggest that focal loss delivers a good combination of performance in terms of AUC and uncertainty calibration in terms of expected calibration error (ECE) simultaneously.

AI.tldr: 论文研究了不同损失函数在黑色素瘤分类任务中处理类别不平衡问题的效果，发现在AUC性能和不确定性校准（ECE）方面，Focal Loss表现最佳。
AI.motivation: 黑色素瘤是最致命的皮肤癌，早期诊断对患者生存至关重要。深度学习图像分类虽显示出前景，但在SIIM-ISIC等黑色素瘤数据集上因类别不平衡导致性能受限，需探索有效的损失函数改进方法。
AI.method: 训练深度神经网络并对比三种损失函数：Focal Loss、Logit-adjusted Softmax Cross-Entropy Loss和Weighted Softmax Cross-Entropy Loss，使用多种指标评估分类性能（AUC）和不确定性校准（ECE）。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，Focal Loss在AUC性能指标和期望校准误差（ECE）不确定性校准指标上同时取得良好表现，优于其他两种损失函数。
AI.conclusion: 针对黑色素瘤分类的类别不平衡问题，Focal Loss能同时提供优秀的分类性能和不确定性校准能力，是处理该任务的有效损失函数选择。

title: Voltic: Distinguishing Volatility from Stochasticity in Recurrent Memory
summary: Recurrent sequence models must decide how strongly to overwrite their memory at each token. Read as Bayesian filtering, this write is the gain of a Kalman update, set by uncertainty from two sources that pull it in opposite directions: volatility, how quickly the underlying associations change, and stochasticity, how noisy each observation of them is. First, we show that the update of gated delta-rule memories is the form this filter takes under isotropic uncertainty. Next, we introduce Voltic, a recurrent memory that keeps the covariance anisotropic and makes both noise variances input-dependent, so the write is vector-valued and carries uncertainty accumulated over the sequence. A dense covariance would have to be propagated token by token, ruling out the parallel training these models depend on. We therefore give two assumed-density approximations, diagonal and quasi-diagonal, both of which leave the memory update in delta-rule form and reuse its chunked kernels. On controlled recall tasks in which associations change and observations are corrupted, Voltic leads all baselines. On the task combining volatility and stochasticity, its margin over the strongest baseline is larger at both extrapolation sizes than at the training sizes. In 45M-parameter language models it leads an eight-task reasoning average and achieves higher retrieval accuracy beyond the training context length than gated baselines, at throughput close to those baselines. Deriving the write from an uncertainty recursion therefore makes memory more responsive to change.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Voltic，一种基于不确定性递归的循环记忆模型，将记忆写入视为卡尔曼滤波增益，引入各向异性协方差与输入相关的噪声方差，通过对角和准对角假设密度近似保持Delta规则形式并支持并行训练，在受控回忆任务和45M语言模型推理基准上优于基线，并在外推长度上表现更优。
AI.motivation: 现有门控Delta规则记忆模型将写入强度视为固定标量，无法同时响应关联变化的波动性和观测噪声的随机性；需要一种能够累积序列不确定性、自适应调节写入强度的机制，使记忆对变化更敏感。
AI.method: 1. 将记忆更新建模为贝叶斯滤波中的卡尔曼增益，引入各向异性协方差矩阵；2. 使过程噪声（波动性）和观测噪声（随机性）均依赖于输入；3. 提出对角和准对角两种假设密度近似，保持协方维护在Delta规则形式，复用分块核实现并行训练；4. 写入变为向量值，携带累积的不确定性信息。
AI.result: 在结合波动性和随机性的受控回忆任务中，Voltic在训练规模和外推规模上均显著领先最强基线；在45M参数语言模型上，八任务推理平均分领先，且在训练上下文长度之外的检索准确率高于门控基线，吞吐量接近基线。
AI.conclusion: 从不确定性递归推导写入机制，使记忆能自适应地响应关联变化与观测噪声，Voltic通过各向异性协方差与输入相关噪声建模，在保持训练并行性的前提下实现了更优的记忆更新，验证了不确定性驱动写入的有效性。

title: Impact of Data Augmentation on Confidence Calibration in Melanoma Classification
comment: Presented at the 30th Conference on Medical Image Understanding and Analysis (MIUA 2026)
summary: Accurately quantifying the predictive uncertainty or improving model calibration plays an important role in medical image classification, in particular in melanoma diagnosis, where accurate uncertainty quantification can have significant implications for patient care. One of the methods for calibration improvement is data augmentation. In addition, data augmentation as a method for synthetically increasing the size of the dataset has been proven to improve the performance of models trained on imbalanced datasets. However, the impact of data augmentation, as a transformation of a part of the original data, on calibration of models trained on imbalanced datasets, in particular in melanoma classification is under-explored. We train neural networks on SIIM-ISIC 2020 melanoma classification dataset under two conditions: with and without data augmentation, and compare the differences in AUC and expected calibration error (ECE) in both scenarios. Our results shows improvements in uncertainty calibration using different augmentation methods.

AI.tldr: 本文研究数据增强对黑色素瘤分类中神经网络校准性能的影响，在SIIM-ISIC 2020数据集上对比有无数据增强下的AUC和ECE，发现数据增强能提升不确定性校准。
AI.motivation: 医学图像分类中准确量化预测不确定性或改善模型校准至关重要，特别是在黑色素瘤诊断中；数据增强可提升不平衡数据集上的模型性能，但其对校准的影响尚未充分探索。
AI.method: 在SIIM-ISIC 2020黑色素瘤分类数据集上训练神经网络，分别使用和不使用数据增强，对比两种条件下的AUC和期望校准误差(ECE)。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，不同数据增强方法均能改善不确定性校准。
AI.conclusion: 数据增强作为原始数据的变换，能有效提升不平衡数据集上黑色素瘤分类模型的校准性能，为临床决策提供更可靠的不确定性估计。

title: Efficient Graph Generation via Direct Prediction and Flow Matching
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Geometric Distributional Deep Learning (Oral)
summary: Generative modeling of graph-structured data is crucial for tasks ranging from drug discovery to social network simulation. Among these models, denoising diffusion models have achieved great success in graph generation by learning to progressively reverse a process that adds noise to the original graph. However, the standard noise-prediction approach of diffusion models is suboptimal for graph data. The goal for a graph generative model is to learn the clean graphs' topological properties, such as connectivity and degree distribution. Because a diffusion model that predicts noise does not explicitly learn these topological properties, it is challenging for the model to output graphs with the desired structural statistics. To address this challenge, we introduce Direct Graph Flow Matching (DiGFM), a novel graph transformer model guided by two goals: predict clean graphs and improve sampling efficiency. Distinct from the prevailing diffusion approach, DiGFM employs a continuous flow-matching paradigm and integrates direct graph prediction. Specifically, DiGFM maps the prior noise distribution to the clean graph distribution via a multi-step process: the model repeatedly predicts the underlying clean graph, and a transformation is employed to convert the model output to the velocity vector that points in the direction toward the clean graph distribution. This design enables DiGFM to generate high-quality samples using only 2.5% to 15.6% of the steps required by diffusion-based models, which leads to a 5.3x to 257x speedup in wall-clock inference time. Experiments demonstrate that DiGFM outperforms or matches prior state-of-the-art models across general graph benchmarks and molecular datasets, generating graphs with strong adherence to ground-truth structural statistics at significantly faster inference speeds.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Direct Graph Flow Matching (DiGFM)，一种基于流匹配的图 Transformer 生成模型，通过直接预测干净图并将输出转换为指向干净图分布的速度向量，实现高质量图生成并大幅加速推理（仅需扩散模型 2.5%–15.6% 步数，推理加速 5.3×–257×），在通用图基准和分子数据集上达到或超越 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型采用噪声预测范式，未显式学习图的拓扑性质（如连通性、度分布），导致生成图难以符合真实结构统计特性；且扩散采样步数多、推理慢，亟需一种既能直接建模拓扑属性又能高效采样的方法。
AI.method: DiGFM 采用连续流匹配框架：从先验噪声分布出发，模型在多步过程中反复直接预测底层干净图，再通过变换将预测结果转换为指向干净图分布的速度向量，从而构建从噪声到数据的确定性流轨迹；该设计使模型显式学习图拓扑结构，并支持大步长少步采样。
AI.result: 在多个通用图生成基准和分子生成数据集上，DiGFM 生成图的结构统计指标（度分布、聚类系数、环统计等）与真实数据高度一致，性能匹配或超越现有最佳模型；推理步数仅为扩散模型的 2.5%–15.6%，墙钟时间加速 5.3×–257×。
AI.conclusion: DiGFM 通过直接预测干净图并结合流匹配机制，解决了扩散模型在图生成中隐式建模拓扑属性和采样效率低的问题，实现了高保真、高结构一致性且极快的图生成，为大规模图生成任务提供了实用的高效范式。

title: AdaSpark: Adaptive DSpark with Online Learning for Tree Verification and N-gram Fill
summary:
Block drafters such as DSpark propose ranked candidates for several positions in one forward pass, and a tree verifier checks them in one pass of the target. The number of rows to verify trades the tokens a wider tree is expected to accept against the time a wider verify takes. Most schedulers that choose this number take the verify time from a table or model measured before serving, corrected online by at most one scale factor, and take acceptance from the drafter's confidence estimates or from a map fitted offline.
  AdaSpark learns both quantities while it serves, with no profile, calibration or sweep in advance. It learns which verify widths are worth offering and fits each one's verify time as a function of context. It fits each candidate's acceptance probability to the target's verify outcomes, with the drafter's confidence head as one input, and orders and sizes the tree by that fit instead of by the head. The same model prices n-gram continuations of the request's own text, so drafted and text-derived candidates compete for rows in one best-first order. The width is chosen by pricing time at the long-run decode rate.
  On single- and multi-turn conversations from six public datasets, on three dense targets and one mixture-of-experts target, AdaSpark decodes 1.5-3.1x faster than llama.cpp's DSpark with the same drafters. Our imparo engine with AdaSpark is 1.17-1.52x faster than imparo running with a three-token chain (the default llama.cpp setting); this gain comes from the scheduler alone. Without a width sweep, AdaSpark is never more than 0.3% slower than the best pinned tree width on any dense target or context band. On the mixture-of-experts target it ties the best pinned width, and the other pinned widths from 4 to 16 rows are 5-14% slower.

AI.tldr: AdaSpark 是一种无需预先分析或校准的自适应调度器，用于块草稿器（如 DSpark）。它在服务过程中在线学习验证宽度和接受概率，利用草稿器置信度作为输入拟合验证时间与接受概率，并将 n-gram 延续作为候选竞争者，以最优优先级构建树结构。实验显示其解码速度比 llama.cpp 的 DSpark 提升 1.5-3.1 倍，且在无宽度扫描情况下接近最优固定宽度性能。
AI.motivation: 现有块草稿器调度器依赖离线测量的验证时间表或模型，仅通过单一比例因子在线修正；接受率依赖草稿器置信度估计或离线拟合映射。这种静态方法无法适应动态上下文和模型特性，导致次优验证宽度选择，限制了解码加速效果。
AI.method: AdaSpark 在服务过程中同时在线学习两个关键量：1) 每个验证宽度的验证时间作为上下文函数；2) 每个候选的接受概率，以草稿器置信度头为输入拟合目标验证结果。它用同一模型为请求自身文本的 n-gram 延续定价，使草稿候选与文本衍生候选在同一最优优先级队列中竞争树行。验证宽度按长期解码速率定价时间来选择。
AI.result: 在六个公开数据集的单轮和多轮对话中，对三个密集目标模型和一个混合专家模型，AdaSpark 解码速度比 llama.cpp 的 DSpark 快 1.5-3.1 倍。imparo 引擎配合 AdaSpark 比默认三 token 链快 1.17-1.52 倍，增益仅来自调度器。无宽度扫描时，AdaSpark 在密集目标上不比最优固定宽度慢超过 0.3%，在 MoE 目标上持平，而其他固定宽度（4-16 行）慢 5-14%。
AI.conclusion: AdaSpark 通过完全在线学习验证时间和接受概率，消除了对离线分析、校准和扫描的需求，实现了自适应且近似最优的树宽度选择。其统一建模框架将草稿候选与 n-gram 延续纳入同一竞争机制，显著提升了推测解码效率，且在各类模型和任务上均表现出鲁棒的性能优势。

title: MS-Exam-Gen: Source-Grounded Benchmark Construction for Evaluating LLMs on Textual Multiple Sclerosis MRI Knowledge
comment: 7 pages, 3 figures. Accepted for publication to BHI 2026
summary: Biomedical large language model (LLM) evaluation requires auditable assessment of narrow, evolving, source-grounded subspecialty knowledge. Multiple sclerosis MRI (MS-MRI) provides a high-stakes textual-knowledge test case because correct reasoning requires current diagnostic criteria, standardized acquisition and reporting knowledge, longitudinal monitoring concepts, lesion morphology, and recognition of difficult mimics. We present MS-Exam-Gen, a reproducible framework for constructing and auditing a text-based multiple-choice question (MCQ) benchmark for MS-MRI knowledge; it does not evaluate direct MRI image interpretation. MS-Exam-Gen targets source-grounded criteria, protocols, reporting, and differential diagnosis. The framework combines expert-source indexing, exam-oriented topic induction, evidence-grounded MCQ generation, automated quality audits, a same-family consistency screen, and empirical calibration. From a 66-source corpus indexed into 4,289 retrieval chunks, the pipeline produced a locked 3,058-item candidate benchmark spanning 16 topics and 53 subtopics. Evaluation across 12 primary LLM endpoints yielded 36,696 item-level predictions and separated performance over a 42.8-percentage-point accuracy range (89.7% to 46.9%). Across these endpoints, 25.5% of items were missed by at least four. Post-generation audits showed that refreshed construction reduced measurable answer cues, while option-order testing showed that absolute MCQ scores remain position-sensitive. Generated construction labels remain metadata rather than validated psychometric categories. Because expert adjudication and full option-order counterbalancing remain future work, MS-Exam-Gen is not a clinically certified examination. It should be interpreted as an automatically filtered, source-grounded candidate benchmark and reproducible audit workflow for item-level and topic-specific LLM evaluation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 MS-Exam-Gen 框架，用于构建和审计多发性硬化症 MRI (MS-MRI) 文本知识的多项选择题 (MCQ) 基准，以评估生物医学大语言模型 (LLM) 在该亚专业领域的表现。该基准包含 3,058 道题目，覆盖 16 个主题和 53 个子主题，基于 66 个权威来源的 4,289 个检索片段生成。在 12 个主要 LLM 端点上的评估显示准确率跨度达 42.8 个百分点 (89.7% 至 46.9%)，25.5% 的题目至少被 4 个模型答错。审计表明刷新构建可减少答案线索，但绝对分数仍对选项顺序敏感。该基准目前为自动筛选、源依据的候选基准及可复现审计工作流，而非临床认证考试。
AI.motivation: 生物医学 LLM 评估需要可审计的、针对狭窄且不断演变的、有据可依的亚专业知识的考核。MS-MRI 是高风险的文本知识测试案例，因为正确推理要求掌握当前诊断标准、标准化采集与报告知识、纵向监测概念、病变形态学及困难模仿症的识别。现有基准缺乏源依据、可审计性和针对性，因此需要一种可复现的框架来构建和审计此类基准。
AI.method: MS-Exam-Gen 框架包含六大步骤：1) 专家源索引：将 66 个权威来源切分为 4,289 个检索片段；2) 面向考试的主题归纳：生成 16 个主题和 53 个子主题；3) 证据依据的 MCQ 生成：基于检索片段生成题目；4) 自动化质量审计：检查题目格式、答案线索等；5) 同族一致性筛选：通过多模型一致性过滤低质量题目；6) 经验校准：在 12 个 LLM 端点上评估，得到 36,696 个题目级预测。此外进行刷新构建审计和选项顺序敏感性测试。
AI.result: 最终锁定 3,058 道候选题目。12 个 LLM 端点准确率范围 89.7% 至 46.9%，跨度 42.8 个百分点。25.5% 的题目至少被 4 个模型答错。刷新构建显著减少了可测量的答案线索。选项顺序测试显示绝对 MCQ 分数仍对位置敏感。生成的构建标签仍为元数据，未经心理测量学验证。专家裁决和完全选项顺序平衡仍为未来工作。
AI.conclusion: MS-Exam-Gen 不是临床认证考试，而是一个自动筛选、源依据的候选基准和可复现的审计工作流，用于题目级和主题特定的 LLM 评估。它为生物医学亚专业知识评估提供了方法论范式，但需进一步专家裁决和心理测量学验证才能用于高风险临床决策支持评估。

title: No Concept Escapes the Audit: Auditing-Aware Unlearning for Verifiable Concept Erasure in Diffusion Models
summary: Text-to-image diffusion models can generate prohibited content, which motivates concept erasure through machine unlearning. Most erasure methods intervene at the text interface, through prompt modification or localized updates to text-conditioning weights, and they are evaluated by what the model outputs for given prompts. Such evaluation cannot see what the network still encodes. Latent-space auditing, which bypasses text conditioning and probes the denoising network directly, shows that erased concepts remain recoverable from internal representations. We find that this also holds for methods built to be robust against adversarial prompts, and that the problem grows with the number of erased concepts. We propose Auditing-Aware Unlearning for Verifiable Concept Erasure in Diffusion Models (AVCE), a framework that grounds erasure in the model's latent representations. AVCE audits the embedding neighborhood of each concept and condenses the discovered vulnerable directions into an anchor at the weakest geometric point. It edits cross-attention and self-attention projections in closed form at this anchor, then fine-tunes the two pathways with pathway-level auditing losses, using orthogonal gradient projection to consolidate multiple concepts. Experiments on SD v1.5, SDXL, and Flux 1.0 across object, explicit-content, and artistic-style unlearning show that AVCE reduces attack success rates by 5.07x and improves auditing scores by 3.84x over the strongest baseline, while preserving competitive generation quality.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了AVCE（审计感知无监督可验证概念擦除）框架，解决扩散模型中文本接口层面的概念擦除方法无法彻底清除潜在空间内部表示的问题，通过在潜在空间锚点处编辑注意力投影并结合正交梯度投影实现多概念巩固，显著降低攻击成功率并提升审计分数。
AI.motivation: 现有概念擦除方法仅在文本接口层面干预（提示词修改或文本条件权重局部更新），且评估仅基于给定提示词的输出，无法发现模型内部表示中仍可恢复的被擦除概念。潜在空间审计揭示了这一问题，且随擦除概念数量增加而恶化，甚至对抗鲁棒方法也无法避免。
AI.method: AVCE框架：1) 审计每个概念的嵌入邻域，将发现的脆弱方向浓缩为最弱几何点的锚点；2) 在该锚点以闭式编辑交叉注意力和自注意力投影；3) 使用路径级审计损失微调两条路径；4) 采用正交梯度投影巩固多个概念的擦除效果。
AI.result: 在SD v1.5、SDXL和Flux 1.0上针对物体、露骨内容和艺术风格三类擦除任务实验表明，AVCE将攻击成功率降低5.07倍，审计分数提升3.84倍，同时保持具有竞争力的生成质量。
AI.conclusion: AVCE通过将擦除锚定在模型潜在表示层面，实现了可验证的概念擦除，有效解决了文本接口层面擦除方法的根本局限，为扩散模型的安全对齐提供了更可靠的技术路径。

title: Auditable Clinical Timeline Reconstruction with Provenance-Aware Evidence Graphs
summary: A patient-timeline reconstruction system is auditable only if it keeps the mentions behind each answer, records how facts were revised, and declines to answer when the evidence is not in the text. This study tests these three properties on a fully synthetic corpus (1,000 patients, 3,353 notes, 220 revision edges). Two provenance-aware Evidence Graph operators reduced the node-plus-edge count to 67% and 63% (77-78% of serialized size) while preserving every answer and mention link across 6,813 query points answerable by recency; a fixed-window baseline returned no value for 53.4% of points, unflagged. On evidence-unavailable controls that announce the omission, a BioClinicalBERT gate and a zero-shot LLM gate responded mainly to the announcement. On marker-free controls, BERT abstained on 0 of 81 notes while its accuracy fell from 93.8% to 59.3% across all three relation classes; the LLM's coverage fell from 75.6% to 27.7% on notes its own model family judged undeterminable. Against 482 regenerated gold spans, the LLM's cited evidence reached recall 0.850 and precision 0.864; BERT's span head, trained without span labels, did not localize evidence. A temporally versioned provenance graph stored abstentions as typed, queryable edges. The clean task admits a 0.651-accuracy shortcut, and results describe implementation behaviour on synthetic data, not clinical performance.

AI.tldr: 该研究在合成语料库上评估患者时间线重建系统的可审计性，测试三个核心属性：保留答案背后的提及、记录事实修订历史、在证据缺失时拒绝回答。提出两个基于溯源的证据图算子实现图压缩，并系统对比BioClinicalBERT与零样本LLM在证据缺失、无标记等控制条件下的行为表现。
AI.motivation: 患者时间线重建系统要具备可审计性，必须满足三个条件：保留每个答案背后的证据提及、记录事实如何被修订、在文本中无证据时明确拒答。现有系统往往忽略这些属性，本研究旨在构建可验证的评估框架，量化不同方法在保持可审计性的同时对图结构的压缩效果，以及模型在证据不足时的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 构建完全合成的临床语料库（1000患者，3353条笔记，220条修订边）。设计两个溯源感知的证据图算子（Evidence Graph operators）压缩图规模。建立6813个基于时效性可回答的查询点，对比固定窗口基线。引入证据不可用控制（显式宣布遗漏）和无标记控制，分别用BioClinicalBERT门控和零样本LLM门控测试模型行为。在482个再生成金标准跨度上评估证据定位能力（召回率/精确率）。构建时序版本化溯源图，将弃权存储为类型化可查询边。
AI.result: 两个证据图算子将节点加边总数分别压缩至67%和63%（序列化大小77%-78%），同时在所有6813个查询点上完整保留答案与提及链接。固定窗口基线在53.4%查询点上无返回值且未标记。证据不可用控制中，BERT与LLM主要响应“遗漏宣布”而非实质内容。无标记控制中，BERT在81篇笔记上弃权0次，准确率从93.8%跌至59.3%（三类关系平均）；LLM覆盖率从75.6%降至27.7%（在自身模型家族判定为不可判定的笔记上）。LLM引用证据达召回率0.850、精确率0.864；BERT跨度头（无跨度标签训练）无法定位证据。时序版本化溯源图成功将弃权存为可查询类型边。干净任务存在0.651准确率的捷径解，所有结果仅反映合成数据上的实现行为，不代表临床性能。
AI.conclusion: 基于溯源的证据图算子能在保持完全可审计性（保留所有答案与提及链接）的前提下大幅压缩图规模。固定窗口基线存在大量静默失败。BERT在证据缺失时不拒答且准确率大幅下降；LLM虽能较好定位证据（高召回/精确率），但在困难样本上覆盖率显著下降。时序版本化溯源图为弃权提供了结构化查询支持。研究结论基于合成数据，需谨慎推广至真实临床场景。

title: Bridging the Evidence-to-Execution Gap:A Reflective Agent for Multi-Objective Peptide Design
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can reason over scientific literature to devise design strategies, yet fail to reliably implement them for biological sequences. While protein generative models learn sequence patterns, they lack the capacity to incorporate literature evidence for multi-step reflective reasoning, forming an evidence-to-execution gap between scientific reasoning and sequence manipulation. We present EASER (Evidence-Aware Sequence Engineering with Reflection), a reflective agent bridging reasoning and sequence generation via a learned property interface of offline-trained, fixed low-rank matrices. The agent steers a diffusion generator by combining these matrices, proposing intervention hypotheses (anchors, editable positions, control coefficients) grounded in retrieved evidence, sequence context and past results. A Probe-and-Steer mechanism validates interventions and allocates samples according to predicted property responses, with outcome reflection informing subsequent decisions. Evaluated on multi-objective antimicrobial peptide design (optimizing activity, non-hemolysis and non-toxicity), explicit hypothesis formulation delivers better multi-objective performance than direct action generation under identical decision conditions. Ablation studies verify the importance of evidence retrieval, episodic history, reflection and Probe-and-Steer. Over six repeated trials, EASER obtains the highest mean hypervolume and lowest mean IGD+ on screened candidates compared with competing baselines. Our work demonstrates how an executable property interface and iterative feedback link scientific reasoning to targeted peptide sequence generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EASER（Evidence-Aware Sequence Engineering with Reflection），一种反思式智能体，通过离线训练的固定低秩矩阵构建的可执行属性接口，将科学文献推理与生物序列生成相连接，实现多目标抗菌肽设计的优化。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型（LLM）虽能从科学文献推导设计策略，但难以可靠地将其落实到生物序列操作；蛋白质生成模型虽学会序列模式，却缺乏融合文献证据进行多步反思推理的能力，导致科学推理与序列操控之间存在“证据到执行”的鸿沟。
AI.method: EASER 由三大核心组件构成：(1) 离线训练的固定低秩矩阵组成的属性接口，将序列映射为可控属性；(2) 基于检索证据、序列上下文及历史结果，提出干预假设（锚点、可编辑位置、控制系数）并引导扩散生成器；(3) Probe-and-Steer 机制验证干预效果、按预测属性响应分配采样预算，并通过结果反思指导后续决策。
AI.result: 在多目标抗菌肽设计（活性、非溶血性、无毒性）任务上，显式假设生成优于直接动作生成；消融实验证实证据检索、情景历史、反思及 Probe-and-Steer 均至关重要。六次重复实验中，EASER 在筛选候选集上获得最高平均超体积和最低平均 IGD+，显著优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 本工作展示了可执行属性接口与迭代反馈如何将科学推理转化为靶向肽序列生成，为弥合证据到执行的鸿沟提供了通用框架。

title: BeliefGraph-JEPA: Structured Latent World Models for Action-Conditioned Time Series
summary: Action-conditioned time-series forecasting requires accounting for how future actions and exogenous forcings influence multiple targets through partially observed effects with different delays and persistence. Direct conditioning leaves the evolution and target-specific influence of these effects implicit in the predictor, while static relational graphs specify connections without tracking evolving effects. This motivates representing future-driver influence through structured latent states that evolve over the forecast horizon and route information to individual targets. We introduce BeliefGraph-JEPA, a structured latent world model that factorizes driver influence into typed latent-effect states. These states are rolled forward under future drivers and routed through a graph to target-specific nodes, forming the predictive base of a joint-embedding predictive architecture. A capacity-controlled residual supplements this base with direct driver information. On four multi-target clinical, agricultural, environmental, and industrial systems, the framework outperforms a range of pretrained and supervised known-future-covariate baselines. Matched controls isolate latent dynamics, future rollout, graph routing, and residual capacity; future rollout and graph-first residual routing improve forecasting across all four systems.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 BeliefGraph-JEPA，一种结构化潜在世界模型，将未来驱动因子的影响分解为类型化的潜在效应状态，在预测时域下滚动演化并经图路由到各目标节点，结合容量受限的残差分支，在临床、农业、环境、工业四大多目标系统上超越已知未来协变量基线。
AI.motivation: 动作条件时间序列预测需处理未来动作与外生强迫通过部分观测、不同时延和持久性影响多个目标的问题。直接条件化将效应演化与目标特异性影响隐式编码在预测器中；静态关系图虽指定连接但无法追踪演化中的效应。因此需要用结构化潜在状态显式表示未来驱动因子影响，使其随预测时域演化并路由至各目标。
AI.method: 1. 将驱动因子影响分解为类型化的潜在效应状态；2. 在预测时域内依据未来驱动因子前向滚动这些状态；3. 通过图结构将滚动后的效应状态路由至目标特定节点，形成联合嵌入预测架构的预测基座；4. 引入容量受限的残差分支直接补充驱动因子信息，防止信息瓶颈。
AI.result: 在临床、农业、环境、工业四个多目标系统上，BeliefGraph-JEPA 均优于预训练与监督的已知未来协变量基线。消融实验证实：未来滚动演化与图优先的残差路由在所有系统上均带来一致性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过将驱动因子影响显式建模为可滚动、可路由的类型化潜在效应状态，并辅以受限残差分支，可有效捕捉多目标系统中不同时延、持久性及目标特异性的动态影响，显著提升动作条件时间序列预测精度。

title: Selecting Long-Horizon Trajectories for Reliable and Efficient Terminal-Agent Training
summary: Terminal agents are commonly trained by imitating long teacher trajectories, yet how much of each trajectory to supervise remains unexplored. We study the \emph{supervision horizon}, the number of trajectory tokens retained for training, and show that it is a key design axis for reliability and cost. Reliability improves with longer horizons but saturates: on Terminal-Bench, a 12K-token horizon solves more tasks than 16K ($29\pm0.7$ vs.\ $26\pm0.8$) while requiring 30\% less training time. The horizon also shapes agent behavior: short horizons cause premature termination, intermediate horizons yield productive error recovery, and long horizons induce over-persistence. We analyze this saturation through a bias--complexity bound, in which longer supervision reduces temporal supervision bias but increases finite-sample estimation error from more heterogeneous late-stage histories. Guided by this analysis, we propose \emph{selective long-horizon refinement}, which first trains on short prefixes and then refines only on continuations that are most likely under the warm-start model. It consistently outperforms full long-horizon training. At 16K, it raises successful attempts from $110\pm2.7$ to $126\pm2.1$ and tasks solved in at least six of eight attempts from $9\pm0.7$ to $14\pm0.6$; with half of the long-horizon data, it still reaches $122\pm2.4$ while cutting training time by 23\%. The gains transfer across benchmarks, from $64\pm2.6$ to $73\pm2.1$ on Terminal-Bench v2.0 and from $137\pm2.7$ to $155\pm2.2$ on OpenThoughts-TBLite. For long-horizon supervision, selecting the right trajectories matters more than training on all of them.

AI.tldr: 论文研究终端智能体训练中的监督视野（supervision horizon）即保留的轨迹token数量，发现更长视野虽提升可靠性但会饱和，12K token优于16K。视野长度影响智能体行为：短视野导致过早终止，中等视野促进错误恢复，长视野引起过度坚持。作者提出选择性长视野微调：先在短前缀预训练，再仅在预热模型下高似然的续写上微调。该方法在Terminal-Bench等基准上显著提升任务解决率，且仅用一半长视野数据即可达到相当性能，训练时间减少23%。核心结论：长视野监督中选择正确轨迹比全量训练更重要。
AI.motivation: 现有终端智能体常通过模仿长教师轨迹训练，但每条轨迹应监督多少token（即监督视野）尚未系统研究。理解视野长度对可靠性、成本及智能体行为的影响，对于设计高效训练策略至关重要。
AI.method: 1. 实证研究不同监督视野（token长度）对Terminal-Bench性能的影响，分析视野与智能体行为（过早终止、错误恢复、过度坚持）的关系。2. 通过偏差-复杂度界理论分析饱和原因：长视野降低时间监督偏差但增加异质晚期历史带来的有限样本估计误差。3. 提出选择性长视野微调：第一阶段在短前缀上预训练；第二阶段仅在预热模型下概率最高的续写轨迹上微调。
AI.result: 在Terminal-Bench上，12K视野解决任务数29±0.7优于16K的26±0.8，训练时间减少30%。选择性长视野微调在16K视野下将成功尝试从110±2.7提升至126±2.1，至少6/8次解决的任务从9±0.7增至14±0.6；仅用一半长视野数据仍达122±2.4，训练时间减23%。增益迁移至Terminal-Bench v2.0（64→73）和OpenThoughts-TBLite（137→155）。
AI.conclusion: 监督视野是终端智能体训练的关键设计轴，过长视野因异质历史导致估计误差增加而饱和。选择性长视野微调通过聚焦高似然续写，以更少数据和计算实现更优性能，证明在长视野监督中选择正确轨迹比全量训练更有效。

title: Judged Useless, Queried Anyway: Tool-Using Agents Rarely Turn Their Own Evidence Judgments into Stopping Decisions
summary: An agent whose tool keeps returning nothing useful should stop relying on it. In a retrieval environment with controlled source failures, we separate how agents judge results from what they do. We compare stopping at the same step after longer and shorter runs of results the agent judged useless; this contrast is zero for clock- or deadline-driven stopping. Where we record their judgments, the seven agents we test call a failing source's results useless 97-100% of the time, yet most of them rarely stop on that judgment. Prompt cues change when they stop but not what they stop on. Permission to answer from memory and a reasoning mode can bring early stops regardless of evidence, a stated budget moves the 7-8B models' stops to the deadline, and a stopping rule or call cost in the prompt is followed at most partly. Stopping follows the evidence only when the harness enforces an integration step that makes the agent answer after five consecutive results it judged useless. This step raises failing-source success for every model, keeps the stopping point fixed when the budget doubles, and needs no extra judgment call when the agent states its judgments. A pre-registered replication on 300 fresh questions confirms the dissociation and the rule's effect.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了在检索环境中，智能体面对持续返回无用结果的工具时是否会停止依赖它。实验发现智能体虽然能判断结果无用（97-100%），但很少据此停止；提示词线索影响停止时机而非停止对象；仅当强制执行“连续五次无用结果后必须回答”的整合步骤时，停止行为才跟随证据，且该规则显著提升失败源下的成功率、稳定停止点、无需额外判断调用。预注册复现实验验证了这一解离现象及规则效果。
AI.motivation: 研究动机是理解智能体在工具持续失效时是否会自适应停止调用，以及提示词、预算、推理模式等因素对停止决策的影响，旨在揭示判断与行动的解离，并寻找能让停止行为跟随证据的机制。
AI.method: 在受控检索环境中引入源故障，分离智能体对结果的判断与停止行为。测试七个智能体，对比长短不一的无用结果序列后的停止步骤，考察时钟/截止驱动停止的对比基线。通过提示词操控（允许凭记忆回答、推理模式、明确预算、停止规则、调用成本）及强制整合步骤（连续五次判断无用后必须回答）来干预停止行为，并在300个新问题上进行预注册复现。
AI.result: 智能体判断失败源结果无用的比例高达97-100%，但极少据此停止。提示词线索改变停止时机而非停止对象；允许凭记忆回答和推理模式导致无证据早停；明确预算使7-8B模型停止点移至截止；提示词中的停止规则或调用成本仅被部分遵循。仅当强制执行“连续五次无用后必须回答”的整合步骤时，停止行为才跟随证据，该步骤使所有模型在失败源下的成功率提升、停止点在预算翻倍时保持固定、且无需额外判断调用。复现实验确认了解离现象及规则效果。
AI.conclusion: 智能体虽能准确判断工具失效，但缺乏基于判断的自发停止机制；外部强制的整合规则（如连续五次无用后强制回答）能有效对齐停止行为与证据，提升鲁棒性，且具备预算不变性和低开销特性。这提示在智能体系统设计中应显式引入基于证据的停止强制机制，而非依赖提示词软约束。

title: Hierarchical Time-aware Bootstrapping for Off-Policy Subgoal Value Learning
summary: Off-policy hierarchical reinforcement learning must estimate the values of high-level decisions while the low-level policy changes. HIRO adapts replay data through subgoal relabeling, but after a label change, the value update targets the relabeled subgoal instead of the subgoal the high-level policy originally needed to update. We propose Hierarchical Time-aware Bootstrapping (HTB), which evaluates specified subgoals under the current low-level policy while retaining accumulated task rewards. Remaining execution time distinguishes subgoal continuation from a new high-level decision. Together with primitive-action conditioning, it enables off-policy Bellman updates based on the stationary environment transition law. HTB combines these one-step updates with multi-step suffix returns and truncated relabeling, reducing dependence on intermediate value estimates. A shared value component supports learning across actions, while nonnegative residuals constrain upward corrections relative to that component. At a fixed mixture weight of 0.95, HTB achieves 32.8% AntFall success versus 9.6% for matched local HIRO over five paired seeds at 10M environment steps. Ablations identify contributions from recursive continuation and mixed supervision; fixed-policy tests show more accurate predictions for actions whose returns were excluded from fitting.

AI.tldr: 提出分层时间感知引导(HTB)，解决离线层次强化学习中高层策略值估计偏移问题，通过剩余执行时间区分子目标延续与新决策，结合原始动作条件化实现基于平稳环境转移律的离线贝尔曼更新，在AntFall任务上显著优于HIRO。
AI.motivation: 离线层次强化学习中，低层策略变化导致高层决策价值估计困难；HIRO虽通过子目标重标签适配回放数据，但重标签后价值更新目标变为重标签子目标，而非高层策略原本需更新的子目标，引入偏差。
AI.method: HTB在保留累积任务奖励的同时，在当前低层策略下评估指定子目标。利用剩余执行时间区分子目标延续与新高层决策，结合原始动作条件化，基于平稳环境转移律实现离线贝尔曼更新。融合单步更新与多步后缀回报及截断重标签，降低对中间价值估计的依赖。共享价值组件支持跨动作学习，非负残差约束相对于该组件的向上修正。
AI.result: 在固定混合权重0.95下，HTB在AntFall任务上达成32.8%成功率，而匹配的局部HIRO仅9.6%（五对种子，10M环境步）。消融实验确认递归延续和混合监督的贡献；固定策略测试显示对拟合中排除回报的动作有更准确预测。
AI.conclusion: HTB通过时间感知引导和混合监督有效解决了离线层次RL中高层价值估计偏移问题，显著提升样本效率和最终性能，为层次策略优化提供了更稳健的价值估计框架。

title: Off-Policy Merging Beats On-Policy Self-Distillation for Continual Learning
summary: A long-standing goal of AI is a model that can continually learn and improve itself. On post-trained models, supervised finetuning (SFT) on new data often causes poor generalization and catastrophic forgetting. As such, the conventional wisdom is that on-policy training is a prerequisite for continual learning. In practice, however, data containing new knowledge or capabilities are often off-policy. While methods such as on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) try to bridge this gap by converting off-policy data into on-policy signal, they have been shown to cause reasoning collapse. In this paper, we show that off-policy merging beats OPSD for continual learning. We first show that SFT learns a useful signal from new data, but naively applying its update interferes with existing capabilities. We reduce this interference with a simple recipe we term grafting, which changes where the update is learned and how it is applied: (1) learning the update on an earlier donor checkpoint, ideally even before the end of pretraining, and applying the weight update to the post-trained model; (2) scaling the weight update, equivalent to a form of model merging; and (3) optionally, masking the most sensitive update directions when the new data distribution is far from the post-trained model. Across continual learning settings including (1) distilling from expert traces, (2) self-improvement with STaR and Pedagogical RL, and (3) injecting knowledge after pretraining cutoff, grafting Pareto-dominates both SFT and OPSD in new-task and old-task performance, while avoiding expensive on-policy sampling. Therefore, our work challenges on-policy training as a necessity for continual learning on RL-trained models.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为“grafting”的简单方法，用于在后训练模型上进行持续学习，无需昂贵的在线采样即可超越SFT和OPSD，挑战了在线策略训练是持续学习必要条件的传统观点。
AI.motivation: 在后训练模型上进行监督微调（SFT）往往导致泛化能力差和灾难性遗忘。传统观点认为在线策略训练是持续学习的前提，但实际中新知识数据常为离线策略。现有的在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）虽试图将离线数据转为在线信号，却会导致推理能力崩溃。
AI.method: 提出grafting方法：(1) 在更早的donor检查点（甚至预训练结束前）学习权重更新，再应用到后训练模型；(2) 缩放权重更新，等效于模型合并；(3) 可选地，当新数据分布与后训练模型差异大时，屏蔽最敏感的更新方向。
AI.result: 在包括专家轨迹蒸馏、STaR和Pedagogical RL自我改进、预训练截止后注入知识等持续学习设置中，grafting在新任务和旧任务性能上均Pareto优于SFT和OPSD，同时避免了昂贵的在线采样。
AI.conclusion: 离线策略合并优于OPSD，grafting证明了在线策略训练并非强化学习训练模型持续学习的必要条件。

title: Copies or Sources? Measuring How LLM Aggregators Count Restated Evidence in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Multi-agent systems built on large language models (LLMs) restate observations as a matter of course: relays forward them, shared boards repeat them and discussion rounds echo them. An aggregator that pools such messages should count sources, not statements. We convert a reported probability into units of independent readings, which assigns every restatement a copy weight, 0 for an aggregator that counts sources and 1 for one that counts every statement, and yields the implied decision under any cost structure. Three testbeds hold the evidence fixed and vary how it is restated: message logs with an exact Bayesian oracle, web documents with appended copies, and logs written by LLM agent teams under four communication protocols. Across four models from three providers, a forwarded copy counts for 0.06 to 0.42 of a new reading, mostly because some replies count every statement. On 5% to 40% of logs that state one reading three times, the reported belief implies an early commitment that the oracle never makes. The models that count copies least and most on controlled logs do so on web copies and agent-written logs as well. A one-paragraph declaration of what a copy contributes brings the copy weight on controlled logs to 0.08 or less. A rule that has agents refer to readings instead of restating them cuts belief-implied early commitment from 11.2% to 1.1% and preserves genuine corroboration.

AI.tldr: 论文研究多智能体系统中大语言模型（LLM）对观察的重述问题，提出复制权重度量聚合器是计数来源还是语句，实验显示转发副本计为0.06-0.42个新读数，简单声明或规则可显著降低复制权重和早期承诺错误。
AI.motivation: 多智能体系统基于LLM不可避免地重述观察（转发、共享板重复、讨论回响），聚合器若计数语句而非来源会导致信念更新偏差（过早承诺），需量化复制影响并设计缓解方法。
AI.method: 将报告概率转换为独立读数单位，定义复制权重（0=计数来源，1=计数语句）；构建三测试床：含贝叶斯神谕的消息日志、附加副本的网页文档、四种通信协议下LLM智能体团队撰写的日志；跨三提供商四模型评估复制权重、信念隐含的早期承诺率，并测试两种干预：段落声明复制贡献、要求智能体引用读数而非重述。
AI.result: 转发副本计为0.06-0.42新读数（主要因部分回复计数每条语句）；5%-40%单读数三次陈述的日志隐含早期承诺（神谕从不）；模型在受控日志上的复制计数倾向泛化到网页副本和智能体日志；段落声明将受控日志复制权重降至≤0.08；引用读数规则将早期承诺从11.2%降至1.1%且保留真实佐证。
AI.conclusion: LLM多智能体聚合中普遍存在“计数语句而非来源”偏差，导致证据重复计数和过早决策；通过显式声明复制权重或改变通信协议（引用而非重述）可有效纠正，使聚合更接近贝叶斯最优。

title: Groupwise Distortion Guarantees for Preference-Based Alignment
summary: Preference-based alignment methods such as reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) and Nash learning from human feedback (NLHF) aggregate pairwise preferences to learn an LLM policy, but a natural goal is maximizing social welfare (average cardinal utility), which comparisons alone need not identify. Gölz, Haghtalab, and Yang (GHY) measure the gap by distortion: the worst-case ratio between the welfare of the best fixed lottery (distribution over responses) and of the learned lottery. They show NLHF is optimal when every user receives the same lottery. Account-based LLMs, however, have information about their users and can serve different lotteries to different people. We give an efficient algorithm, GLHF, that learns a single group-conditioned policy from one comparison per user. Under individual Bradley--Terry comparisons, GLHF asymptotically matches GHY's optimal population distortion bound simultaneously on every group in a prespecified, possibly overlapping collection, with sample complexity growing logarithmically in the number of groups and inversely with the smallest group mass. A sharper guarantee for groups with similar preferences approaches distortion of one when members share a feasible favorite response. In experiments using human coffee ratings and synthetic LLM-generated ratings, GLHF lowers distortion in every evaluated group and substantially reduces worst-group distortion relative to NLHF and other group-agnostic baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GLHF（Group Learning from Human Feedback）算法，从每个用户的一条成对比较中学习分群条件策略，在个体 Bradley-Terry 模型下，同时对预设的（可能重叠的）群体集合达到 GHY 的最优种群扭曲界，样本复杂度随群体数对数增长、反比于最小群体质量；偏好相似的群体其扭曲更趋近 1。实验在人类咖啡评分和合成 LLM 评分上均显著降低各群体扭曲，并大幅改善最差群体表现。
AI.motivation: 基于偏好的对齐方法（RLHF、NLHF）仅聚合成对偏好，无法直接识别最大化社会福利（平均基数效用）的策略。GHY 用扭曲度量最优固定彩票与学习彩票的福利最坏比率，证明 NLHF 在全体用户共享同一彩票时最优。但账户制 LLM 拥有用户信息，可向不同人群分发不同彩票，因此需要一种高效算法从极少比较中学习分群条件策略。
AI.method: GLHF 算法：在每个用户提供一条个体 Bradley-Terry 比较的设定下，学习单一的分群条件策略。理论上证明其渐近同时达到 GHY 的最优种群扭曲界，适用于预设的、可能重叠的群体集合；样本复杂度对群体数呈对数增长，对最小群体质量呈反比。对于偏好相近的群体，给出更尖锐的保证：当成员共享可行的最爱响应时扭曲趋近 1。
AI.result: 在人类咖啡评分数据集和合成 LLM 生成评分数据集上的实验表明，GLHF 在每个被评估群体中均降低扭曲，并相对于 NLHF 及其他无群体感知的基线大幅降低最差群体扭曲。
AI.conclusion: GLHF 为分群条件偏好对齐提供了高效且理论保证最优的算法，仅需每用户一条比较即可实现每群体最优扭曲界，显著改善最弱势群体的福利，具有实际部署价值。

title: StagQ: Constraint-Driven Multi-Precision Weight Quantization for LLMs
summary: Serving a large language model (LLM) across a fleet of deployments requires several weight-precision operating points. Multi-precision formats serve them all from one stream whose prefixes are valid lower-precision codes, instead of storing multiple copies. We present StagQ, a multi-precision weight format whose main stream is a 2-bit group-wise affine base followed by a configurable number of 1-bit refinement planes on a dyadic step schedule. Every supported precision is a readable prefix, decoded by an affine map derived from metadata shared across all precisions, with no per-weight lookup. A sparse side record, filled both before and after the grid is fitted, holds out the few weights the grid serves worst. We report two configurations of the encoder. At two bits the cheaper one leads the strongest multi-precision baseline on Llama-3.1-8B, Phi-4, and OLMo-2-7B by 3.1 to 7.0 MMLU points, at a slightly lower logical rate. At three bits it leads on Llama-3.1-8B, leads on Phi-4 at a higher rate, and ties on OLMo-2-7B. At four bits it ties on all three, at a higher rate. In a batch-one matrix-vector product on an NVIDIA A100 GPU, timed on synthetic weights, our kernel is faster than the two baseline kernels in most shape-precision cases.

AI.tldr: StagQ 提出一种多精度权重量化格式，主流为 2-bit 组-wise affine 基础量化，后接可配置数量的 1-bit 细化平面；所有支持精度皆为可读前缀，通过共享元数据的 affine 映射解码，无需逐权重查表；稀疏侧记录处理离群值。在 Llama-3.1-8B、Phi-4、OLMo-2-7B 上，2-bit 配置比最强基线高 3.1–7.0 MMLU，3-bit 领先或持平，4-bit 全部持平；A100 上 batch-1 GEMV 内核在多数形状-精度组合下快于基线。
AI.motivation: LLM 部署需要多个精度操作点，传统做法存储多份副本浪费空间。多精度格式可从单一流中通过前缀解码得到不同精度，但现有方案在精度-速率权衡、解码开销或异常值处理上仍有不足。
AI.method: StagQ 采用 2-bit 组-wise affine 量化为基础流，后续添加若干 1-bit 细化平面（二进制步长调度）。所有精度均为前缀码，解码仅需共享元数据推导的 affine 映射，无需逐权重查找。引入稀疏侧记录，在网格拟合前后双向填充，专门存储网格拟合最差的少量离群权重。提供两种编码器配置以平衡速率与质量。
AI.result: 在三个主流模型上：2-bit 配置比最强多精度基线高 3.1–7.0 MMLU 分且逻辑速率略低；3-bit 在 Llama-3.1-8B 领先、Phi-4 高速率领先、OLMo-2-7B 持平；4-bit 三模型均持平且速率更高。合成权重的 batch-1 矩阵-向量乘在 A100 上多数形状-精度下内核耗时优于两个基线内核。
AI.conclusion: StagQ 通过前缀可解码的多精度流、共享元数据的 affine 映射及稀疏侧记录，实现了高精度、低解码开销、单一存储服务多精度部署，并在实际 GPU 内核上展现出优于现有基线的推理速度。

title: Do Small Language Models Learn to Negotiate? A Controlled Scaling Study of RL-Trained Sellers
comment: 20 pages, 3 figures, 9 tables. Accepted (poster) at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on SLMs for Agentic Systems (SLM-Agents), Paris
summary: LLM agents are starting to own the full customer experience. Soon, LLMs may be selling and buying on behalf of companies and customers respectively. Small models are more cost-efficient at scale, but can reinforcement learning train them into competent sellers? We train four Gemma 4 checkpoints (2.3B to 31B effective parameters) with GRPO on a programmatic utility reward for bilateral multi-issue bargaining, and evaluate every arm on the same 1,152 negotiations against two frontier buyers it never saw in training. With the same learning rate ($10^{-6}$) for every size, the gain of the RL model over its base rises from $+0.001$ at 2.3B to $+0.078$ at 31B. Each size was trained once and the two smallest checkpoints use a different architecture, so we fit no scaling law. Tripling the learning rate, with the same or fewer training steps, improves on the shared rate at every size by $+0.032$ (2.3B) to $+0.081$ (4.5B). In exploratory comparisons with two frontier models run as sellers, the 12B seller trained at the tripled rate scores above both, though its untrained base already scores as high as they do. The 4.5B seller at that rate shows no detectable difference from either and fits on one 48 GB GPU. A further 2.3B arm at ten times the shared rate raises pooled score, but its gain concentrates on the evaluation buyer that shares a model family with the training pool. These results suggest tuning the learning rate before concluding that a small model cannot learn to negotiate, and testing against buyers from more than one model family.

AI.tldr: 研究探讨小规模 LLM 通过强化学习 (GRPO) 能否成为胜任的谈判卖方，发现学习率对小模型性能影响巨大，12B 模型在较高学习率下甚至超越前沿模型，且 4.5B 模型可单卡部署。
AI.motivation: LLM 代理即将全面接管客户体验，小模型在规模部署时更具成本效益，但尚不清楚强化学习能否将其训练成合格的谈判卖方。
AI.method: 在程序化效用奖励下，对四个 Gemma 4 检查点（2.3B 至 31B 有效参数）应用 GRPO 进行双边多议题谈判训练，随后在 1,152 场相同谈判中，针对两个训练未见过的前沿买家模型进行评估。
AI.result: 固定学习率 (1e-6) 时，RL 增益随模型规模增长（2.3B 仅 +0.001，31B 达 +0.078）。将学习率提高三倍（步数不增）可使所有规模均获提升（+0.032 至 +0.081）。12B 三倍学习率模型超越两个前沿卖方基线，但其基础模型已不相上下；4.5B 同率模型与前沿模型无显著差距且仅需单张 48 GB GPU。2.3B 十倍学习率虽提升汇总分，但增益主要来自与训练池同模型家族的评估买家。
AI.conclusion: 在断定小模型无法学会谈判前应先充分调优学习率，且评估时必须包含多个模型家族的买家以避免家族偏见。

title: VERA: Verdict-Conditioned Reliability for Adaptive LLM Judges
summary: Accurately estimating judgment reliability is a central challenge in adapting LLM judges to newly verified feedback while preserving previously learned behavior. However, existing approaches often rely on output-level confidence, which can be overconfident and poorly aligned with judgment correctness. We propose VERA, a VErdict-conditioned Reliability Axis that estimates reliability from hidden activations by distinguishing correct from incorrect judgments within each predicted-verdict group. Using VERA as a control signal, we develop a VERA-guided periodic adaptation framework that integrates reliability-ranked corrective updates, reliability-residual replay, and periodic refresh of the reliability directions. After VERA-guided adaptation on Chatbot Arena, 8B- and 14B-parameter judges outperform the strongest baseline on each of four held-out public benchmarks, with relative gains of up to 23.01%. The framework also improves focal-class recall by up to 16.1% relative to the strongest adaptive baselines on a separate proprietary temporal auditing task.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了VERA（基于裁决条件的可靠性轴），一种从隐藏激活中估计LLM裁判判断可靠性的方法，并开发了VERA引导的周期性适配框架，在Chatbot Arena上显著提升了8B和14B参数裁判模型的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM裁判适配方法依赖输出层置信度，存在过度自信且与判断正确性对齐不良的问题，难以在保持已学行为的同时准确估计判断可靠性以整合新验证反馈。
AI.method: 提出VERA从隐藏激活中区分每个预测裁决组内的正确与错误判断来估计可靠性；基于VERA开发周期性适配框架，包含可靠性排序的纠正性更新、可靠性残差重放和可靠性方向的周期性刷新三个组件。
AI.result: VERA引导适配后，8B和14B参数裁判在四个保留的公共基准上均超越最强基线，相对提升高达23.01%；在专有时间审计任务上，焦点类别召唤率相对最强自适应基线提升高达16.1%。
AI.conclusion: VERA通过从内部表示而非输出置信度估计可靠性，配合周期性适配策略，有效解决了LLM裁判在持续学习中的可靠性估计与灾难性遗忘问题，显著提升了模型在新旧任务上的判断质量。

title: AI-Decision Checkpoints for AI-Augmented Business Process Management: Framework and Educational Instantiation
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and AI agents are increasingly embedded in operational business processes. Yet Business Process Management (BPM) curricula and frameworks still largely treat artificial intelligence (AI) as an add-on technology, leaving graduates (as potential future process developers) unprepared to reason about AI as a first-class design element of end-to-end processes. This paper addresses that gap by proposing \emph{AI-decision checkpoints}: explicit moments in a process development trajectory where process developers identify AI-candidate sub-processes, assess expected effects on time, cost, quality, and flexibility, consider legal and organisational constraints, and document a reasoned decision to adopt, constrain, or reject specific AI components. The checkpoints are instantiated through a fictitious customer onboarding process as a \textit{BPM Teaching Case}, embedded in a lifecycle-driven framework spanning six modules that combine process modeling, simulation, workflow execution with AI agents, and process mining, with each module's output serving as the next module's input. A preliminary formative reflection draws on instructor observations, submitted artifacts, and discovered process maps from learning-management-system logs. These exploratory observations suggest that the approach supported clearer distinctions between task-level automation and process-level value.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“AI-决策检查点”教学框架，将AI作为一等设计要素纳入BPM课程，通过客户入职教学案例跨六个模块（流程建模、仿真、AI代理工作流执行、流程挖掘）实例化，帮助未来流程开发者在端到端流程中理性决策AI组件的采纳、约束或拒绝。
AI.motivation: 当前BPM课程和框架仍将AI视为附加技术，导致毕业生（未来流程开发者）无法将AI作为端到端流程的一等设计要素进行推理，存在教育鸿沟。
AI.method: 提出AI-决策检查点：在流程开发轨迹中设置显式时刻，让开发者识别AI候选子流程，评估对时间、成本、质量、灵活性的预期影响，考虑法律和组织约束，并记录对特定AI组件采纳、约束或拒绝的推理决策。通过虚构的客户入职流程作为BPM教学案例，嵌入覆盖六个模块的生命周期驱动框架，模块间输出作为下一模块输入，结合流程建模、仿真、AI代理工作流执行和流程挖掘。
AI.result: 基于教师观察、提交工件和LMS日志发现的流程图的初步形成性反思显示，该方法帮助学习者更清晰地区分任务级自动化与流程级价值。
AI.conclusion: AI-决策检查点框架有效填补了BPM教育中AI作为一等设计要素的空白，通过结构化决策时刻和全生命周期教学案例，培养了未来流程开发者在业务流程中做出明智AI采纳决策的能力。

title: Measuring and Reducing Cross-Vendor Mismatch in Language Models
summary: Running the same language model on different graphics processing unit (GPU) vendors can produce different logits, even when the model weights and inputs are the same. We analyze cross-vendor mismatch in two dense and two mixture-of-experts (MoE) models with five metric families, namely bitwise equality, logit differences, top-K consistency, token agreement, and task accuracy. We trace one source of the mismatch to accumulation order inside vendors' matrix instructions. Upcasting to FP32 reduces the dense model's logit error by 43% at three times the runtime, yet keeping only the MLPs in BF16 retains 94% of this gain at 1.3 times the runtime, so most of the cost of full upcasting buys little. In the MoE models, FP32 and FP16 both lower the probability error but raise the logit error and change expert selection, and FP16 fails in the dense model. An output-head low-rank adapter (LoRA) does not help either, since the final hidden state does not predict the mismatch. The mismatch also carries into training. With every seed fixed, a student distilled from a teacher running on AMD answers 431 MMLU questions differently from one distilled from the same teacher on NVIDIA. Under FP32 upcasting, bitwise equality barely changes while the output distributions move most of the way to the reference, so judging cross-vendor agreement by a single measure misreads both its cost and its gains. Code is available at https://github.com/crova-project/crova.

AI.tldr: 论文研究在不同GPU厂商（AMD vs NVIDIA）上运行相同语言模型时产生的跨厂商数值不匹配问题，分析了密集模型和MoE模型在五个指标族上的差异，发现矩阵指令内部累加顺序是主要来源之一，并评估了FP32上转、BF16保留MLP、FP16、LoRA等缓解方案，发现单一指标无法全面评估跨厂商一致性的代价与收益。
AI.motivation: 同一模型在不同GPU厂商硬件上运行会产生不同的logits，即使权重和输入完全相同，这影响模型部署的一致性、可复现性及蒸馏训练的可靠性，需要系统分析不匹配来源并评估缓解方案的有效性。
AI.method: 在两个密集模型和两个MoE模型上，使用五个指标族（位级相等性、logit差异、top-K一致性、token一致性、任务准确率）量化跨厂商不匹配；追踪累加顺序差异；实验对比FP32全上转、仅MLP保持BF16、FP16、输出头LoRA等策略；在固定所有随机种子下，对比从AMD和NVIDIA教师模型蒸馏的学生模型在MMLU上的表现。
